function portBerthAtOld(b,now){
 const T=now/1000+b.t0,k=Math.floor(T/b.cycle),tin=T-k*b.cycle;
 let phase,u=1,loadT=0;
 if(tin<PORT_ARRIVE){phase='arrive';u=tin/PORT_ARRIVE}
 else if(tin<PORT_ARRIVE+b.load){phase='load';loadT=tin-PORT_ARRIVE}
 else if(tin<PORT_ARRIVE+b.load+PORT_DEPART){phase='depart';u=(tin-PORT_ARRIVE-b.load)/PORT_DEPART;loadT=b.load}
 else{phase='gap';loadT=b.load}
 let off=0,alpha=1;
 if(phase==='arrive'){off=PORT_SLIDE*(1-portEase(u));alpha=Math.min(1,u*3.2)}
 else if(phase==='depart'){off=PORT_SLIDE*portEase(u);alpha=Math.min(1,(1-u)*3.2)}
 else if(phase==='gap'){off=PORT_SLIDE;alpha=0}
 
 let ext=0;
 if(phase==='arrive')ext=portEase((tin-(PORT_ARRIVE-7))/6);
 else if(phase==='load')ext=1;
 else if(phase==='depart')ext=1-portEase((tin-PORT_ARRIVE-b.load)/6);
 return{b,k,tin,phase,u,loadT,off,alpha,ext,present:phase!=='gap',name:portShipName(b,k),livery:portLivery(b,k)};
}
let __opsT=-1,__ops=null;
function portOps(now){
 if(__opsT===now&&__ops)return __ops;
 const m={};for(const b of PORT_BERTHS)m[b.id]=portBerthAt(b,now);
 __opsT=now;__ops=m;return m;
}


function portCranePoseOld(c,S,now){
 const b=S.b,tipFar=(b.kind==='bulk'?b.yc+b.B/2:b.cargoY0+b.rows*PORT_ROWP)+4,tipNear=PORT_RAIL_W+78;
 const P={x:c.home,tipY:portLerp(tipNear,tipFar,S.ext),ty:PORT_LANE_Y,h:0,load:null,slot:null,grab:null,j:-1,p:0};
 if(b.kind==='bulk'){
  const hx=b.stationX(c.set[0]),py=c.pile?c.pile.cy:PORT_RAIL_L+34,hy=b.yc;
  if(S.phase==='load'||(S.phase==='arrive'&&S.tin>PORT_ARRIVE-3)){
   const tt=Math.max(0,S.loadT)+(c.id==='D6-CR2'?3.4:0),Tg=8,p=((tt%Tg)+Tg)%Tg/Tg;P.p=p;
   P.x=hx;
   
   if(p<.15){P.ty=hy;P.h=1-p/.15*.0;P.grab={open:1,fill:0};P.hh=portEase(p/.15)}
   else if(p<.30){P.ty=hy;P.grab={open:1-portEase((p-.15)/.15),fill:1};P.hh=1-portEase((p-.15)/.15)*.0}
   else if(p<.55){P.ty=portLerp(hy,py,portEase((p-.30)/.25));P.grab={open:0,fill:1};P.hh=1}
   else if(p<.68){P.ty=py;P.grab={open:portEase((p-.55)/.13),fill:1-portEase((p-.55)/.13)};P.hh=1-portEase((p-.55)/.13)*.55}
   else if(p<.80){P.ty=py;P.grab={open:1,fill:0};P.hh=.45+portEase((p-.68)/.12)*.55}
   else{P.ty=portLerp(py,hy,portEase((p-.80)/.20));P.grab={open:1,fill:0};P.hh=1}
   P.h=P.hh;
  }else{P.ty=PORT_RAIL_W+60}
  return P;
 }
 
 const list=portSlots(b,S.k).cranes.find(q=>q.id===c.id).list,n=list.length;
 if(S.phase==='arrive'||S.phase==='gap'){P.ty=PORT_LANE_Y;return P}
 const first=list[0],last=list[n-1];
 if(S.phase==='depart'){const e=portEase(S.u/.6);P.x=portLerp(last.cx,c.home,e);P.ty=portLerp(PORT_LANE_Y,PORT_RAIL_W+60,portEase(S.u/.3));return P}
 const q=(S.loadT-3)/PORT_TM;
 if(q<0){P.x=portLerp(c.home,first.cx,portEase((S.loadT)/3));return P}
 const j=Math.min(n-1,Math.floor(q));
 if(q>=n){P.x=last.cx;P.ty=PORT_LANE_Y;P.j=n;return P}
 const p=q-j,s=list[j],nx=list[j+1];
 P.j=j;P.p=p;P.slot=s;
 let xs=s.cx;
 if(p>.76){const to=nx?nx.cx:s.cx;xs=portLerp(s.cx,to,portEase((p-.76)/.24))}
 P.x=xs;
 
 if(p<.10){P.ty=PORT_LANE_Y;P.h=.6*(1-portEase(p/.10))}
 else if(p<.24){P.ty=PORT_LANE_Y;P.h=portEase((p-.10)/.14)}
 else if(p<.56){P.ty=portLerp(PORT_LANE_Y,s.cy,portEase((p-.24)/.32));P.h=1}
 else if(p<.70){P.ty=s.cy;P.h=1-portEase((p-.56)/.14)}
 else if(p<.76){P.ty=s.cy;P.h=0}
 else{P.ty=portLerp(s.cy,PORT_LANE_Y,portEase((p-.76)/.24));P.h=.6*portEase((p-.76)/.12)}
 if(p>=.10&&p<.70)P.load=s;   
 return P;
}

function portDoneCount(c,S,n){
 if(S.phase==='arrive'||S.phase==='gap')return 0;
 if(S.phase==='depart')return n;
 const q=(S.loadT-3)/PORT_TM-.70;return Math.max(0,Math.min(n,Math.floor(q)+1));
}

function portTrucks(c,S){
 const out=[];if(c.kind!=='spreader'||S.phase!=='load')return out;
 const list=portSlots(S.b,S.k).cranes.find(q=>q.id===c.id).list,n=list.length,q=(S.loadT-3)/PORT_TM;
 for(let j=Math.max(0,Math.floor(q)-1);j<=Math.min(n-1,Math.floor(q)+1);j++){
  const qq=q-j,s=list[j];if(qq<-.55||qq>.55)continue;
  let x=s.cx,al=1;
  if(qq<0){const e=portEase((qq+.55)/.55);x=s.cx-230*(1-e);al=Math.min(1,(qq+.55)/.07)}
  else if(qq>.12){const e=portEase((qq-.12)/.43);x=s.cx+230*e;al=Math.min(1,(.55-qq)/.08)}
  out.push({x,y:PORT_LANE_Y,alpha:al,slot:s,carry:qq<.10});
 }
 return out;
}


const PORT_SPRITES=new Map();
function portSprite(key,w,h,paint,q=1){
 let o=PORT_SPRITES.get(key);
 if(!o){const c=window.document.createElement('canvas');c.width=Math.ceil(w*q);c.height=Math.ceil(h*q);const g=c.getContext('2d');g.scale(q,q);g.translate(w/2,h/2);
  try{paint(g);o={cv:c,w,h}}catch(e){o={cv:null,err:String(e&&e.message||e)}}PORT_SPRITES.set(key,o)}
 return o;
}
function portDropSprites(prefix,keep){for(const k of [...PORT_SPRITES.keys()])if(k.startsWith(prefix)&&k!==keep){const o=PORT_SPRITES.get(k);PORT_SPRITES.delete(k);if(o&&o.cv)try{o.cv.width=0;o.cv.height=0}catch(e){}}}    

function portHullPath(g,L,B,bowLen,inset=0){
 const hl=L/2-inset,hb=B/2-inset,bl=Math.max(20,bowLen-inset*.6),sr=Math.max(5,26-inset);
 g.beginPath();g.moveTo(-hl+sr,-hb);g.lineTo(hl-bl,-hb);
 g.bezierCurveTo(hl-bl*.38,-hb,hl-bl*.12,-hb*.62,hl,0);
 g.bezierCurveTo(hl-bl*.12,hb*.62,hl-bl*.38,hb,hl-bl,hb);
 g.lineTo(-hl+sr,hb);g.quadraticCurveTo(-hl,hb,-hl,hb-sr);g.lineTo(-hl,-hb+sr);g.quadraticCurveTo(-hl,-hb,-hl+sr,-hb);g.closePath();
}
function portShadowRect(g,x,y,w,h,dx=5,dy=6){g.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.26)';g.fillRect(x+dx,y+dy,w,h)}
function portHullBase(g,L,B,bowLen,lv,deckCol){
 g.save();portHullPath(g,L,B,bowLen,-4);g.fillStyle='rgba(235,247,252,.32)';g.fill();g.restore();   
 portHullPath(g,L,B,bowLen,0);g.fillStyle=lv.hull;g.fill();
 const gr=g.createLinearGradient(0,-B/2,0,B/2);gr.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,255,255,.18)');gr.addColorStop(.45,'rgba(255,255,255,0)');gr.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,.30)');g.fillStyle=gr;portHullPath(g,L,B,bowLen,0);g.fill();
 portHullPath(g,L,B,bowLen,4.5);g.lineWidth=4;g.strokeStyle=lv.stripe;g.stroke();
 portHullPath(g,L,B,bowLen,9);g.fillStyle=deckCol||lv.deck;g.fill();g.lineWidth=1.2;g.strokeStyle='rgba(20,28,34,.6)';g.stroke();
}
function portBollards(g,L,B,bowLen,from,to,step=70){
 const hb=B/2-12;g.fillStyle='#2e3438';
 for(let x=from;x<=to;x+=step){for(const y of[-hb,hb]){g.beginPath();g.arc(x,y,3.2,0,Math.PI*2);g.fill()}}
}

 {id:'E6-TUG',label:'גוררת נמל',paint:paintTug,L:270,B:100,x:5898,y:PORT_QY+10},

function drawPortShips(v,now){if(WTC_LP===1)return;
 const ops=portOps(now);
 ctx.save();ctx.beginPath();ctx.rect(PORT_BOX.x,PORT_QY-40,PORT_BOX.w,900);ctx.clip();
 for(const b of PORT_BERTHS){
  const S=ops[b.id];if(!S.present)continue;
  const x=b.cx,y=b.yc+S.off;
  if(!portVis(v,b.x0-30,y-b.B/2-34,b.L+60,b.B+80))continue;
  const bob=Math.sin(now/1700+b.cx*.01)*.7*(S.phase==='load'?.6:1),pad=30,w=b.L+pad*2,h=b.B+pad*2,key='ship|'+b.id+'|'+S.k;
  portDropSprites('ship|'+b.id+'|',key);portDropSprites('cargo|'+b.id+'|','cargo|'+b.id+'|'+S.k);
  const sp=portSprite(key,w,h,g=>{if(b.dir<0)g.rotate(Math.PI);PORT_PAINT[b.kind](g,b,S.livery)},1);
  ctx.globalAlpha=S.alpha;
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(6,20,34,.30)';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x+4,y+bob+9,b.L/2-8,b.B/2+1,0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
  if(sp.cv)ctx.drawImage(sp.cv,x-w/2,y-h/2+bob,w,h);
  
  if(b.kind==='container')flDrawCargo(b,S,bob);
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;
  Targets.add({id:'SHIP-'+b.id,label:(b.kind==='container'?'אוניית מכולות · ':b.kind==='bulk'?'מובילת תפזורת · ':'מעבורת · ')+S.name,category:'port-ship',x:b.cx,y:y,w:b.L,h:b.B});
 }
 
 for(const o of PORT_BOATS){
  if(o.away&&o.away(now))continue;    
  if(!portVis(v,o.x-o.B/2-10,o.y-6,o.B+20,o.L+20))continue;
  const key='boat|'+o.id,w=o.B+40,h=o.L+40,sp=portSprite(key,w,h,g=>{g.rotate(-Math.PI/2);o.paint(g,o.L,o.B)},1.5);
  const bob=Math.sin(now/1500+o.x*.02)*.6;
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(6,20,34,.30)';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(o.x+3,o.y+o.L/2+8+bob,o.B/2,o.L/2-4,0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
  if(sp.cv)ctx.drawImage(sp.cv,o.x-w/2,o.y+o.L/2-h/2+bob,w,h);
  Targets.add({id:o.id,label:o.label,category:'port-ship',x:o.x,y:o.y+o.L/2,w:o.B,h:o.L});
 }
 ctx.restore();
}

function drawPortTrucksLegacy189(v,now){
 const ops=portOps(now);
 for(const c of PORT_CRANES){
  if(c.kind!=='spreader')continue;const S=ops[c.berth];if(S.phase!=='load')continue;
  if(!portVis(v,c.home-420,PORT_LANE_Y-60,1200,120)&&!portVis(v,c.cx-300,PORT_LANE_Y-60,600,120))continue;
  for(const t of portTrucks(c,S)){

   for(const o of st){if(o===s)continue;const d=sg*(o.pts[0][1]-y);if(d>0&&d<=44)cut.push([Math.min(o.pts[0][0],o.pts[1][0]),Math.max(o.pts[0][0],o.pts[1][0])])}
   for(const c of cv){let lo=1e9,hi=-1e9,ylo=1e9,yhi=-1e9;for(const p of c.pts){lo=Math.min(lo,p[0]);hi=Math.max(hi,p[0]);ylo=Math.min(ylo,p[1]);yhi=Math.max(yhi,p[1])}if(ey>=ylo-22&&ey<=yhi+22)cut.push([lo,hi])}
   let segs=[[x0,x1]];for(const [a,b] of cut){const nx=[];for(const [p,q] of segs){if(b<=p||a>=q){nx.push([p,q]);continue}if(a>p)nx.push([p,a]);if(b<q)nx.push([b,q])}segs=nx}
   for(const [p,q] of segs)if(q-p>1)out.push([p,ey-.75,q-p,1.5])}}
 return PORT_TRENCH_EDGES=out}

 if(pass==='bed'){for(const [w,col] of[[44,'#767b7d'],[40,'#666b6d']]){ctx.strokeStyle=col;ctx.lineWidth=w;for(const s of segs){e5PathOf(s.pts);ctx.stroke()}}}
 if(pass==='ties'){ctx.lineCap='butt';ctx.strokeStyle='#413d37';ctx.lineWidth=5;ctx.beginPath();for(const s of segs)for(const q of e5Walk(s.pts,15,7)){ctx.moveTo(q.x-q.nx*18,q.y-q.ny*18);ctx.lineTo(q.x+q.nx*18,q.y+q.ny*18)}ctx.stroke()}
 if(pass==='rails'){ctx.lineCap='round';ctx.strokeStyle='#c6cbd0';ctx.lineWidth=3;for(const o of[-13,13])for(const s of segs){e5PathOf(e5RailOffsetPts(s,o));ctx.stroke()}}
 ctx.restore()}

}

function portRoadRects(){return EDGES.filter(e=>/^TC-(E6|D6|C6)-/.test(e.globalRoadId)).map(e=>{const a=_NODE_BY_ID[e.a],b=_NODE_BY_ID[e.b],h=_ROAD_HALF(e);return{id:e.id,gid:e.globalRoadId,x:Math.min(a.x,b.x)-h,y:Math.min(a.y,b.y)-h,w:Math.abs(a.x-b.x)+h*2,h:Math.abs(a.y-b.y)+h*2}})}

const portInside=(a,b)=>a.x>=b.x&&a.y>=b.y&&a.x+a.w<=b.x+b.w&&a.y+a.h<=b.y+b.h;
const portFp=b=>({id:b.id,x:b.x+b.info.fp[0],y:b.y+b.info.fp[1],w:b.info.fp[2],h:b.info.fp[3]});

 }

const portInflate=(r,m)=>({id:r.id,x:r.x-m,y:r.y-m,w:r.w+2*m,h:r.h+2*m});

const portCraneRail=x=>PORT_CRANE_RAILS.find(r=>x>=r.x0&&x<=r.x1)||null;
function portCraneSweep(){
 let minGap=1e9,minPair='',outside=[];
 const T=Math.max(...PORT_BERTHS.map(b=>b.cycle))*2.1;
 for(let t=0;t<T;t+=1){
  const ops=portOps(t*1000),xs=PORT_CRANES.map(c=>({c,x:portCranePose(c,ops[c.berth],t*1000).x}));
  for(const q of xs){const cr=portCraneRail(q.x);if(!cr||q.x-PORT_HW-12<cr.x0+4||q.x+PORT_HW+12>cr.x1-4)outside.push(q.c.id+'@'+Math.round(q.x))}
  for(let i=0;i<xs.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<xs.length;j++){const g=Math.abs(xs[i].x-xs[j].x)-2*(PORT_HW+12);if(g<minGap){minGap=g;minPair=xs[i].c.id+'/'+xs[j].c.id}}
 }
 __opsT=-1;
 return{minGap:Math.round(minGap),minPair,outside:[...new Set(outside)].slice(0,4)};
}
function portGeometryAudit(){

 const roads=portRoadRects(),zones=PORT_RAIL_ZONES,fp=PORT_BUILDINGS.map(portFp),solRect=s=>({id:s.id,x:s.x,y:s.y,w:s.w,h:s.h});

 for(let i=0;i<fp.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<fp.length;j++)if(over(fp[i],fp[j]))issues.push('building-overlap:'+fp[i].id+':'+fp[j].id);
 
 for(const y of PORT_YARDS){const b=chunkBox(y.id);if(!b||!inside(y,b))issues.push(y.id+':bounds');for(const r of roads)if(over(y,r))issues.push(y.id+':road:'+r.id);for(const z of zones)if(over(y,z))issues.push(y.id+':rail')}
 for(let i=0;i<PORT_YARDS.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<PORT_YARDS.length;j++)if(over(PORT_YARDS[i],PORT_YARDS[j]))issues.push('yard-overlap:'+PORT_YARDS[i].id+'/'+PORT_YARDS[j].id);
 
 for(const s of PORT_SOLIDS){if(s10Own(s))continue;    const q=solRect(s);for(const r of roads)if(over(q,r))issues.push(s.id+':road:'+r.id);if(!/^E6-PYLON|^E6-SUB/.test(s.id)&&!isWagon(s.id))for(const z of zones)if(over(q,z))issues.push(s.id+':rail');if(!isLightOrTree(s.id)&&!isWagon(s.id)&&!isLeg(s.id)&&!/^E6-SUB|^E6-PYLON|-PILE/.test(s.id)&&!PORT_YARDS.some(y=>over(q,y)))issues.push(s.id+':no-yard');if(!isLightOrTree(s.id)){for(const f of fp)if(over(q,f))issues.push(s.id+':building:'+f.id)}}
 
 for(const b of PORT_BLOCKS){if(s10Own(b))continue;if(!PORT_YARDS.some(y=>inside({x:b.x,y:b.y,w:b.w,h:b.h},y)))issues.push(b.id+':outside-yard');for(const r of fat)if(over({x:b.x,y:b.y,w:b.w,h:b.h},r))issues.push(b.id+':under-sidewalk:'+r.id)}
 for(const t of[...PORT_TANKS,...PORT_PUMPS])for(const r of fat)if(over(t,r))issues.push(t.id+':under-sidewalk:'+r.id);
 for(const e of PORT_EQUIPMENT){const q={x:e.x-e.w/2,y:e.y-e.h/2,w:e.w,h:e.h},sw=(e.heading||0)>1?{x:e.x-e.h/2,y:e.y-e.w/2,w:e.h,h:e.w}:q;for(const r of fat)if(over(sw,r))issues.push(e.id+':under-sidewalk:'+r.id)}
 
 for(const s of PORT_STALLS){if(!PORT_YARDS.some(y=>inside(s,y)))issues.push(s.id+':outside-yard');for(const r of fat)if(over(s,r))issues.push(s.id+':under-sidewalk:'+r.id);for(const f of fp)if(over(s,{x:f.x,y:f.y,w:f.w,h:f.h+30}))issues.push(s.id+':building:'+f.id);for(const q of PORT_SOLIDS)if(!s10Own(q)&&!isLightOrTree(q.id)&&!/^PC-/.test(q.id)&&over(s,solRect(q)))issues.push(s.id+':solid:'+q.id)}
 for(let i=0;i<PORT_STALLS.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<PORT_STALLS.length;j++)if(over(PORT_STALLS[i],PORT_STALLS[j]))issues.push('stall-overlap:'+PORT_STALLS[i].id+'/'+PORT_STALLS[j].id);
 for(const o of PARKED_CARS.filter(o=>/^PC-(E6|D6)-/.test(o.id)))if(!o.slotRect||!PORT_STALLS.some(s=>s.x===o.slotRect.x&&s.y===o.slotRect.y))issues.push(o.id+':not-in-stall');
 
 for(const o of PARKED_CARS.filter(o=>o.ref==='SemiLong')){const I=TurboCity.info(o.asset,{scale:roadVehicleScaleFor(o.asset,o.ref)});if(Math.abs(I.fp[3]-FREIGHT_W)>.3)issues.push(o.id+':width:'+I.fp[3].toFixed(1));if(I.fp[2]>(o.slotRect.w>=o.slotRect.h?o.slotRect.w-4:o.slotRect.h+.5))issues.push(o.id+':too-long-for-stall')}

 for(const t of PORT_TREES){const q={x:t.x-12,y:t.y-12,w:24,h:24};for(const r of roads)if(over(q,r))issues.push(t.id+':road:'+r.id);for(const f of fp)if(over(q,f))issues.push(t.id+':building:'+f.id);for(const z of zones)if(over(q,z))issues.push(t.id+':rail')}

function b5PedRoute(a,b,paths=B5_PATHS){
 const segs=[];for(const p of paths)for(let i=1;i<p.pts.length;i++){const x=p.pts[i-1],y=p.pts[i];if(Math.hypot(x[0]-y[0],x[1]-y[1])>.01)segs.push({a:x,b:y,points:[x,y]})}
 if(!segs.length)return[];    
 const near=(p,s)=>{const dx=s.b[0]-s.a[0],dy=s.b[1]-s.a[1],t=clamp(((p.x-s.a[0])*dx+(p.y-s.a[1])*dy)/(dx*dx+dy*dy),0,1);return[s.a[0]+dx*t,s.a[1]+dy*t]};
 const between=(q,s)=>q[0]>=Math.min(s.a[0],s.b[0])-.01&&q[0]<=Math.max(s.a[0],s.b[0])+.01&&q[1]>=Math.min(s.a[1],s.b[1])-.01&&q[1]<=Math.max(s.a[1],s.b[1])+.01;
 for(let i=0;i<segs.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<segs.length;j++){const x=segs[i],y=segs[j],xh=x.a[1]===x.b[1],yh=y.a[1]===y.b[1];if(xh!==yh){const q=xh?[y.a[0],x.a[1]]:[x.a[0],y.a[1]];if(between(q,x)&&between(q,y)){x.points.push(q);y.points.push(q)}}else for(const q of [x.a,x.b,y.a,y.b])if(between(q,x)&&between(q,y)){x.points.push(q);y.points.push(q)}}
 const snap=p=>{let best=null;for(const s of segs){const q=near(p,s),d=Math.hypot(q[0]-p.x,q[1]-p.y);if(!best||d<best.d)best={q,d,s}}best.s.points.push(best.q);return best.q},start=snap(a),end=snap(b),key=q=>q.map(n=>n.toFixed(2)).join(','),g=new Map(),xy=new Map();
 for(const s of segs){const ps=[...new Map(s.points.map(q=>[key(q),q])).values()].sort((a,b)=>(a[0]-b[0])||(a[1]-b[1]));for(const q of ps){const k=key(q);if(!g.has(k))g.set(k,[]);xy.set(k,{x:q[0],y:q[1]})}for(let i=1;i<ps.length;i++){const x=key(ps[i-1]),y=key(ps[i]),w=Math.hypot(ps[i][0]-ps[i-1][0],ps[i][1]-ps[i-1][1]);g.get(x).push({id:y,w});g.get(y).push({id:x,w})}}
 const sk=key(start),ek=key(end),dist=new Map([[sk,0]]),prev=new Map(),open=new Set(g.keys());while(open.size){let u=null,d=Infinity;for(const k of open)if((dist.get(k)??Infinity)<d){u=k;d=dist.get(k)}if(u===null||u===ek)break;open.delete(u);for(const v of g.get(u)){const nd=d+v.w;if(nd<(dist.get(v.id)??Infinity)){dist.set(v.id,nd);prev.set(v.id,u)}}}if(!dist.has(ek))return[];const ids=[ek];let k=ek;while(k!==sk){k=prev.get(k);if(!k)return[];ids.push(k)}return[{x:a.x,y:a.y},...ids.reverse().map(k=>xy.get(k)),{x:b.x,y:b.y}]
}
function b5GeometryAudit(){const issues=[],over=(a,b)=>a.x<b.x+b.w&&a.x+a.w>b.x&&a.y<b.y+b.h&&a.y+a.h>b.y,bounds=q=>q.x>=1200&&q.y>=3400&&q.x+q.w<=2400&&q.y+q.h<=4250;for(const b of B5_BUILDINGS){if(!bounds(b.fp))issues.push(b.id+':bounds');if(B5_ROAD_BOXES.some(r=>over(b.fp,r)))issues.push(b.id+':road');if(b5CollisionAt(b.entrance.x,b.entrance.y,5))issues.push(b.id+':blocked-entrance')}for(let i=0;i<B5_BUILDINGS.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<B5_BUILDINGS.length;j++)if(over(B5_BUILDINGS[i].fp,B5_BUILDINGS[j].fp))issues.push('buildings:'+B5_BUILDINGS[i].id+'/'+B5_BUILDINGS[j].id);for(const p of B5_PARKING){if(!bounds(p))issues.push(p.id+':bounds');if(B5_ROAD_BOXES.some(r=>over(p,r)))issues.push(p.id+':road');if(B5_BUILDINGS.some(b=>over(p,b.fp)))issues.push(p.id+':building')}for(const t of B5_TREES)if(B5_ROAD_BOXES.some(r=>over({x:t.x-4,y:t.y-4,w:8,h:8},r)))issues.push(t.id+':road');if(!MAP_ACTIVE_IDS.has('B5'))issues.push('inactive');return{ok:!issues.length,issues,buildings:B5_BUILDINGS.length,parkingSpaces:B5_STALLS.length,accessible:B5_STALLS.filter(s=>s.accessible).length,parkedCars:B5_PARKED.length,paths:B5_PATHS.length,trees:B5_TREES.length,props:B5_PROPS.length,visitors:B5_VISITORS.length,roads:EDGES.filter(e=>e.globalRoadId.startsWith('TC-B5-')).length,connectors:B5_CONNECTORS.map(c=>({id:c.id,x:c.x,y:c.y,neighbor:c.neighbor})),plannedUses:['קמפוס וכיכר סטודנטים','גן תרבות ורחבת מוזיאון','כיכר עירייה וספרייה','מתנ״ס ובית משפט','חניות מוסדות נגישות','שולי גינון ושבילי הליכה']}}
window.__TC_B5_QA=()=>b5GeometryAudit();

function c5Building(id,asset,left,top,scale,rot,label){
 const I=TurboCity.info(asset,{scale,rot}),en=I.an.find(a=>a[0]==='Entrance'),x=left-I.fp[0],y=top-I.fp[1],fp={x:left,y:top,w:I.fp[2],h:I.fp[3]},entrance={x:x+en[1],y:y+en[2]};
 if(rot===0)entrance.y=fp.y+fp.h+10;else if(rot===1)entrance.x=fp.x-10;else if(rot===2)entrance.y=fp.y-10;else entrance.x=fp.x+fp.w+10;
 return{id,asset,x,y,scale,rot,label,info:I,fp,entrance};
}

function c5Line(a,b,n=12){return Array.from({length:n+1},(_,i)=>({x:a.x+(b.x-a.x)*i/n,y:a.y+(b.y-a.y)*i/n}));}
function c5Bezier(a,b,c,d,n=28){return Array.from({length:n+1},(_,i)=>{const t=i/n,u=1-t;return{x:u*u*u*a.x+3*u*u*t*b.x+3*u*t*t*c.x+t*t*t*d.x,y:u*u*u*a.y+3*u*u*t*b.y+3*u*t*t*c.y+t*t*t*d.y};});}
function c5Path(...parts){const pts=[];for(const p of parts)for(const q of p)if(!pts.length||Math.hypot(q.x-pts.at(-1).x,q.y-pts.at(-1).y)>.001)pts.push(q);const legs=[];let total=0;for(let i=1;i<pts.length;i++){const a=pts[i-1],b=pts[i],len=Math.hypot(b.x-a.x,b.y-a.y);if(len>.001){legs.push({a,b,len,s:total});total+=len;}}return{legs,total};}
function c5PathPose(path,s,reverse=false){const q=path.legs.find(q=>s<=q.s+q.len+.001)||path.legs.at(-1),t=clamp((s-q.s)/q.len,0,1);return{x:q.a.x+(q.b.x-q.a.x)*t,y:q.a.y+(q.b.y-q.a.y)*t,heading:Math.atan2(q.b.y-q.a.y,q.b.x-q.a.x)+(reverse?Math.PI:0)};}

function s12Surface(c,s,N){const r=s.rect;if(!s12In(r,10))return;

  case 'garden':s9Garden(c,r,s.id,{});break;
  case 'hedge':s9HedgeStrip(c,r,s.id);break;
  case 'paving':s9Pav(c,r,s.id,S12C.pav);break;
  case 'asphalt':s12Fill(c,r,N?'#2f3236':S12C.asph);break;
  case 'concrete':s9Pav(c,r,s.id,S12C.conc);break;
  case 'track':s12Fill(c,r,N?'#4f4232':S12C.track);s12Specks(c,r,s.id,30,['rgba(255,255,255,.25)','rgba(90,70,40,.3)']);break;
  case 'park':break;    
  case 'fence':break}}

     const wait = 4 + R() * 3; bpush(S, 0, { k: 'feet', j: kick, t0: t, t1: t + wait, face: [X(.5) - d * 100, Y(.5)] }); step(t, wait, K, new Set([kick]), 4); key(S, kick, t + wait, X(.5) + d * 8, Y(.5)); t += wait;
     holder = kick; first = true; continue; }
    if (!first && R() < .34 && toGoal > 120) {   
     const len = (4 + R() * 6) * MPX, np = [cl(hp[0] + d * len, PI_[0] + 20, PI_[2] - 20), cl(hp[1] + (R() - .5) * len * .8, PI_[1] + 20, PI_[3] - 20)], dur = len / MPX / (4.6 + R() * 1.6);
     const T = shape(h, np, tm); T[holder] = np; step(t, dur, T, new Set([holder]), 7); bpush(S, 0, { k: 'feet', j: holder, t0: t, t1: t + dur, face: [gx, GY] }); t += dur; continue; }
    
    const mates = []; for (let i = 1; i < 11; i++) { const j = tm * 11 + i; if (j === holder) continue; const p = C[j], dd = dist(hp, p); if (dd < 60 || dd > 340) continue; const fw = (p[0] - hp[0]) * d; mates.push([j, Math.max(.05, 1 + fw / 120 + (R() - .5) * .8)]); }
    if (first) { const j = tm * 11 + (R() < .5 ? 6 : 7); mates.length = 0; mates.push([j, 1]); }
    if (!mates.length) { const dur = 1 + R(); bpush(S, 0, { k: 'feet', j: holder, t0: t, t1: t + dur, face: [gx, GY] }); const np = [hp[0] + d * 20, hp[1]]; const T = shape(h, np, tm); T[holder] = np; step(t, dur, T, new Set([holder]), 6); t += dur; continue; }
    let sum = 0; mates.forEach(m => sum += m[1]); let r = R() * sum, rj = mates[0][0]; for (const m of mates) { r -= m[1]; if (r <= 0) { rj = m[0]; break; } }
    const pre = .25 + R() * .5; bpush(S, 0, { k: 'feet', j: holder, t0: t, t1: t + pre, face: C[rj] }); step(t, pre, shape(h, hp, tm), new Set([holder]), 6); key(S, holder, t + pre, hp[0], hp[1]); t += pre;
    const C2 = cur(), Tm = shape(h, C2[rj], tm), rr = C2[rj], tgt = Tm[rj], dd0 = dist(hp, rr), dur0 = cl(dd0 / MPX / 15, .45, 2.4), run = Math.min(dist(rr, tgt), 5.5 * MPX * dur0), rp = run > 1 ? [rr[0] + (tgt[0] - rr[0]) / dist(rr, tgt) * run, rr[1] + (tgt[1] - rr[1]) / dist(rr, tgt) * run] : rr;

    const T = shape(h, bp, rec < 11 ? 0 : 1); T[rec] = bp; T[holder] = hp; const fd = rec === rj ? dur : dur * .72;
    step(t, fd, T, new Set([rec]), 7); key(S, rec, t + fd, bp[0], bp[1]);
    bpush(S, 0, { k: 'air', i: holder, j: rec, t0: t, t1: t + fd, a: [hp[0] + (rp[0] - hp[0]) / (dd || 1) * 6, hp[1] + (rp[1] - hp[1]) / (dd || 1) * 6 + 1, .11], b: [bp[0] - (bp[0] - hp[0]) / (dd || 1) * 6, bp[1] - (bp[1] - hp[1]) / (dd || 1) * 6 + 1, .11], h: cl((dd / MPX - 16) * .1, 0, 5) });
    t += fd; holder = rec; first = false; }
   
   const C = cur(), hp = C[holder], rp = C[RF], dd = dist(hp, rp), dur = cl(dd / MPX / 12, .6, 3.2);
   if (holder % 11 === 0 && holder < 22) bpush(S, 0, { k: 'hand', j: holder, t0: t, t1: t + .4 }); else bpush(S, 0, { k: 'feet', j: holder, t0: t, t1: t + .4, face: rp }); hold(t, .4); t += .4;
   const T = cur(); bpush(S, 0, { k: 'air', i: holder, j: RF, t0: t, t1: t + dur, a: [hp[0], hp[1], .5], b: [rp[0], rp[1] + 1, 1.05], h: cl(dd / MPX * .08, .5, 4) }); step(t, dur, T, null, 1); key(S, RF, t + dur, rp[0], rp[1]); t += dur;
   const out = walkOut(t); bpush(S, 0, { k: 'hand', j: RF, t0: t, t1: S.pl[RF].vis[S.pl[RF].vis.length - 1][1], face: TUN }); return out; }
  const e1 = half(1, 0, MT.h1[0], MT.h1[1]); const e2 = half(2, 1, MT.h2[0], MT.h2[1]); S.end = e2; S.ht = e1; S.score = score; S.kind = 'match'; S.tA = MT.enter - 2; return S; }
 
 function scoreAt(S, u) { const s = [0, 0]; for (const g of S.goals) if (g.t <= u) s[g.team]++; return s; }
 
 
 function genTrain(seed) { const R = rng(seed), S = Sess(), N = 9, CO = 9, GK = 8;
  for (let j = 0; j < N; j++) addPl(S, TRN[j], TUN[0], TUN[1], 0); addPl(S, COACH, TUN[0], TUN[1], 0);

    bpush(S, g, { k: 'air', i: h, j: r, t0: t, t1: t + dur, a: [hpos[0] + (rp[0] - hpos[0]) / dd * 6, hpos[1] + (rp[1] - hpos[1]) / dd * 6 + 1, .11], b: [rp[0] + (hpos[0] - rp[0]) / dd * 6, rp[1] + (hpos[1] - rp[1]) / dd * 6 + 1, .11], h: 0 }); t += dur;
    prev = h; h = r; hpos = rp; }
   
   const k = pl.indexOf(h), hp = posAtTr(S.pl[h].tr, t); bpush(S, g, { k: 'hand', j: h, t0: t, t1: t + 8, face: [520, 2075] }); key(S, h, t, hp[0], hp[1]);

   q.forEach((j, i) => { const a = SP(i + 1), b = SP(i); key(S, j, t, a[0], a[1]); key(S, j, t + Math.min(dur, 2.5), b[0], b[1]); }); t += dur;   
   const g = posAtTr(S.pl[GK].tr, t), save = R() > .4, ty = save ? cl(g[1] + (R() - .5) * 36, GY - 32, GY + 32) : (R() < .5 ? GY - 30 : GY + 28), tp = save ? [PI_[0] + 10, ty] : [PI_[0] + 4.5, ty], sd = cl(dist(run, tp) / MPX / 22, .35, 1);
   key(S, GK, t, g[0], g[1]); key(S, GK, t + sd, save ? tp[0] : PI_[0] + 12, save ? ty - 3 : g[1] + (ty - g[1]) * .3);

  L0[L0.length - 1].t1 = S.pl[ho].vis[0][1]; S.balls[1][S.balls[1].length - 1].t1 = S.pl[CO].vis[0][1]; S.end = endT; S.kind = 'train'; return S; }

 
 
 function walkPath(S, j, t0, pts, v) { let t = t0; key(S, j, t, pts[0][0], pts[0][1]); for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) { t += dist(pts[i - 1], pts[i]) / MPX / v; key(S, j, t, pts[i][0], pts[i][1]); } return t; }

 function genBasket(seed) { const R = rng(seed), S = Sess(), H = [324, 2995], SP = [[262, 2950], [256, 2995], [262, 3040], [286, 2960], [286, 3030], [248, 2972], [248, 3018], [300, 2944], [300, 3046]];
  for (let j = 0; j < 4; j++) addPl(S, YOUTH[j], DOOR[0], DOOR[1], 0);
  const IN = [DOOR, [480, 3104], [372, 3104], [346, 3078]];
  let tEnd = 0; for (let j = 0; j < 4; j++) { const s = j * 1.4, sp = j < 2 ? SP[j] : [SP[j - 2][0] + 14, SP[j - 2][1]]; tEnd = Math.max(tEnd, walkPath(S, j, s, IN.concat([sp]), 1.5)); S.pl[j].vis.push([s, 1e9]); }
  let t = tEnd + .6; bpush(S, 0, { k: 'hand', j: 0, t0: 0, t1: t, face: H });
  let off = [0, 1], def = [2, 3], h = 0, passes = 0;
  const guard = (o, oq) => [oq[0] + (H[0] - oq[0]) * .22, oq[1] + (H[1] - oq[1]) * .22 + (o % 2 ? 3 : -3)];
  
  while (t < 240) {
   const C = j => posAtTr(S.pl[j].tr, t), mate = off[0] === h ? off[1] : off[0];
   
   const a = SP[Math.floor(R() * SP.length)]; let b = SP[Math.floor(R() * SP.length)]; if (dist(a, b) < 30) b = [a[0] - 20, a[1] + (a[1] < H[1] ? 44 : -44)];
   const dd = cl(1.2 + R() * 1.6, 1.2, 2.8); bpush(S, 0, { k: 'dribble', j: h, t0: t, t1: t + dd, face: H }); key(S, h, t + dd, a[0], a[1]); key(S, mate, t + dd, b[0], b[1]);
   def.forEach((d, i) => { const o = i === 0 ? h : mate, oq = o === h ? a : b, g = guard(o, oq); key(S, d, t + dd, g[0], g[1]); }); t += dd;
   if (passes < 3 && R() < .55) {   
    const hp = C(h), mp = C(mate), du = cl(dist(hp, mp) / MPX / 9, .35, .9); bpush(S, 0, { k: 'air', i: h, j: mate, t0: t, t1: t + du, a: [hp[0] + (mp[0] - hp[0]) / dist(hp, mp) * 3.5, hp[1] + 1, 1.2], b: [mp[0] - (mp[0] - hp[0]) / dist(hp, mp) * 3.5, mp[1] + 1, 1.2], h: .15 });
    key(S, h, t + du, hp[0], hp[1]); key(S, mate, t + du, mp[0], mp[1]); def.forEach(d => { const q = C(d); key(S, d, t + du, q[0], q[1]); }); t += du; h = mate; passes++; continue; }
   
   const hp = C(h), su = 1.05, make = R() < .45, rb = make ? def[0] : (R() < .35 ? off[R() < .5 ? 0 : 1] : def[R() < .5 ? 0 : 1]);
   bpush(S, 0, { k: 'air', i: h, j: -1, t0: t, t1: t + su, a: [hp[0] + 2, hp[1] - 1, 2.3], b: [H[0] - 1, H[1], 3.1], h: 1.6, cont: true }); key(S, h, t + su, hp[0], hp[1]);
   const rp = make ? [H[0] - 16, H[1] + 6] : [H[0] - 24 - R() * 18, H[1] + (R() - .5) * 60], bu = make ? 1.1 : 1.3;
   off.concat(def).forEach(j => { if (j === rb) return; const q = C(j); key(S, j, t + su, q[0] + (H[0] - q[0]) * .1, q[1] + (H[1] - q[1]) * .1); });
   key(S, rb, t + su + bu, rp[0], rp[1]); off.concat(def).forEach(j => { if (j === rb) return; const q = posAtTr(S.pl[j].tr, t + su); key(S, j, t + su + bu, q[0], q[1]); });
   bpush(S, 0, { k: 'bounce', i: -1, j: rb, t0: t + su, t1: t + su + bu, a: [H[0] - 1, H[1], make ? 2.9 : 3.1], b: [rp[0] + 3.5, rp[1] + 1, 1.05], fb: make ? .55 : .5, h: make ? 0 : .5, h2: .55 }); t += su + bu;
   const rebOff = off.indexOf(rb) >= 0; h = rb; passes = 0;
   bpush(S, 0, { k: 'hand', j: rb, t0: t, t1: t + .7, face: [200, 2995] }); off.concat(def).forEach(j => { const q = C(j); key(S, j, t + .7, q[0], q[1]); }); t += .7;
   if (!rebOff) { 
    const tmp = off; off = def; def = tmp; const out = [244, 2995 + (R() - .5) * 50]; bpush(S, 0, { k: 'dribble', j: h, t0: t, t1: t + 2.2, face: [200, 2995] }); key(S, h, t + 2.2, out[0], out[1]);
    const m2 = off[0] === h ? off[1] : off[0], mp2 = SP[Math.floor(R() * SP.length)]; key(S, m2, t + 2.2, mp2[0], mp2[1]); def.forEach((d, i) => { const g = guard(d, i ? mp2 : out); key(S, d, t + 2.2, g[0], g[1]); }); t += 2.2; } }
  
  const ho = h; bpush(S, 0, { k: 'hand', j: ho, t0: t, t1: t + 1e-3 }); let e = t; for (let j = 0; j < 4; j++) { const q = posAtTr(S.pl[j].tr, t), en = walkPath(S, j, t + .5 + j * .6, [[q[0], q[1]], [346, 3078], [372, 3104], [480, 3104], DOOR], 1.4); S.pl[j].vis[0][1] = en; e = Math.max(e, en); }
  const L = S.balls[0]; L[L.length - 1].t1 = S.pl[ho].vis[0][1]; S.end = e; S.kind = 'basket'; return S; }
 
 function genTennis(seed) { const R = rng(seed), S = Sess(), TI = [104, 3157, 342, 3267], NX = 223, BY = [3170, 3254];
  addPl(S, kit(90, '#f4f4f0', '#1f2326', '#f4f4f0', 1.74), DOOR[0], DOOR[1], 0); addPl(S, kit(91, '#2e8b57', '#f4f4f0', '#f4f4f0', 1.8), DOOR[0], DOOR[1], 0);
  const IN = [DOOR, [480, 3108], [414, 3114], [398, 3132]], P0 = [[92, 3190], [354, 3234]];
  let tEnd = 0; for (let j = 0; j < 2; j++) { const pts = IN.concat(j ? [[354, 3234]] : [[360, 3140], [230, 3140], [92, 3150], P0[0]]); const e = walkPath(S, j, j * 1.6, pts, 1.4); S.pl[j].vis.push([j * 1.6, 1e9]); tEnd = Math.max(tEnd, e); }
  let t = tEnd + .8, h = 0; bpush(S, 0, { k: 'hand', j: 0, t0: 0, t1: t, face: [354, 3234] });
  while (t < 215) { let n = 5 + Math.floor(R() * 6); const sv = posAtTr(S.pl[h].tr, t); key(S, h, t, sv[0], sv[1]);
   bpush(S, 0, { k: 'hand', j: h, t0: t, t1: t + .9, face: [NX, sv[1]] }); key(S, 1 - h, t + .9, posAtTr(S.pl[1 - h].tr, t)[0], posAtTr(S.pl[1 - h].tr, t)[1]); t += .9;   
   let first = true;
   while (n-- > 0) { const a = posAtTr(S.pl[h].tr, t), o = 1 - h, side = o === 0 ? -1 : 1, ty = BY[0] + R() * (BY[1] - BY[0]), tx = o === 0 ? 86 + R() * 14 : 346 + R() * 14, du = 1.15 + R() * .35;
    const ob = posAtTr(S.pl[o].tr, t), mv = Math.min(dist(ob, [tx, ty]), 4.2 * MPX * du); const oq = mv > 1 ? [ob[0] + (tx - ob[0]) / dist(ob, [tx, ty]) * mv, ob[1] + (ty - ob[1]) / dist(ob, [tx, ty]) * mv] : ob;

  b.vx = dx / T * 10; b.vy = dy / T * 10; b.vz = vz; S.coolJ = j; S.coolT = S.t + .3; S.own = -1; S.last = j; S.lastT = e.team; if (why) S.ev.push({ t: S.t, k: why, j }); return T; }
 function bkPass(S, j, r) { const b = S.B, e = S.E[j], q = S.E[r], d = hyp(q.x - e.x, q.y - e.y), T0 = d / 95, lp = [q.x + q.vx * T0 * .6 + Math.cos(Math.atan2(e.y - q.y, e.x - q.x)) * 2.5, q.y + q.vy * T0 * .6 + Math.sin(Math.atan2(e.y - q.y, e.x - q.x)) * 2.5];
  { const p = ballOn(e.look, e.x, e.y, e.h, 2, e.jz, .12); b.x = p[0]; b.y = p[1]; b.z = p[2]; } const dd = hyp(lp[0] - b.x, lp[1] - b.y) / 10, vh = 9, T = Math.max(.2, dd / vh); b.held = -1; e.hold = false;
  if (S.R() < .3 && dd > 4) { const T1 = T * .58; b.vx = (lp[0] - b.x) / T; b.vy = (lp[1] - b.y) / T; b.vz = (.12 - b.z + .5 * G * T1 * T1) / T1; } else { b.vx = (lp[0] - b.x) / T; b.vy = (lp[1] - b.y) / T; b.vz = .5 * G * T; }
  S.coolJ = j; S.coolT = S.t + .3; S.own = -1; S.last = j; S.lastT = e.team; S.passTo = r; S.passT = S.t; S.passPt = lp; S.ev.push({ t: S.t, k: 'pass', j }); }
 
 function bkCheck(S, a, r) { const E = S.E, b = S.B, th = E[a], q = E[r], u = S.t; th.hold = false; b.held = -1; b.mode = 'hand'; const p = ballOn(th.look, th.x, th.y, th.h, 2, th.jz, .12); b.x = p[0]; b.y = p[1]; b.z = p[2];
  const T = Math.max(.35, hyp(q.x - b.x, q.y - b.y) / 70), T1 = T * .55; b.vx = (q.x - b.x) / T; b.vy = (q.y - b.y) / T; b.vz = (.12 - b.z + .5 * G * T1 * T1) / T1; S.passTo = r; S.passT = u; S.passPt = [q.x, q.y]; S.coolJ = a; S.coolT = u + .3; S.ev.push({ t: u, k: 'pass', j: a }); }
 function bkThink(S) { const E = S.E, b = S.B, u = S.t, n = S.n, rf = E[S.rf];
  if (S.st === 'in' || S.st === 'out') return;
  const H = hoopOf(S, S.off), Hd = hoopOf(S, 1 - S.off);
  
  rf.tx = cl(b.x - (n === 5 ? (H.s < 0 ? 40 : -40) : 30), n === 5 ? BK.x0 + 20 : 220, BK.x1 - 18); rf.ty = BK.y1 + 7; rf.spd = 4; rf.face = [b.x, b.y];
  if (S.st === 'jump' || S.st === 'check' || S.st === 'inb') return;
  const offE = E.filter(e => e.team === S.off), defE = E.filter(e => e.team === 1 - S.off), Hs = n === 5 ? [[0, 7.3], [-52, 6.8], [52, 6.8], [-84, 6.5], [64, 2.4]] : [[0, 7.3], [S.side || -55, 6.6]];
  if (S.st === 'live' && (!S.spT || u > S.spT)) { S.spT = u + 3 + S.R() * 4; S.side = S.R() < .5 ? -55 : 55; S.rot = (S.rot || 0) + (S.R() < .4 ? 1 : 0); }
  offE.forEach((e, k) => { const q = Hs[(k + (S.rot || 0)) % Hs.length], p = spotB(H, q[0], q[1]); if (S.own !== e.j) { e.tx = p[0]; e.ty = p[1]; e.spd = hyp(p[0] - e.x, p[1] - e.y) > 50 ? 5.5 : 3; e.face = [b.x, b.y]; } });
  if (S.st === 'bring' || S.st === 'clear') { const h = E[S.own >= 0 ? S.own : S.last]; if (h && S.own === h.j) { const p = spotB(H, 0, 7.6); h.tx = p[0]; h.ty = p[1]; h.spd = 4.6; if (hyp(h.x - p[0], h.y - p[1]) < 12) S.st = 'live'; } }
  defE.forEach((e, k) => { const m = offE[k] || offE[0], dd = hyp(H.rx - m.x, BK.cy - m.y), f = dd > 30 ? .26 : .12; e.tx = m.x + (H.rx - m.x) * f; e.ty = m.y + (BK.cy - m.y) * f; e.spd = hyp(e.tx - e.x, e.ty - e.y) > 40 ? 5.8 : 4; e.face = [m.x, m.y]; });
  
  if (b.held < 0) { const lp = bkLand(S); for (let tm = 0; tm < 2; tm++) { const T = E.filter(e => e.team === tm).map(e => [hyp(e.x - lp[0], e.y - lp[1]), e]).sort((a, c) => a[0] - c[0]); T.slice(0, n === 5 ? 2 : 1).forEach((q, k) => { const e = q[1]; if (S.passTo === e.j && u - S.passT < 2) { e.tx = S.passPt[0]; e.ty = S.passPt[1]; } else { e.tx = lp[0] + (k ? 9 : 0) * (tm ? 1 : -1); e.ty = lp[1] + (k ? 6 : 0); } e.spd = e.top; e.face = [b.x, b.y]; }); } return; }
  if (S.own < 0) return; const h = E[S.own]; if (h.team !== S.off) return;
  if (S.st !== 'live') return;
  
  const dr = hyp(H.rx - h.x, BK.cy - h.y), opp = defE.reduce((m, e) => Math.min(m, hyp(e.x - h.x, e.y - h.y)), 1e9);
  if (!S.plan && u > S.planT) { const R = S.R; if (dr < 26) S.plan = { k: 'shoot' }; else if (dr < 74 && opp > 12 && R() < .4) S.plan = { k: 'shoot' }; else if (R() < .22 && dr < 110) S.plan = { k: 'drive', p: [H.rx + H.s * 15, BK.cy + (R() - .5) * 16] };
   else if (R() < .65) { let best = null, bs = -1e9; offE.forEach(e => { if (e === h) return; const o = defE.reduce((m, f) => Math.min(m, hyp(f.x - e.x, f.y - e.y)), 1e9), lane = defE.reduce((m, f) => Math.min(m, segD(f.x, f.y, h.x, h.y, e.x, e.y)), 1e9); const s = o / 10 + Math.min(lane, 12) / 4 + R() * 2 - (e.j === S.lastPass ? 2 : 0); if (s > bs) { bs = s; best = e; } }); S.plan = best ? { k: 'pass', r: best.j } : { k: 'drib', p: spotB(H, (R() - .5) * 120, 6 + R() * 1.5) }; }
   else S.plan = { k: 'drib', p: spotB(H, (R() - .5) * 130, 5.5 + R() * 2) }; }
  const P = S.plan; if (P && (P.k === 'drive' || P.k === 'drib')) { h.tx = P.p[0]; h.ty = P.p[1]; h.spd = P.k === 'drive' ? 5.6 : 3.8; h.face = [H.rx, BK.cy]; if (b.mode === 'hand') { b.mode = 'drib'; b.vz = -3.2; h.hold = false; } }
  else { h.tx = h.x; h.ty = h.y; h.face = P && P.k === 'pass' ? [E[P.r].x, E[P.r].y] : [H.rx, BK.cy]; } }
 function bkLand(S) { const b = S.B; let x = b.x, y = b.y, z = b.z, vx = b.vx, vy = b.vy, vz = b.vz; for (let k = 0; k < 150; k++) { vz -= G * .02; x += vx * .02; y += vy * .02; z += vz * .02; if (vz < 0 && z < 2.1) break; } return [cl(x, BK.x0 + 4, BK.x1 - 4), cl(y, BK.y0 + 4, BK.y1 - 4)]; }
 function bkBall(S) { const b = S.B, E = S.E;
  if (b.held >= 0) { const e = E[b.held]; b.hid = !e.vis; const ch = Math.cos(e.h), sh = Math.sin(e.h);
   if (b.mode === 'drib') { const sd = 2.4 * e.look.h / 1.8; b.x = e.x + ch * 1.1 - sh * sd; b.y = e.y + sh * 1.1 + ch * sd * .42 + .3; b.vz -= G * DT; b.z += b.vz * DT; if (b.z <= .12) { b.z = .12; b.vz = Math.abs(b.vz) * .84; S.ev.push({ t: S.t, k: 'bounce' }); } if (b.z >= .46 * e.look.h + .12 && b.vz > 0) { if (S.stopDrib) { b.mode = 'hand'; e.hold = true; S.stopDrib = false; } else b.vz = -(3.1 + hyp(e.vx, e.vy) / 30); } b.roll += 2; return; }
   const p = ballOn(e.look, e.x, e.y, e.h, b.mode === 'up' ? 4 : 2, e.jz, .12); b.x = p[0]; b.y = p[1]; b.z = p[2]; b.vx = b.vy = b.vz = 0; return; }    
  b.hid = false; const px = b.x, py = b.y, pz = b.z; b.vz -= G * DT; b.x += b.vx * DT; b.y += b.vy * DT; b.z += b.vz * DT; b.roll += hyp(b.x - px, b.y - py);
  if (b.z <= .12) { b.z = .12; if (b.vz < -.8) { b.vz = -b.vz * .78; b.vx *= .9; b.vy *= .9; S.ev.push({ t: S.t, k: 'bounce' }); } else { b.vz = 0; const sp = hyp(b.vx, b.vy); if (sp > 0) { const ns = Math.max(0, sp - 8 * DT); b.vx *= ns / sp; b.vy *= ns / sp; } } }
  for (let hi = 0; hi < 2; hi++) { const H = BK.H[hi];
   
   if (Math.abs(b.y - BK.cy) < 9 + 1.2 && b.z > 2.9 - .12 && b.z < 3.95 + .12) { const s0 = (px - H.bx) * H.s, s1 = (b.x - H.bx) * H.s; if (s0 >= 1.2 && s1 < 1.2) { b.x = H.bx + H.s * 1.2; b.vx = -b.vx * .6; b.vy *= .9; S.ev.push({ t: S.t, k: 'board', h: hi }); } }
   
   if (b.z < 3.4) { const dx = b.x - H.px, dy = b.y - BK.cy, d = hyp(dx, dy); if (d < 2.8) { const nx = d ? dx / d : 1, ny = d ? dy / d : 0, vn = b.vx * nx + b.vy * ny; if (vn < 0) { b.vx -= 1.5 * vn * nx; b.vy -= 1.5 * vn * ny; } b.x = H.px + nx * 2.8; b.y = BK.cy + ny * 2.8; } }
   
   const dxm = (b.x - H.rx) / 10, dym = (b.y - BK.cy) / 10, rho = hyp(dxm, dym) || 1e-6, qx = dxm / rho * .225, qy = dym / rho * .225, ex = dxm - qx, ey = dym - qy, dz = b.z - BK.rz, dd = hyp(ex, ey, dz), Rr = .13;
   if (dd < Rr) { const nx = ex / dd, ny = ey / dd, nz = dz / dd, vx = b.vx / 10, vy = b.vy / 10, vn = vx * nx + vy * ny + b.vz * nz; if (vn < 0) { const k = 1.6; b.vx = (vx - k * vn * nx) * 10; b.vy = (vy - k * vn * ny) * 10; b.vz -= k * vn * nz; S.ev.push({ t: S.t, k: 'rim', h: hi }); } b.x = (H.rx / 10 + qx + nx * Rr) * 10; b.y = (BK.cy / 10 + qy + ny * Rr) * 10; b.z = BK.rz + nz * Rr; }
   
   const rh = hyp(b.x - H.rx, b.y - BK.cy) / 10; if (pz > BK.rz && b.z <= BK.rz && rh < .19 && S.shot && !S.shot.made && S.shot.h === hi) { S.shot.made = true; S.pts.push({ t: S.t, team: S.shot.team, n: S.shot.n }); S.ev.push({ t: S.t, k: 'swish', h: hi, n: S.shot.n }); if (S.shot.n === 3) { const rf = E[S.rf]; rf.sig = 3; rf.sigT = S.t + 1.4; } }
   if (b.z < BK.rz && b.z > 2.5 && rh < .3) { b.vx *= .9; b.vy *= .9; b.vz *= .985; b.x += (H.rx - b.x) * .08; b.y += (BK.cy - b.y) * .08; } }
  const W = BK.W; if (b.x < W[0]) { b.x = W[0]; b.vx = Math.abs(b.vx) * .3; } if (b.x > W[2]) { b.x = W[2]; b.vx = -Math.abs(b.vx) * .3; } if (b.y < W[1]) { b.y = W[1]; b.vy = Math.abs(b.vy) * .3; } if (b.y > W[3]) { b.y = W[3]; b.vy = -Math.abs(b.vy) * .3; } }
 function bkRules(S) { const E = S.E, b = S.B, u = S.t, n = S.n, rf = E[S.rf], R = S.R;
  if (S.st === 'in') { const P = bkStartPos(S); E.forEach((e, j) => { if (!e.vis && u >= e.appear) e.vis = true; if (e.vis && e.leg === undefined) e.leg = 0; if (e.vis) { const w = [...(S.G || BK).path.slice(1), P[j]]; if (e.leg < w.length && hyp(e.x - w[e.leg][0], e.y - w[e.leg][1]) < 4) e.leg++; const q = w[Math.min(e.leg, w.length - 1)]; e.tx = q[0]; e.ty = q[1]; e.spd = 1.6 + (j % 3) * .1; e.face = [BK.cx, BK.cy]; } });

   return; }

 function goTo(e, P, t0, t1, face) { let V0 = [e.vx, e.vy]; const tl = landT(e, t0); if (tl > t0 + 1e-6) { t0 = tl; V0 = [0, 0]; }

 function walkTo(e, P, t, spd, face) { const d = hyp(P[0] - e.x, P[1] - e.y); return goTo(e, P, t, landT(e, t) + Math.max(.45, d / ((spd || 3) * 10) * 1.5), face); }
 const reach = (e, tau) => Math.max(0, tau - .12) * e.top * 10 / 1.5;

 function fixAt(e, a, t, k, t0, t1) { e.fixH = a; e.fixT = (t0 == null ? t - .22 : Math.min(t0, t - .1)) - .2; e.fixT2 = t - .06; e.ps = { a: t0 == null ? t - .22 : t0, b: t1 == null ? t + .2 : t1, k }; e.face = far(e, a); }
 function legStep(e, t) { const L = e.L; let x = e.x, y = e.y, vx = 0, vy = 0;
  if (L && t < L.t1) { const D = L.t1 - L.t0, s = cl((t - L.t0) / D, 0, 1), s2 = s * s, s3 = s2 * s, a0 = 2 * s3 - 3 * s2 + 1, a1 = s3 - 2 * s2 + s, a2 = -2 * s3 + 3 * s2, d0 = 6 * s2 - 6 * s, d1 = 3 * s2 - 4 * s + 1, d2 = -6 * s2 + 6 * s;
   x = a0 * L.P0[0] + a1 * D * L.V0[0] + a2 * L.P1[0]; y = a0 * L.P0[1] + a1 * D * L.V0[1] + a2 * L.P1[1]; if (t >= L.t0) { vx = (d0 * L.P0[0] + d1 * D * L.V0[0] + d2 * L.P1[0]) / D; vy = (d0 * L.P0[1] + d1 * D * L.V0[1] + d2 * L.P1[1]) / D; } }
  else if (L) { x = L.P1[0]; y = L.P1[1]; e.L = null; }
  const sp = hyp(vx, vy); e.d += hyp(x - e.x, y - e.y) / (1 + 1.4 * cl((sp / 10 - 2.2) / 4, 0, 1)); e.x = x; e.y = y; e.vx = vx; e.vy = vy; e.mv = sp > 4;
  const fx = e.fixH != null && t >= e.fixT, hd = fx ? e.fixH : sp > 8 ? Math.atan2(vy, vx) : e.face ? Math.atan2(e.face[1] - e.y, e.face[0] - e.x) : null;
  if (hd != null && isFinite(hd)) { if (fx && t >= e.fixT2) e.h = hd; else { const df = wrapA(hd - e.h), mx = (fx ? 16 : 9) * DT; e.h = wrapA(e.h + cl(df, -mx, mx)); } }
  const J = e.J; e.jz = 0; if (J && t >= J.t0) { const u = t - J.t0; if (u >= 2 * J.v / G) e.J = null; else e.jz = Math.max(0, J.v * u - .5 * G * u * u); }
  const P = e.ps; e.sig = P && t >= P.a && t < P.b ? P.k : 0; if (P && t >= P.b) { e.ps = null; e.fixH = null; } }
 
 function mkF(A, t0, B, t1) { const T = t1 - t0; return { t0, t1, A: A.slice(), B: B.slice(), vx: (B[0] - A[0]) / T, vy: (B[1] - A[1]) / T, vz: (B[2] - A[2] + .5 * G * T * T) / T }; }
 const fAt = (F, t) => { const u = t - F.t0; return [F.A[0] + F.vx * u, F.A[1] + F.vy * u, F.A[2] + F.vz * u - .5 * G * u * u]; };
 const fNet = F => { if ((F.A[0] - VB.nx) * (F.B[0] - VB.nx) >= 0 || !F.vx) return 99; const p = fAt(F, F.t0 + (VB.nx - F.A[0]) / F.vx); return p[1] > VB.posts[0] - 3 && p[1] < VB.posts[1] + 3 ? p[2] : 99; };

 function vbDefend(S, t, tm) { const E = S.E, R = S.R, sd = side(tm), T = E.filter(e => e.team === tm), bl = T.slice().sort((a, c) => Math.abs(a.x - VB.nx) - Math.abs(c.x - VB.nx))[0], df = T.find(e => e !== bl);

 function vbRec(S, t, A, tm, r, kind, N) { const E = S.E, R = S.R, sd = side(tm), s = E.find(e => e.team === tm && e !== r);
  const pose = kind === 'spike' ? (R() < .6 ? 7 : 2) : kind === 'serve' ? (R() < .25 ? 7 : 2) : (R() < .3 ? 7 : 2), zc = zHand(r.look, pose) + BZ, spd = 120 + R() * 40;

  const okBlk = F => { if (!blk || (F.A[0] - VB.nx) * (F.B[0] - VB.nx) >= 0) return true; const p = fAt(F, F.t0 + (VB.nx - F.A[0]) / F.vx); return Math.abs(p[1] - blk.y) > 6 || p[2] > blk.z + .35; };

 function vbOver(S, t, A, from, kind, N) { const E = S.E, R = S.R, fr = E[from], tm = 1 - fr.team, sd = side(tm), mine = E.filter(e => e.team === tm);
  const roll = R(), pOut = kind === 'serve' ? .05 : kind === 'over' ? .02 : .08, pKill = kind === 'serve' ? .06 : kind === 'over' ? 0 : (S.rl || 0) > 3 ? .45 : .26, spd = 120 + R() * 40;
  let res = roll < pOut ? 'out' : roll < pOut + pKill ? 'kill' : 'rec'; vbDefend(S, t, fr.team);
  if (res === 'rec') { const r = kind === 'serve' ? mine[R() < .5 ? 0 : 1] : N && N.dig != null ? E[N.dig] : mine.slice().sort((a, c) => Math.abs(c.x - VB.nx) - Math.abs(a.x - VB.nx))[0];
   if (vbRec(S, t, A, tm, r, kind, N)) return; res = 'kill'; }
  const blk = N && N.blk && !N.blk.hit ? N.blk : null, okBlk = F => { if (!blk || (F.A[0] - VB.nx) * (F.B[0] - VB.nx) >= 0) return true; const p = fAt(F, F.t0 + (VB.nx - F.A[0]) / F.vx); return Math.abs(p[1] - blk.y) > 6 || p[2] > blk.z + .35; };
  for (let q = 0; q < 40; q++) { const L = res === 'kill' ? [VB.nx + sd * (8 + R() * 64), VB.y0 + 3 + R() * (VB.y1 - VB.y0 - 6)] : R() < .6 ? [sd < 0 ? VB.x0 - 4 - R() * 10 : VB.x1 + 4 + R() * 10, VB.y0 + R() * (VB.y1 - VB.y0)] : [VB.nx + sd * (10 + R() * 60), R() < .5 ? VB.y0 - 4 - R() * 9 : VB.y1 + 4 + R() * 9];
   const B = [L[0], L[1], BZ], ap = (kind === 'serve' ? 3.5 + R() * 1.6 : kind === 'spike' ? 0 : Math.max(A[2] + .3, 3) + R() * 1.1) + (q > 20 ? .6 + (q - 20) * .1 : 0), tau = kind === 'spike' ? hyp(B[0] - A[0], B[1] - A[1]) / spd * (1 + (q % 10) * .1) : tFly(A[2], BZ, ap), t1 = qT(t + Math.max(.3, tau)), F = mkF(A, t, B, t1);
   if (fNet(F) < NETOK || !okBlk(F) || fTop(F) > 7.5) continue;
   if (res === 'kill' && q < 30 && mine.some(e => hyp(e.x - L[0], e.y - L[1]) < reach(e, t1 - landT(e, t)) * (kind === 'serve' ? .6 : 1) + 9)) continue;
   const ch = mine.slice().sort((a, c) => hyp(a.x - L[0], a.y - L[1]) - hyp(c.x - L[0], c.y - L[1]))[0]; fly(S, F, ch.j, 'sand', kind, null); F.pt = res === 'kill' ? fr.team : tm; F.res = res === 'kill' ? 'in' : 'out';

   goTo(ch, [ch.x + (L[0] - ch.x) * k, ch.y + (L[1] - ch.y) * k], t, res === 'kill' ? Math.max(t1 + .25, t + d / (ch.top * 10) * 1.5) : t1 + .2, [L[0], L[1]]); return; }
  if (kind !== 'over') { vbOver(S, t, A, from, 'over', null); return; }

 function vbToSetter(S, t, N) { const E = S.E, R = S.R, r = E[N.j], s = E[N.setter], tm = r.team, sd = side(tm), b = S.B, sy = N.setSpot[1];

  const o = 1 - tm, so = side(o), O = E.filter(e => e.team === o), bl = O.slice().sort((a, c) => Math.abs(a.x - VB.nx) - Math.abs(c.x - VB.nx))[0], df = O.find(e => e !== bl);
  S.blkOn = R() < .7; walkTo(bl, S.blkOn ? [VB.nx + so * 4.5, Ap[1]] : [VB.nx + so * 22, (Ap[1] + VB.cy) / 2], t, 4.2, [VB.nx - so * 40, Ap[1]]);
  walkTo(df, [VB.nx + so * (40 + R() * 10), cl(VB.cy - (Ap[1] - VB.cy) * .6 + (R() - .5) * 10, VB.y0 + 6, VB.y1 - 6)], t, 4.2, [VB.nx, VB.cy]);

 function vbToHitter(S, t, N) { const E = S.E, R = S.R, s = E[N.j], h = E[N.hitter], tm = h.team, sd = side(tm), b = S.B, Ap = N.Ap;
  const type = R() < .22 ? 'shot' : 'spike', zs = zHand(h.look, 4), J = cl(VB.top + .3 + R() * .14 - zs, .45, .95), jv = Math.sqrt(2 * G * J), ph = Math.atan2(VB.cy + (R() - .5) * 40 - Ap[1], -sd * 60);
  const B = ballOn(h.look, Ap[0], Ap[1], ph, 4, J), need = hyp(Ap[0] - h.x, Ap[1] - h.y) / (h.top * 10) * 1.5 + .15;
  const t1 = qT(t + Math.max(tFly(b.z, B[2], Math.max(b.z, B[2]) + 1.1 + R() * .6), need + jv / G)), tj = t1 - jv / G, F = mkF([b.x, b.y, b.z], t, B, t1);
  const bl = E[N.bl], df = E[N.df], so = side(bl.team); let blk = null;
  if (S.blkOn) { const hit = type === 'spike' && R() < .16, tb = t1 + 2 * QG, zb = zHand(bl.look, 4), Jb = cl(NETOK + .06 - BZ - zb, .3, .95), jvb = Math.sqrt(2 * G * Jb), phb = sd > 0 ? 0 : Math.PI;
   const by = hit ? B[1] : cl(B[1] + (R() < .5 ? -1 : 1) * (7 + R() * 3), VB.y0, VB.y1), ft = [VB.nx + so * 4.5, by], Bb = ballOn(bl.look, ft[0], ft[1], phb, 4, Jb), tjb = tb - jvb / G;
   goTo(bl, ft, t, Math.max(t + .25, tjb - .05)); bl.J = { t0: tjb, v: jvb }; fixAt(bl, phb, tb, 4, tjb, tjb + 2 * jvb / G); blk = { j: bl.j, y: Bb[1], z: Bb[2], hit, tb, B: Bb }; }
  fly(S, F, h.j, 'touch', 'set', { k: 'attack', ev: type, j: h.j, type, blk, dig: S.blkOn ? df.j : null, tm });
  goTo(h, Ap, t, tj - .02); h.J = { t0: tj, v: jv }; fixAt(h, ph, t1, 4, tj, tj + 2 * jv / G);
  goTo(s, [VB.nx + sd * 30, cl(VB.cy - (Ap[1] - VB.cy) * .8, VB.y0 + 8, VB.y1 - 8)], t + .3, t + 1.6, [VB.nx, VB.cy]); }
 
 function vbBlockOut(S, t, bl) { const E = S.E, R = S.R, b = S.B, A = [b.x, b.y, b.z], atk = 1 - bl.team, sa = side(atk);
  if (R() < .75) for (let q = 0; q < 12; q++) { const L = [VB.nx + sa * (5 + R() * 16), cl(A[1] + (R() - .5) * 16, VB.y0 - 4, VB.y1 + 4)], t1 = qT(t + tFly(A[2], BZ, A[2] + .2 + q * .12)), F = mkF(A, t, [L[0], L[1], BZ], t1); if (fNet(F) < NETOK) continue;
   const ch = E.filter(e => e.team === atk).sort((a, c) => hyp(a.x - L[0], a.y - L[1]) - hyp(c.x - L[0], c.y - L[1]))[0]; fly(S, F, ch.j, 'sand', 'block', null); F.pt = bl.team; F.res = 'block';
   const d = hyp(L[0] - ch.x, L[1] - ch.y), k = Math.max(0, d - 3) / (d || 1); goTo(ch, [ch.x + (L[0] - ch.x) * k, ch.y + (L[1] - ch.y) * k], t, Math.max(t1 + .2, t + .4), [L[0], L[1]]); return; }
  const df = E.find(e => e.team === bl.team && e !== bl); if (vbRec(S, t, A, bl.team, df, 'over', null)) return; vbOver(S, t, A, bl.j, 'over', null); }
 function vbPoint(S, tm, why) { S.pts.push({ t: S.t, team: tm, n: 1 }); S.score[tm]++; S.ev.push({ t: S.t, k: 'point', team: tm, why }); S.st = 'dead'; S.deadT = S.t; S.next = null; if (S.srvT !== tm) { S.srvT = tm; S.sk[tm] = 1 - S.sk[tm]; } S.srv = tm * 2 + S.sk[tm]; }
 
 function vbArrive(S, t) { const F = S.F, E = S.E, b = S.B;
  if (F.kind === 'sand') { setMode(S, 'free', t); b.vx = F.vx; b.vy = F.vy; b.vz = F.vz - G * (F.t1 - F.t0); S.ev.push({ t, k: 'mark', x: b.x, y: b.y }); vbFree(S); if (S.st === 'rally') vbPoint(S, F.pt, F.res); return; }
  const e = E[F.j], N = S.next || {}, A = [b.x, b.y, b.z]; S.ev.push({ t, k: N.ev || 'touch', j: e.j, x: b.x, y: b.y, z: b.z });
  if (N.k === 'catch') { setMode(S, 'held', t); b.held = e.j; e.hold = true; return; }
  if (N.k === 'serve') { S.st = 'rally'; vbOver(S, t, A, e.j, 'serve', null); return; }
  if (N.k === 'bump') { vbToSetter(S, t, N); return; }
  if (N.k === 'set') { vbToHitter(S, t, N); return; }
  if (N.k === 'attack') { if (N.blk && N.blk.hit) { fly(S, mkF(A, t, N.blk.B, N.blk.tb), N.blk.j, 'touch', N.type, { k: 'block', ev: 'block', j: N.blk.j }); vbDefend(S, t, e.team); } else vbOver(S, t, A, e.j, N.type, N); return; }
  if (N.k === 'block') { vbBlockOut(S, t, e); return; }
  setMode(S, 'free', t); }
 
 function vbFree(S) { const b = S.B, px = b.x; b.vz -= G * DT; b.x += b.vx * DT; b.y += b.vy * DT; b.z += b.vz * DT; b.roll += hyp(b.vx, b.vy) * DT;
  if (b.z <= BZ) { b.z = BZ; if (b.vz < -1) { b.vz = -b.vz * .18; b.vx *= .35; b.vy *= .35; } else { b.vz = 0; const v = hyp(b.vx, b.vy); if (v > 0) { const nv = Math.max(0, v - 60 * DT); b.vx *= nv / v; b.vy *= nv / v; } } }
  if ((px - VB.nx) * (b.x - VB.nx) <= 0 && px !== b.x && b.y > VB.posts[0] && b.y < VB.posts[1]) { b.x = VB.nx + (Math.sign(px - VB.nx) || 1) * 4.5; b.vx = 0; }
  if (Math.abs(b.x - VB.nx) < 4.5 && b.z < .5) b.x = VB.nx + (Math.sign(b.x - VB.nx) || 1) * 4.5;
  b.x = cl(b.x, VB.W[0] + 6, VB.W[2] - 6); b.y = cl(b.y, VB.W[1] + 6, VB.W[3] - 6); }
 
 function vbPrep(S, t) { const E = S.E, b = S.B, R = S.R, sv = E[S.srv], tm = sv.team, sd = side(tm);

   for (let q = 0; q < 14 && !F; q++) { const f = mkF(A, t, B, qT(t + tFly(A[2], B[2], (h.team !== sv.team ? 3.6 : 2.4) + q * .3))); if (fNet(f) >= NETOK) F = f; }
   if (!F) { walkTo(h, [VB.nx + side(h.team) * 30, h.y], t, 2.4, [sv.x, sv.y]); S.thr.at = t + 1.4; return; }
   h.hold = false; S.ev.push({ t, k: 'throw', j: h.j }); fly(S, F, sv.j, 'touch', 'throw', { k: 'catch', ev: 'catch', j: sv.j }); fixAt(sv, ph, F.t1, 2, F.t1 - .35, F.t1 + .05); S.thr = null; S.fetch = null; return; }
  if (!S.walk) { S.walk = 1; walkTo(sv, S.spot, t, 2.4, [VB.nx, VB.cy]); }
  if (sv.L || t < S.prepT) return;
  const ph = Math.atan2((VB.cy - sv.y) * .3, -sd), J = R() < .35 ? .3 + R() * .25 : 0, B = ballOn(sv.look, sv.x, sv.y, ph, 4, J), A = [b.x, b.y, b.z], t1 = qT(t + tFly(A[2], B[2], B[2] + .7 + R() * .6)), F = mkF(A, t, B, t1);
  sv.hold = false; S.ev.push({ t, k: 'toss', j: sv.j }); fly(S, F, sv.j, 'touch', 'toss', { k: 'serve', ev: 'serve', j: sv.j });

 function vbStep(S) { const E = S.E, b = S.B, t = S.t + DT;   
  if (b.mode === 'fly') { const F = S.F, p = t >= F.t1 - 1e-6 ? F.B : fAt(F, t); b.x = p[0]; b.y = p[1]; b.z = p[2]; b.roll += 2.2; }
  for (const e of E) legStep(e, t);
  for (let a = 0; a < 4; a += 2) { const A = E[a], B = E[a + 1], d = hyp(B.x - A.x, B.y - A.y); if (d < 6.5) { const m = A.ps || A.J ? B : B.ps || B.J ? A : B, o = m === A ? B : A; if (!(m.ps || m.J)) { const k = Math.min(1.2, 6.5 - d) / (d || 1); m.x += (m.x - o.x || .5) * k; m.y += (m.y - o.y) * k; if (m.L) { m.L.P1[0] += (m.x - o.x || .5) * k; m.L.P1[1] += (m.y - o.y) * k; } } } }   
  for (const e of E) { const sd = side(e.team); if ((e.x - VB.nx) * sd < 3) e.x = VB.nx + sd * 3; }   
  if (b.mode === 'fly' && t >= S.F.t1 - 1e-6) vbArrive(S, t);
  if (b.mode === 'held') { const e = E[b.held], p = ballOn(e.look, e.x, e.y, e.h, 2, e.jz); b.x = p[0]; b.y = p[1]; b.z = p[2]; }
  else if (b.mode === 'lift') { const L = S.lift, e = E[L.j], u = sm((t - L.t0) / .3), p = ballOn(e.look, e.x, e.y, e.h, 7, e.jz); b.x = lerp(L.A[0], p[0], u); b.y = lerp(L.A[1], p[1], u); b.z = lerp(L.A[2], p[2], u); if (t >= L.t0 + .5) { setMode(S, 'held', t); b.held = L.j; e.hold = true; S.lift = null; } }
  else if (b.mode === 'free') vbFree(S);
  if (S.st === 'prep') vbPrep(S, t);
  if (S.st === 'dead' && t - S.deadT > 1.6) { S.st = 'prep'; S.prepT = t + 2.5; S.spot = null; S.fetch = null; S.placed = false; S.walk = 0; S.thr = null; S.pick = null; if (S.score[0] >= 21 || S.score[1] >= 21) S.ev.push({ t, k: 'game', s: S.score.slice() }); } }
 
 const TOUCH = { serve: 1, pass: 1, dig: 1, set: 1, spike: 1, shot: 1, block: 1, catch: 1 };
 function vbTouchD(S, v, P) { const p = getP(S, v.j, v.t), bb = getB(S, v.t); if (!p || !bb) return 99; const e = S.E[v.j], k = poseK(p.act); if (!HT[k]) return 98; let H;

  return hyp(bb.x - H[0], (bb.y - (bb.z - BZ) * PZ - 1.3) - (H[1] - H[2] * PZ)); }
 
 function vbAirCheck(S) { let bad = 0, nf = 0; const modeAt = u => { let m = 'held'; for (const q of S.MD) { if (q[0] > u + 1e-6) break; m = q[1]; } return m; };
  for (let f = 0; f < S.fB; f++) { const u = f / 30, z = S.TB[f * 4 + 2]; if (z < .45) continue; nf++; const m = modeAt(u); if (m === 'held' || m === 'lift') continue; if (m !== 'fly' || !S.FL.some(F => F.t0 <= u + 1e-6 && F.t1 >= u - 1e-6)) bad++; }
  for (const F of S.FL) { if (F.kind !== 'sand') continue; const p0 = getP(S, F.j, F.t0), p1 = getP(S, F.j, F.t1); if (!p0 || !p1) continue; const d0 = hyp(p0.x - F.B[0], p0.y - F.B[1]), d1 = hyp(p1.x - F.B[0], p1.y - F.B[1]); if (!(d1 < d0 - 2 || d1 < 16)) bad++; }
  return { frames: nf, bad }; }
 function vbTouchCheck(n, useP34) { const P = useP34 !== false && typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.P34 : null, out = { sessions: 0, touches: 0, max: 0, sum: 0, over6: 0, byKind: {}, air: 0, airFrames: 0, pose: P && P.pose ? 'P34' : 'table', worst: null };
  for (let i = 0; i < (n || 4); i++) { const S = vbGen((i * 4099 + 7) | 0); simTo(S, S.dur); out.sessions++; for (const v of S.ev) { if (!TOUCH[v.k]) continue; const d = vbTouchD(S, v, P); out.touches++; out.sum += d; if (d > out.max) { out.max = d; out.worst = { s: i, k: v.k, t: +v.t.toFixed(2), d: +d.toFixed(2) }; } if (!(d < 6)) out.over6++; const B = out.byKind[v.k] || (out.byKind[v.k] = { n: 0, max: 0 }); B.n++; B.max = Math.max(B.max, +d.toFixed(2)); }
   const A = vbAirCheck(S); out.air += A.bad; out.airFrames += A.frames; }
  out.mean = out.touches ? +(out.sum / out.touches).toFixed(2) : 0; out.max = +out.max.toFixed(2); delete out.sum; out.ok = out.over6 === 0 && out.air === 0 && out.touches > 0; return out; }

 function auditSess(S, name, area) { const out = { name, frames: 0, bad: 0, why: [], overlap: 0, jumpP: 0, jumpB: 0, outArea: 0, post: 0, events: {} }; simTo(S, S.dur); const n = S.E.length, why = s => { out.bad++; if (out.why.length < 6) out.why.push(name + ': ' + s); };
  for (const v of S.ev) out.events[v.k] = (out.events[v.k] || 0) + 1;
  for (let f = 1; f < S.fP; f++) { const u = S.t0 + f / 15; out.frames++; for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) { const a = (f * n + j) * 6, p = a - n * 6, T = S.TP; if (T[a + 3] === 9) continue; if (!isFinite(T[a]) || !isFinite(T[a + 1])) { why('NaN #' + j + ' at ' + u.toFixed(1)); continue; }
    if (T[p + 3] !== 9 && hyp(T[a] - T[p], T[a + 1] - T[p + 1]) * 15 > 100) { out.jumpP++; why('player jump #' + j + ' at ' + u.toFixed(1)); }
    if (area && (T[a] < area[0] || T[a] > area[2] || T[a + 1] < area[1] || T[a + 1] > area[3])) { out.outArea++; why('out of area #' + j + ' at ' + u.toFixed(1)); }
    for (let q = j + 1; q < n; q++) { const c = (f * n + q) * 6; if (T[c + 3] === 9) continue; const d = hyp(T[a] - T[c], T[a + 1] - T[c + 1]); if (d < 4.2 && !(T[a + 3] === 2 || T[c + 3] === 2 || T[a + 3] === 3 || T[c + 3] === 3 || T[a + 3] >= 10 || T[c + 3] >= 10)) { out.overlap++; if (out.overlap < 3) why('overlap #' + j + '/#' + q + ' ' + d.toFixed(1) + ' at ' + u.toFixed(1)); } } } }
  for (let f = 1; f < S.fB; f++) { const a = f * 4, p = a - 4, T = S.TB; if (T[a + 2] === -99 || T[p + 2] === -99) continue; if (!isFinite(T[a])) { why('ball NaN'); continue; } if (hyp(T[a] - T[p], T[a + 1] - T[p + 1]) * 30 > 400) { out.jumpB++; why('ball jump at ' + (S.t0 + f / 30).toFixed(2)); }
   if (S.kind === 'match') for (const gx of [A3.x0, A3.x1]) for (const py of [A3.gy - A3.pw, A3.gy + A3.pw]) if (T[a + 2] < A3.cb && hyp(T[a] - gx, T[a + 1] - py) < 1.6) { out.post++; why('ball in post at ' + (S.t0 + f / 30).toFixed(2)); }
   if (S.kind === 'volley' && T[a + 1] > VB.posts[0] && T[a + 1] < VB.posts[1] && T[a + 2] < VB.top - .05 && T[a + 2] > .3 && (T[p] - VB.nx) * (T[a] - VB.nx) < 0) { out.post++; why('ball through the net at ' + (S.t0 + f / 30).toFixed(2)); }

  if (S.kind === 'volley') { out.touch = 0; out.touchMax = 0; for (const v of S.ev) { if (!TOUCH[v.k]) continue; const d = vbTouchD(S, v, null); out.touch++; out.touchMax = Math.max(out.touchMax, +d.toFixed(2)); if (!(d < 6)) why('touch ' + v.k + ' #' + v.j + ' ' + d.toFixed(1) + ' px at ' + v.t.toFixed(2)); }

  out.score = scoreAt(S, S.dur); return out; }

 const SH = .8;   
 function towerPose(i, p, t) {   
  const lv = i % 3, b = LT[i - lv], m = LT[i - lv + 1], x0 = p.x, y0 = p.y - lv * 9, z1 = b.h * SH, z2 = z1 + m.h * SH;
  if (lv === 0) return { x: x0, y: y0, z: 0, act: t > 1 && t < 4.9 ? 3 : 0 };
  const zT = lv === 1 ? z1 : z2, c0 = lv === 1 ? .2 : 1.1, c1 = c0 + .9, j0 = lv === 2 ? 3.7 : 4.3, j1 = j0 + .75, land = [x0 + (lv === 1 ? -9 : 9), y0 + 13];
  if (t < c0) return { x: x0, y: y0 + lv * 9, z: 0, act: 0 };
  if (t < c1) { const f = (t - c0) / (c1 - c0); return { x: x0, y: lerp(y0 + lv * 9, y0 + lv * .05, sm(f)), z: arc(0, zT, .35, f), act: 10 }; }
  if (t < j0) return { x: x0 + Math.sin(t * 1.7 + lv) * .25 * lv, y: y0 + lv * .05, z: zT, act: lv === 2 && t > c1 + .3 ? 10 : 4 };
  if (t < j1) { const f = (t - j0) / (j1 - j0); return { x: lerp(x0, land[0], f), y: lerp(y0 + lv * .05, land[1], f), z: arc(zT, 0, .5, f), act: 10 }; }
  if (t < j1 + 1) return { x: land[0], y: land[1], z: 0, act: t > j1 + .3 ? 7 : 0 };   
  const f = sm((t - j1 - 1) / .55); return { x: lerp(land[0], x0, f), y: lerp(land[1], y0 + lv * 9, f), z: 0, act: 0 }; }   
 function showTowers(ctx, Q, s, u, res) {

   if (t == null) { H.person(ctx, Q, { x: p.x, y: p.y, z: 0, h: p.h, act: p.mv ? 1 : 0, d: p.d }, LT[i], u, res, 0, null); continue; }
   if (i >= 9) { const k = ((t + (i - 9) * .27) % .9) / .9, up = t > .4 && t < 6.2; H.person(ctx, Q, { x: p.x, y: p.y, z: up ? arc(0, 0, .55, k) : 0, h: p.h, act: up && k > .15 && k < .85 ? 10 : 0, d: p.d }, LT[i], u, res, 0, null); continue; }   
   const q = towerPose(i, p, t), back = s > T_END - .4 && i % 3;   
   H.person(ctx, Q, { x: q.x, y: q.y + (i % 3) * .02, z: back ? 0 : q.z, h: p.h, act: q.act, d: p.d }, LT[i], u, res, 0, null); } }

   else{const R=RB2[h.node];for(const v of [...TRAFFIC_CARS,...BUS_VEHICLES]){const dd=Math.hypot(v.x-R.x,v.y-R.y);if(dd>R.Ro+8||dd<R.Ri-8)continue;const da=((Math.atan2(v.y-R.y,v.x-R.x)-h.a)%(2*Math.PI)+2*Math.PI)%(2*Math.PI);if(da<1.5||da>2*Math.PI-.3){wait=true;break}}}
   if(!wait&&h.kind==='rb'&&RB2[h.node]){const xw=rbFleetExitWait3(m,h);if(xw){wait=true;m.rbBy=xw;if((h.max||0)<45)h.max=45}}    
  }catch{}
  if(wait&&(m.holdT||0)<h.max){m.holdT=(m.holdT||0)+dt;m.holdKind=h.kind;if(h.kind!=='rev')m.priority=false;m.state={c:0,r:0,L:{lights:false}};return true}
  h.done=true;m.holdT=0}
 return false}
function a4FleetPathAudit(){const out={poses:0,hits:[],maxTurn:0};const L=parkedStepList();
 for(const name of ['fire','ems']){const cfg=A4_FLEET_CFG[name];for(const id of cfg.ids){const home=a4FleetParked(id);if(!home)continue;
  for(const [ph,route] of [['out',a4FleetOutbound(cfg,home)],['in',a4FleetInbound(cfg,home)]]){let ph0=null;
   for(let d=0;d<=route.total;d+=2){const p=a4FleetPose(route,d);out.poses++;if(ph0!=null){let dh=Math.abs(p.heading-ph0)%(2*Math.PI);if(dh>Math.PI)dh=2*Math.PI-dh;if(dh>out.maxTurn&&dh<3)out.maxTurn=+dh.toFixed(3)}ph0=p.heading;
    const me=vehicleCollisionShape(home.asset,home.ref||'Sedan',p.x,p.y,p.heading);
    for(const o of L){if(o.id===id||Math.abs(o.x-p.x)>200||Math.abs(o.y-p.y)>200)continue;const b=vehicleCollisionShape(o.asset,o.ref||'Sedan',o.x,o.y,o.heading||0);if(vehicleBodiesOverlap(me,b,1.2)){if(out.hits.length<20)out.hits.push(id+' '+ph+' d'+d+' @'+Math.round(p.x)+','+Math.round(p.y)+' × '+o.id);break}}}}}}
 const PH=[[1065,3424,0],[1105,3424,0],[700,3424,0],[1231,3060,-Math.PI/2],[1231,2860,-Math.PI/2]];for(const name of ['fire','ems']){const cfg=A4_FLEET_CFG[name];for(const id of cfg.ids){const home=a4FleetParked(id);if(!home)continue;const route=a4FleetOutbound(cfg,home);
  for(let d=0;d<=route.total;d+=2){const p=a4FleetPose(route,d);if(p.x<1100||p.y<3250)continue;const me=vehicleCollisionShape(home.asset,home.ref||'Sedan',p.x,p.y,p.heading);for(const [x,y,h] of PH){if(Math.abs(x-p.x)>200||Math.abs(y-p.y)>200)continue;if(vehicleBodiesOverlap(me,vehicleCollisionShape('VH-SD-02','Sedan',x,y,h),1.2)){if(out.hits.length<20)out.hits.push(id+' out d'+d+' @'+Math.round(p.x)+','+Math.round(p.y)+' × a car standing at '+x+','+y);break}}}}}
 out.ok=!out.hits.length;return out}
window.a4FleetPathAudit=a4FleetPathAudit;


function a4FleetRoadAudit(){const RD=EDGES.filter(e=>!e.future).map(e=>{const a=byNode[e.a],b=byNode[e.b],L=Math.hypot(b.x-a.x,b.y-a.y);return{id:e.id,a:e.a,b:e.b,ax:a.x,ay:a.y,ux:(b.x-a.x)/L,uy:(b.y-a.y)/L,L,h:roadType(e).width/2}});
 const half={};for(const r of RD){half[r.a]=Math.max(half[r.a]||0,r.h);half[r.b]=Math.max(half[r.b]||0,r.h)}
 const box=(x,y)=>{for(const id in half){const n=byNode[id];if(n&&Math.abs(x-n.x)<=half[id]+2&&Math.abs(y-n.y)<=half[id]+2&&!RB2[id])return id}return null};
 const apron=[];for(const name of ['fire','ems']){const B=A4_FLEET_BAYS.filter(b=>b.fleet===name);if(B.length)apron.push([Math.min(...B.map(b=>b.x)),Math.min(...B.map(b=>b.y))-30,1140,Math.max(...B.map(b=>b.y+b.h))+30])}
 const out={poses:0,off:[],wrong:[],apron:0,cross:0};
 const judge=(x,y,vx,vy)=>{if(apron.some(r=>x>=r[0]&&x<=r[2]&&y>=r[1]&&y<=r[3]))return'apron';
  for(const id in RB2){const R=RB2[id],d=Math.hypot(x-R.x,y-R.y);if(d<=R.Ro+2&&d>=R.Ri-2){const rx=(x-R.x)/d,ry=(y-R.y)/d;return(rx*vy-ry*vx)<.2?'ok':'wrong'}}
  if(box(x,y))return'ok';
  for(const r of RD){const px=x-r.ax,py=y-r.ay,t=px*r.ux+py*r.uy;if(t<0||t>r.L)continue;const lat=-px*r.uy+py*r.ux;if(Math.abs(lat)>r.h+1)continue;const sg=Math.sign(r.ux*vx+r.uy*vy)||1;if(lat*sg>=2)return'ok';const cs=Math.abs(r.ux*vx+r.uy*vy)/Math.hypot(vx,vy);return(cs<.82&&apron.some(q=>y>=q[1]-40&&y<=q[3]+40&&x<1265))?'cross':'wrong'}    
  return'off'};
 for(const name of ['fire','ems']){const cfg=A4_FLEET_CFG[name];for(const id of cfg.ids){const home=a4FleetParked(id);if(!home)continue;
  for(const [ph,route] of [['out',a4FleetOutbound(cfg,home)],['in',a4FleetInbound(cfg,home)]]){
   for(let d=0;d<=route.total;d+=2){const p=a4FleetPose(route,d),q=a4FleetPose(route,Math.min(route.total,d+1.5)),rv=route.rev!=null&&p.segment>=route.rev?-1:1,vx=(q.x-p.x)*rv,vy=(q.y-p.y)*rv;    if(Math.hypot(vx,vy)<.01)continue;out.poses++;const j=judge(p.x,p.y,vx,vy);
    if(j==='apron')out.apron++;else if(j==='cross')out.cross++;else if(j==='off'){if(out.off.length<12)out.off.push(id+' '+ph+' d'+d+' @'+Math.round(p.x)+','+Math.round(p.y))}else if(j==='wrong'){if(out.wrong.length<12)out.wrong.push(id+' '+ph+' d'+d+' @'+Math.round(p.x)+','+Math.round(p.y))}}}}}
 out.ok=!out.off.length&&!out.wrong.length;return out}
window.a4FleetRoadAudit=a4FleetRoadAudit;

 
var A4RB={max:90,soft:25,waits:0,maxWait:0,forced:0,yields:0,leads:0,breakT:0,breaks:0,followT:0};
 
 
function a4FleetRbPrep(m){m.route.rbPrep=1;const hl=a4FleetHl(m);
 for(const h of m.route.holds){if(h.kind!=='rb'||!RB2[h.node]||h.rbShift!=null)continue;a4FleetRbGeom(m.route,h);const sh=Math.max(0,Math.min(h.d,hl-4));h.rbShift=sh;h.d-=sh}}
function a4FleetRbFollow(m){if(m.a5h||m.phase!=='inbound'||!m.route||!(m.kind==='fire'||m.kind==='ambulance'))return null;let near=false;
 for(const id of ['J12_25','J12_42']){const R=RB2[id];if(R&&Math.hypot(m.x-R.x,m.y-R.y)<R.Ro+30){near=true;break}}if(!near)return null;
 const hl=a4FleetHl(m),cand=[...TRAFFIC_CARS,...BUS_VEHICLES].filter(v=>Math.abs(v.x-m.x)<170&&Math.abs(v.y-m.y)<170);if(!cand.length)return null;
 for(let s=hl+4;s<=hl+100;s+=4){const p=a4FleetPose(m.route,Math.min(m.route.total,m.d+s));for(const v of cand){const vh=(v.c2&&v.c2.hl)||22;if(Math.hypot(v.x-p.x,v.y-p.y)<13&&s-hl-vh<40)return v.id}if(m.d+s>=m.route.total)break}
 return null}

function a4FleetHl(m){if(!m.hl){try{m.hl=vehicleCollisionShape(m.asset,m.ref||'Sedan',0,0,0).halfLength||30}catch(e){m.hl=30}}return m.hl}
function a4FleetRbGeom(route,h){if(h.rbIn!=null)return h;const R=RB2[h.node];let dIn=null,dOut=null;const end=Math.min(route.total,h.d+1800);
 for(let d=h.d;d<=end;d+=2){const p=a4FleetPose(route,d),r=Math.hypot(p.x-R.x,p.y-R.y);if(Math.abs(r-R.Rc)<3){if(dIn==null)dIn=d;dOut=d}else if(dIn!=null&&r>R.Rc+3)break}
 if(dIn==null){dIn=h.d;dOut=h.d}const pi=a4FleetPose(route,dIn),po=a4FleetPose(route,dOut);
 h.rbIn=dIn;h.rbOut=dOut;h.thIn=Math.atan2(pi.y-R.y,pi.x-R.x);h.thOut=Math.atan2(po.y-R.y,po.x-R.x);h.rbD=(dOut-dIn)/R.Rc;return h}
 
function a4FleetRingInfo(id){const out=[];if(typeof A4_FLEET_STATE==='undefined')return out;
 for(const name of ['fire','ems']){const st=A4_FLEET_STATE[name],m=st&&st.active;if(!m||m.offsite||m.scene||m.a5h||m.phase!=='inbound'||!m.route||!m.route.holds)continue;
  for(const h of m.route.holds){if(h.kind!=='rb'||h.node!==id||!RB2[id])continue;a4FleetRbGeom(m.route,h);if(m.d<h.d-1||m.d>h.rbOut+80)continue;if(!h.done&&m.d<=h.d+.5)break;
   const R=RB2[id],hl=a4FleetHl(m),sp=((m.holdT||0)>0||(m.blocked||0)>0||(m.waitFleet||0)>0)?0:(m.speed||0);
   if(m.d<h.rbIn)out.push({id:m.id,th:h.thIn,pre:h.rbIn-m.d,post:0,rem:h.rbD,hl,speed:sp});
   else if(m.d<=h.rbOut)out.push({id:m.id,th:Math.atan2(m.y-R.y,m.x-R.x),pre:0,post:0,rem:Math.max(0,h.rbD-(m.d-h.rbIn)/R.Rc),hl,speed:sp});
   else if(m.d-h.rbOut<hl+4)out.push({id:m.id,th:h.thOut,pre:0,post:m.d-h.rbOut,rem:0,hl,speed:sp});
   break}}
 return out}
 
function a4FleetRbWait(m,h,dt){const R=RB2[h.node],node=NODES2.get(h.node),cfg=node&&node.rb;if(!R)return null;if(!h.rbMax){h.rbMax=1;h.max=Math.max(h.max||0,A4RB.max)}a4FleetRbGeom(m.route,h);
 const late=(m.holdT||0)>=A4RB.soft,a0=h.thIn,hl=a4FleetHl(m),pre=Math.max(0,h.rbIn-m.d),win=(cfg?cfg.win:110)+pre*.5,seen=new Set();let by=null;
 if(node)for(const o of node.inside){if(o.remote||o.ghost||o.standing)continue;const v=o.v,c=v&&v.c2;if(!c)continue;seen.add(v.id);let th,pr=0,post=0,rem;
  if(c.mv&&c.mv.rb&&c.mv.node===node.id){const q=rbTheta2(c);th=q.th;pr=q.pre;post=q.post;rem=q.phase===0?c.mv.rb.D:q.phase===1?q.th-c.mv.rb.a1:0}
  else{const m2=(c.next&&c.next.rb&&c.next.node===node.id)?c.next:(c.gate&&c.gate.mv&&c.gate.mv.rb&&c.gate.node===node.id?c.gate.mv:null);if(!m2||!c.lane||c.lane!==m2.from)continue;th=m2.rb.a0;pr=m2.rb.Le+Math.max(0,m2.sStart-c.s);rem=m2.rb.D}
  const up=rbMod2(th-a0);if(up<=rem+.02&&up*R.Rc+pr<(late?hl+c.hl+40:win+(v.speed||0)*1.1)){by=v.id;break}
  const dn=rbMod2(a0-th)*R.Rc;if(pr<1&&dn<c.hl+hl+14-post){by=v.id;break}}
 if(!by){const A=late?.6:1.5;for(const v of [...TRAFFIC_CARS,...BUS_VEHICLES]){if(seen.has(v.id))continue;const dd=Math.hypot(v.x-R.x,v.y-R.y);if(dd>R.Ro+8||dd<R.Ri-8)continue;const da=rbMod2(Math.atan2(v.y-R.y,v.x-R.x)-h.a);if(da<A||da>2*Math.PI-.3){by=v.id;break}}}
 if(!by)for(const F of a4FleetActors()){if(F===m)continue;const dd=Math.hypot(F.x-R.x,F.y-R.y);if(dd>R.Ro+8||dd<R.Ri-8)continue;const da=rbMod2(Math.atan2(F.y-R.y,F.x-R.x)-h.a);if(da<1.5||da>2*Math.PI-.3){by=F.id;break}}
 if(by){A4RB.waits+=dt;A4RB.maxWait=Math.max(A4RB.maxWait,(m.holdT||0)+dt);if((m.holdT||0)+dt>=h.max)A4RB.forced++}
 return by}
 
function a4FleetRbYield(v,mv,node){const R=mv.rb,cfg=node.rb;if(!R||!cfg||!v.c2)return null;
 for(const I of a4FleetRingInfo(node.id)){const up=rbMod2(I.th-R.a0);if(up<=I.rem+.02&&up*R.Rc+I.pre<cfg.win+(I.speed||0)*1.1){A4RB.yields++;return'rb-yield'}
  const dn=rbMod2(R.a0-I.th)*R.Rc;if(I.pre<1&&dn<I.hl+v.c2.hl+14-I.post){A4RB.yields++;return'rb-yield'}}
 return null}
 
function a4FleetRbLead(v,c,R,node,me,myRem,consider){
 for(const I of a4FleetRingInfo(node.id)){if(I.pre>I.hl+8||I.post>I.hl+4)continue;const ah=rbMod2(me.th-I.th);if(ah>Math.min(Math.PI,myRem+.3))continue;if(ah<.02&&me.phase===1&&I.pre>0)continue;
  const gap=me.pre+ah*R.Rc-I.pre-c.hl-(I.post>0?I.hl-I.post:I.hl)-4;A4RB.leads++;consider(gap,{v:null,id:I.id,speed:I.speed||0,kind:'fleet'})}}
 
function a4FleetRbBreak(m,dt,hit){if(!(m.a5h||m.kind==='fire'||m.kind==='ambulance')||(m.blocked||0)<=1)return false;    let near=false;
 for(const id of ['J12_25','J12_42']){const R=RB2[id];if(R&&Math.hypot(m.x-R.x,m.y-R.y)<R.Ro+60){near=true;break}}if(!near)return false;

 const L=String(c.limitLead||''),mine=c.hardBy===m.id||L===m.id||L===m.id+'+';if(!mine)return false;

 m.waitFleet=3;m.blocked=Math.max(m.blocked||0,A4_UNJAM_T+.5);A4RB.breaks++;    try{SaveManager.log('a4_fleet','ring_break',{vehicle:m.sourceId,by:hit,x:Math.round(m.x),y:Math.round(m.y)})}catch{}return true}

function addPedEdge(a,b,type='sidewalk',crosswalkId=null){
 const k=[a,b].sort().join('|')+'|'+type;if(PED_EDGE_KEYS.has(k))return null;PED_EDGE_KEYS.add(k);

function buildPedGraph(){

   addPedEdge(A.id,B.id,'sidewalk');(junctionEnds[e.a]??=[]).push(A.id);(junctionEnds[e.b]??=[]).push(B.id)}
 }

function updateNPCPedestrians(dt){for(const n of NPC_PEDESTRIANS){

 if(crossing&&!n.inCrosswalk)n.inCrosswalk=edge.crosswalkId;

 if(hit){n.pose='idle';n.wait=true;n.blockT=(n.blockT||0)+dt;if(n.blockT>1.1){n.ghost=.8;n.blockT=0}continue}

function trafficLaneCenterOffset(cls,lane=0,dir=1){if(cls==='oneway5')return 0;if(cls==='oneway2')return clamp(Number(lane)||0,0,1)?SCALE.lane/2:-SCALE.lane/2;    if(cls==='main0')return SCALE.mainLane/2+SCALE.mainLane*clamp(Number(lane)||0,0,2);    if(cls==='art21')return dir<0?31:(clamp(Number(lane)||0,0,1)?39:4);    return cls==='track'?11:cls==='main'?SCALE.mainMedian/2+SCALE.mainLane/2+SCALE.mainLane*clamp(Number(lane)||0,0,2):cls==='arterial'?SCALE.median/2+SCALE.lane/2+SCALE.lane*clamp(Number(lane)||0,0,1):SCALE.lane/2}
function trafficPreferredLane(car,e){
 if(e&&e.cls==='oneway2'){if(car?.kind==='bus')return 1;const id=String(car?.id||'0');let h=3;for(let i=0;i<id.length;i++)h=(h*29+id.charCodeAt(i))>>>0;return h%2}    
 if(e&&e.cls==='main0'){if(car?.kind==='bus')return 2;const id=String(car?.id||'0');let h=5;for(let i=0;i<id.length;i++)h=(h*37+id.charCodeAt(i))>>>0;return h%3}    
 if(e&&e.cls==='main'){if(car?.kind==='bus')return 2;if(!Number.isFinite(car?.lanePref3)){const id=String(car?.id||'0');let h=7;for(let i=0;i<id.length;i++)h=(h*37+id.charCodeAt(i))>>>0;if(car)car.lanePref3=h%3;return h%3}return car.lanePref3}    
 if(!e||e.cls!=='arterial')return 0;
 if(car?.kind==='bus')return 1;
 if(Number.isFinite(car?.lanePref))return clamp(Math.round(car.lanePref),0,1);
 const id=String(car?.id||'0');let h=0;for(let i=0;i<id.length;i++)h=(h*31+id.charCodeAt(i))>>>0;
 car.lanePref=h%2;return car.lanePref
}
function trafficEdgePoint(edgeId,dirSign,t,lane=0){
 const e=byEdge[edgeId],a=byNode[e.a],b=byNode[e.b],dx=b.x-a.x,dy=b.y-a.y,len=Math.hypot(dx,dy),ux=dx/len,uy=dy/len,nx=-uy,ny=ux;
 const off=trafficLaneCenterOffset(e.cls,lane,dirSign),sg=dirSign>0?1:-1;
 const q=dirSign>0?t:1-t;
 return{x:a.x+dx*q+nx*off*sg,y:a.y+dy*q+ny*off*sg,heading:Math.atan2(uy*dirSign,ux*dirSign)}
}
function shuffled(a){a=[...a];for(let i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[a[i],a[j]]=[a[j],a[i]]}return a}

const TAXI_HAIL_DIST=150,TAXI_BOARD_DIST=105,TAXI_BASE_FARE=12,TAXI_METER_RATE=.12,TAXI_PICKUP_MAX_MS=30000,TAXI_PICKUP_FORCE_MS=28500;
function nearestRoadPosition(x,y,edgeOk=null){
 let best=null;
 for(const e of EDGES){if(edgeOk&&!edgeOk(e))continue;const a=byNode[e.a],b=byNode[e.b],dx=b.x-a.x,dy=b.y-a.y,l2=dx*dx+dy*dy;if(l2<1)continue;const u=clamp(((x-a.x)*dx+(y-a.y)*dy)/l2,0,1),px=a.x+dx*u,py=a.y+dy*u,d=Math.hypot(x-px,y-py);if(!best||d<best.d)best={edge:e,u,x:px,y:py,d}}
 return best
}
function taxiPathPx(ids){let d=0;for(let i=1;i<ids.length;i++){const a=byNode[ids[i-1]],b=byNode[ids[i]];if(a&&b)d+=Math.hypot(a.x-b.x,a.y-b.y)}return d}
function taxiFinalClamp(edgeId,dir,t){try{const ln=lane2(edgeId,dir,0);if(!ln)return t;const lo=(ln.boxFrom+34)/ln.len,hi=(Math.min(ln.stopS,ln.len)-34)/ln.len;return hi>lo?clamp(t,lo,hi):t}catch{return t}}    
function taxiApproach(car,x,y){
 const pubRoad=e=>!pgRestrictedEdge(e)&&!e.future&&!e.freightOnly&&!e.oneway;    const pos=nearestRoadPosition(x,y,pubRoad);if(!pos)return null;
 const e=byEdge[car.edgeId],forward=car.dirSign>0?e.b:e.a,targetEdge=pos.edge;
 const sameTravelT=car.dirSign>0?pos.u:1-pos.u;
 if(car.edgeId===targetEdge.id&&sameTravelT>car.t+.05)return{nodes:[forward],pos:0,entryNode:forward,finalEdgeId:car.edgeId,finalDirSign:car.dirSign,finalT:taxiFinalClamp(car.edgeId,car.dirSign,sameTravelT),finalActive:true,targetX:x,targetY:y};
 const pA=shortestNodePath(forward,targetEdge.a,pubRoad),pB=shortestNodePath(forward,targetEdge.b,pubRoad),dA=pA.length?taxiPathPx(pA):Infinity,dB=pB.length?taxiPathPx(pB):Infinity;
 const fromA=dA<=dB,nodes=(fromA?pA:pB);if(!nodes.length)return null;
 return{nodes,pos:0,entryNode:fromA?targetEdge.a:targetEdge.b,finalEdgeId:targetEdge.id,finalDirSign:fromA?1:-1,finalT:taxiFinalClamp(targetEdge.id,fromA?1:-1,fromA?pos.u:1-pos.u),finalActive:false,targetX:x,targetY:y}
}

function taxiAvailable(v){return v?.kind==='taxi'&&!v.taxiRoute&&!v.turn}
function nearestHailableTaxi(maxDist=TAXI_HAIL_DIST){

 return best
}

function forceTaxiPickupArrival(car){

function startTaxiPassengerRide(destId,mode='watch'){
 const ride=State.taxiRide,car=ride&&taxiCarById(ride.taxiId),poi=navPoiRegistry()[destId];if(!ride||ride.phase!=='waiting'||!car||!poi)return toast('המונית עדיין לא מוכנה לנסיעה');

}
function placeTaxiAtDestination(car,poi){

}
function skipTaxiRideToDestination(){

}
function completeTaxiRide(skipped=false){
 const ride=State.taxiRide;if(!ride||ride.phase!=='riding')return false;const car=taxiCarById(ride.taxiId),poi=navPoiRegistry()[ride.destId];if(!car||!poi)return false;

}
function cancelTaxiService(){

}

function pointSegmentDistanceSq(px,py,ax,ay,bx,by){const dx=bx-ax,dy=by-ay,l2=dx*dx+dy*dy;if(l2<1e-8){const x=px-ax,y=py-ay;return x*x+y*y}const t=clamp(((px-ax)*dx+(py-ay)*dy)/l2,0,1),x=ax+t*dx-px,y=ay+t*dy-py;return x*x+y*y}
function orient2d(ax,ay,bx,by,cx,cy){return(bx-ax)*(cy-ay)-(by-ay)*(cx-ax)}
function segmentsIntersect2d(a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h){const o1=orient2d(a,b,c,d,e,f),o2=orient2d(a,b,c,d,g,h),o3=orient2d(e,f,g,h,a,b),o4=orient2d(e,f,g,h,c,d);return((o1>0&&o2<0)||(o1<0&&o2>0))&&((o3>0&&o4<0)||(o3<0&&o4>0))}
function segmentDistanceSq(a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h){if(segmentsIntersect2d(a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h))return 0;return Math.min(pointSegmentDistanceSq(a,b,e,f,g,h),pointSegmentDistanceSq(c,d,e,f,g,h),pointSegmentDistanceSq(e,f,a,b,c,d),pointSegmentDistanceSq(g,h,a,b,c,d))}
function vehicleBodiesOverlap(a,b,pad=1.2){const rr=a.radius+b.radius+pad;return segmentDistanceSq(a.ax,a.ay,a.bx,a.by,b.ax,b.ay,b.bx,b.by)<rr*rr}
function pointHitsVehicleBody(px,py,r,b,pad=0){const rr=b.radius+r+pad;return pointSegmentDistanceSq(px,py,b.ax,b.ay,b.bx,b.by)<rr*rr}
