  const K = .6, PXM = 10, TAU = Math.PI * 2, D2R = Math.PI / 180;
  
  
  
  
  
  const shade = (hex, k) => { const n = parseInt(hex.slice(1), 16), f = v => Math.max(0, Math.min(255, Math.round(v * k))); return 'rgb(' + f(n >> 16) + ',' + f((n >> 8) & 255) + ',' + f(n & 255) + ')' };
  const P = (x, y, p) => [x + p[0] * S * PXM, y + (p[1] - K * p[2]) * S * PXM];   
  function rng(seed) { let a = seed >>> 0; return () => { a = (a + 0x6D2B79F5) >>> 0; let t = a; t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1); t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61); return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296 } }

  
  function reelSide(c, kind, x, y, k) {   
    if (kind === 'none') return;
    const big = { open: 1, spin: 1.25, free: 1.45, surf: 1.9 }[kind] || 1, r = 2.4 * k * big, stem = 2.4 * k * big;
    c.save(); c.translate(x, y);
    c.fillStyle = '#9aa3ab'; c.fillRect(-1.6 * k, 0, 3.2 * k, .5 * k);                      
    c.fillStyle = '#5b6168'; c.fillRect(-.5 * k, 0, 1 * k, stem);                            
    c.fillStyle = kind === 'surf' ? '#2a2f35' : kind === 'free' ? '#3a3d33' : '#30353b';
    c.beginPath(); c.ellipse(0, stem + r, r * 1.05, r, 0, 0, TAU); c.fill();

    c.fillStyle = '#e7ebee'; c.fillRect(-r - sl - .6 * k, stem + r * .35, sl, r * .35);

  function rodSide(c, rod, x0, y0, ppm, o) {

    if (rod.reel !== 'none') { c.beginPath(); c.moveTo(x0 - rs - 4 * k, y0 + w0 + 4 * k); c.lineTo(X(1), Y(1)); c.stroke() }
    c.fillStyle = '#c9b26a'; c.beginPath(); c.arc(X(1), Y(1), Math.max(mn * 1.1, w1), 0, TAU); c.fill();   
    if (rod.kind === 'bottom') { const bx = X(.93), by = Y(.93); c.fillStyle = '#d4a62a'; for (const d of [-4, 4]) { c.beginPath(); c.arc(bx + d * k, by - 4 * k, 2.6 * k, 0, TAU); c.fill() } c.fillStyle = '#7a5a12'; c.fillRect(bx - mn * .8, by - 4 * k, mn * 1.6, 4 * k) }
    c.restore();
    return { tipX: X(1), tipY: Y(1), reelX: x0 - rs };
  }

  
  
  const A = {
    hold: [[.30, .12, -.94], [.90, -.20, .38], [.25, .10, -.96], [.80, -.55, .20]], back: [[.05, .25, .96], [-.35, -.05, .94], [.45, .15, 0], [.85, -.45, .25]],
    fwd: [[.75, .15, .62], [.97, -.05, .2], [.45, .12, -.4], [.9, -.35, .2]], strike: [[.3, .15, .45], [.35, -.1, .93], [.35, .12, -.8], [.8, -.45, .4]],
    reelA: [[.35, .12, -.85], [.9, -.2, .4], [.3, .15, -.9], [.75, -.5, .45]], reelB: [[.35, .12, -.85], [.9, -.2, .4], [.3, .15, -.9], [.75, -.55, -.05]],
    lift: [[.35, .18, .55], [.25, -.1, .97], [.3, .12, -.6], [.7, -.6, .4]], fish: [[.03, .1, -1], [.25, .05, -.97], [.5, .15, -.8], [.95, -.15, .25]],
    down: [[.03, .07, -1], [.1, .03, -1], [.03, .07, -1], [.1, .03, -1]], pole: [[.35, .12, -.9], [.85, -.25, .45], [.1, .12, -.99], [.55, -.3, -.4]],
    poleUp: [[.35, .15, .2], [.4, -.15, .9], [.3, .12, -.85], [.75, -.3, .55]], two: [[.3, .15, .5], [.3, -.15, .9], [.35, .1, -.2], [.85, -.45, .1]] };
  
  const F = {
    pole:   [['pole', 22, .04], ['poleUp', 60, .05], ['fwd', 14, .03], ['pole', 30, .38], ['pole', 40, .45], ['poleUp', 52, .5], ['poleUp', 74, .55], ['fish', 8, 0]],
    float:  [['hold', 18, .03], ['back', 62, .06, 0, 1], ['fwd', 28, .04], ['strike', 50, .32], ['reelA', 34, .42], ['reelB', 36, .44], ['lift', 68, .5], ['fish', 6, 0]],
    spin:   [['reelA', 10, .07], ['back', 55, .08, 0, 1], ['fwd', 24, .05], ['strike', 46, .36], ['reelA', 30, .46], ['reelB', 32, .48], ['lift', 64, .52], ['fish', 6, 0]],
    bottom: [['down', 26, .04, 1], ['back', 58, .07, 0, 1], ['fwd', 30, .05], ['down', 26, .3, 1], ['reelA', 40, .46], ['reelB', 42, .48], ['lift', 70, .55], ['fish', 6, 0]],
    surf:   [['down', 58, .06, 1], ['two', 40, .1, 0, 1], ['fwd', 34, .06], ['down', 58, .3, 1], ['two', 52, .55], ['reelB', 40, .5], ['lift', 66, .6], ['fish', 8, 0]] };
  const KINDS = ['pole', 'float', 'spin', 'bottom', 'surf'], kindOf = rod => 'f' + (KINDS.indexOf(rod.kind) + 1);
  
  function armsFor(k, fr, right) { const kind = KINDS[+k.slice(1) - 1], f = F[kind] && F[kind][fr | 0]; const a = A[(f && f[0]) || 'hold']; return right ? [a[0], a[1]] : [a[2], a[3]] }
  const dirOf = h => ((Math.round(h / (Math.PI / 4)) % 8) + 8) % 8;
  
  function rodWorld(g, rod, x, y, h, fr, look, o) { sync();
    o = o || {}; const f = F[rod.kind][fr | 0], bend = (o.bend != null ? o.bend : f[2]), onRest = !!f[3], back = !!f[4], res = o.res || 1, hl = rod.handle[0];
    let el = f[1] * D2R, az = h + (back ? Math.PI * .92 : .12), u, root, butt, Lr;
    if (onRest) { const R = restGeo(rod, h);   
      if (rod.kind === 'surf') { u = unit(R.top, R.cup); butt = R.cup; root = along(R.cup, u, .55); Lr = rod.len - .55 }
      else { u = unit(R.front, R.back); root = along(R.back, u, .12); butt = along(R.back, u, -hl * .5); Lr = rod.len - hl * .5 - .12 }
      el = Math.asin(u[2]); az = Math.atan2(u[1], u[0]) }
    else { u = [Math.cos(az) * Math.cos(el), Math.sin(az) * Math.cos(el), Math.sin(el)];
      let hand = [Math.cos(h) * .35, Math.sin(h) * .35, 1.0]; try { const Sx = P34.pose(look, { k: kindOf(rod) }, dirOf(h), fr | 0); const r = Sx.arms.find(a => a.side < 0); if (r) hand = r.hand } catch (e) { }
      root = hand; const k_ = rod.kind === 'spin' ? .55 : .75; Lr = rod.len - hl * k_;
      butt = [root[0] - u[0] * hl * k_, root[1] - u[1] * hl * k_, Math.max(.03, root[2] - u[2] * hl * .75)] }
    const dx = Math.cos(az), dy = Math.sin(az);
    const tip0 = [root[0] + u[0] * Lr, root[1] + u[1] * Lr, root[2] + u[2] * Lr], drop = bend * Lr * .42;
    const tip = [tip0[0] + dx * drop * Math.sin(el) * .35, tip0[1] + dy * drop * Math.sin(el) * .35, tip0[2] - drop * Math.cos(el * .6)];
    const mid = [(root[0] + tip0[0]) / 2, (root[1] + tip0[1]) / 2, (root[2] + tip0[2]) / 2 - drop * .18];
    
    const Pb = P(x, y, butt), Pr = P(x, y, root), Pm = P(x, y, mid), Pt = P(x, y, tip), q = (a, b, c2, t) => [(1 - t) * (1 - t) * a[0] + 2 * (1 - t) * t * b[0] + t * t * c2[0], (1 - t) * (1 - t) * a[1] + 2 * (1 - t) * t * b[1] + t * t * c2[1]];
    const minW = .8 / res, wB = Math.max(minW * 1.5, rod.dia[0] / 1000 * S * PXM * 2.6), wT = Math.max(minW, rod.dia[1] / 1000 * S * PXM * 2);   
    g.save(); g.lineCap = 'round';
    g.strokeStyle = rod.handle[1]; g.lineWidth = Math.max(minW * 2, wB * 1.7); g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(Pb[0], Pb[1]); g.lineTo(Pr[0], Pr[1]); g.stroke();
    const n = 10; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const a = q(Pr, Pm, Pt, i / n), b = q(Pr, Pm, Pt, (i + 1) / n), t = (i + .5) / n;
      g.strokeStyle = t > .88 ? rod.tip : rod.blank; g.lineWidth = wB + (wT - wB) * t; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(a[0], a[1]); g.lineTo(b[0], b[1]); g.stroke() }
    if (rod.reel !== 'none') { const rr = { open: .045, spin: .055, free: .065, surf: .085 }[rod.reel] * S * PXM, rp = P(x, y, [root[0], root[1], root[2] - .07]), mr = { open: 1.1, spin: 1.3, free: 1.5, surf: 1.9 }[rod.reel] / res;   
      g.fillStyle = '#2f343a'; g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(rp[0], rp[1], Math.max(rr, mr), Math.max(rr * .8, mr * .8), 0, 0, TAU); g.fill(); g.fillStyle = '#c3cad1'; g.beginPath(); g.arc(rp[0] - Math.max(rr, mr) * .3, rp[1] - Math.max(rr, mr) * .2, Math.max(rr, mr) * .38, 0, TAU); g.fill() }
    if (res >= 4 && rod.guides) for (let i = 1; i <= rod.guides; i++) { const p = q(Pr, Pm, Pt, Math.pow(i / (rod.guides + 1), .8)); g.fillStyle = '#c3cad1'; g.beginPath(); g.arc(p[0], p[1] + wB * .6, .5 / res * 1.4, 0, TAU); g.fill() }
    if (rod.kind === 'bottom') { const b = q(Pr, Pm, Pt, .94), ring = o.bell ? Math.sin(o.t * 40) * .25 : 0; g.fillStyle = '#e8b52a'; g.beginPath(); g.arc(b[0] + ring, b[1] - .25, Math.max(.4, 1.5 / res), 0, TAU); g.fill(); g.strokeStyle = '#7a5a12'; g.lineWidth = .4 / res; g.stroke() }
    
    if (o.line) { const [wx, wy] = o.line, sl = o.slack != null ? o.slack : (bend > .2 ? 0 : .5); g.strokeStyle = o.night ? 'rgba(220,235,255,.5)' : 'rgba(240,248,255,.78)'; g.lineWidth = Math.max(.5 / res, .12);
      g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(Pt[0], Pt[1]); g.quadraticCurveTo((Pt[0] + wx) / 2, (Pt[1] + wy) / 2 + sl * Math.min(6, Math.hypot(wx - Pt[0], wy - Pt[1]) * .06), wx, wy); g.stroke() }
    g.restore();
    return { tip: Pt, root: Pr, butt: Pb };
  }
  
  const unit = (a, b) => { const v = [a[0] - b[0], a[1] - b[1], a[2] - b[2]], n = Math.hypot(v[0], v[1], v[2]) || 1; return [v[0] / n, v[1] / n, v[2] / n] }, along = (p, u, d) => [p[0] + u[0] * d, p[1] + u[1] * d, p[2] + u[2] * d];
  function restGeo(rod, h) { const fx = Math.cos(h), fy = Math.sin(h), lx = -Math.sin(h), ly = Math.cos(h), s = -.3, at = (f, z) => [fx * f + lx * s, fy * f + ly * s, z];
    return rod.kind === 'surf' ? { top: at(.55, 1.25), cup: at(-.05, .1), feet: [at(.9, 0), [fx * .35 + lx * (s - .3), fy * .35 + ly * (s - .3), 0], [fx * .35 + lx * (s + .3), fy * .35 + ly * (s + .3), 0]] } : { front: at(.8, .5), back: at(-.1, .3) } }
  function rest(g, rod, x, y, h, res) { sync(); if (rod.kind !== 'bottom' && rod.kind !== 'surf') return; const R = restGeo(rod, h), minW = .8 / res, lw = Math.max(minW * 1.4, .28); g.save(); g.lineCap = 'round';
    if (rod.kind === 'surf') { const top = P(x, y, R.top); g.strokeStyle = '#a7b0b8'; g.lineWidth = lw; for (const f of R.feet) { const p = P(x, y, f); g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(p[0], p[1]); g.lineTo(top[0], top[1]); g.stroke() }
      g.strokeStyle = '#5b6168'; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(top[0] - 1, top[1] - .7); g.lineTo(top[0], top[1] + .2); g.lineTo(top[0] + 1, top[1] - .7); g.stroke();
      const c0 = P(x, y, R.cup), c1 = P(x, y, [R.cup[0], R.cup[1], 0]); g.strokeStyle = '#a7b0b8'; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(c1[0], c1[1]); g.lineTo(top[0], top[1]); g.stroke(); g.fillStyle = '#4a5056'; g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(c0[0], c0[1], Math.max(.5, 1.1 / res), Math.max(.3, .7 / res), 0, 0, TAU); g.fill() }
    else for (const at of [R.front, R.back]) { const s0 = P(x, y, [at[0], at[1], 0]), s1 = P(x, y, at); g.strokeStyle = '#5a4630'; g.lineWidth = lw; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(s0[0], s0[1]); g.lineTo(s1[0], s1[1] + .3); g.stroke(); g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(s1[0] - .8, s1[1] - .5); g.lineTo(s1[0], s1[1] + .3); g.lineTo(s1[0] + .8, s1[1] - .5); g.stroke();
      g.fillStyle = 'rgba(10,14,20,.25)'; g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(s0[0] + .4, s0[1] + .2, .7, .3, 0, 0, TAU); g.fill() }
    g.restore() }
  
  function float(g, x, y, t, bite, night, res) { sync(); const r = Math.max(.55, 1.1 / res), dip = bite ? (Math.sin(t * 9) > 0 ? .9 : 0) : Math.sin(t * 2.2) * .45;   
    g.save(); g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (bite ? .55 : .3) + ')'; g.lineWidth = Math.max(.12, .5 / res); const rr = (bite ? 2.2 : 1.4) + Math.sin(t * 3) * .7;
    g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(x, y + .3, rr * 1.6, rr * .6, 0, 0, TAU); g.stroke();
    if (dip < .8) { g.fillStyle = '#f2f0ea'; g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(x, y + dip, r * .55, r * .4, 0, 0, TAU); g.fill(); g.fillStyle = night ? '#ffe34d' : '#e2372b'; g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(x, y - r * .5 + dip, r * .3, r * .55, 0, 0, TAU); g.fill();
      if (night) { const q = g.createRadialGradient(x, y - r * .5, 0, x, y - r * .5, r * 3.5); q.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,240,120,.55)'); q.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,240,120,0)'); g.fillStyle = q; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y - r * .5, r * 3.5, 0, TAU); g.fill() } }
    g.restore() }
  
  
  const FZ = [.6, .85, 1, 1.35];   
  function fishAt(g, id, cm, mx, my, ang, ppc, si, v, t) { sync(); if (typeof TurboCity === 'undefined' || !TurboCity.get(id)) return; const sp = LAKE_FISH.concat(COAST_FISH).find(q => q.id === id); if (!sp) return;
    const sz = si == null ? 2 : si, scale = ppc * cm / (sp.base * FZ[sz]), I = TurboCity.info(id, { scale }), c = I.an.find(a => a[0] === 'Center') || ['C', I.w / 2, I.h / 2];
    g.save(); g.translate(mx, my); g.rotate(ang); TurboCity.draw(g, id, -cm * ppc / 2 - c[1], -c[2], { mode: 'runtime', scale, v: v == null ? 3 : v, sz, time: t || 0 }); g.restore() }
  function fish(g, id, cm, x, y, ang, ppc, top, si, v) { const Ld = cm * ppc; return fishAt(g, id, cm, x + Math.cos(ang) * Ld / 2, y + Math.sin(ang) * Ld / 2, ang, ppc, si, v == null ? (top ? 0 : 3) : v, 0) }
  
  function fitsLv(lv, id) { const rod = RODS[(lv | 0) - 1]; if (!rod) return true; const b = (typeof LAKE_BAITS !== 'undefined' && LAKE_BAITS[id]) || (typeof COAST_BAITS !== 'undefined' && COAST_BAITS[id]) || {};
    if (b.lure || b.reusable || /^lure-/.test(id)) return rod.kind === 'spin' || rod.kind === 'surf'; if (typeof LAKE_BAITS !== 'undefined' && LAKE_BAITS[id]) return rod.baits.includes(id); return rod.kind !== 'spin' }
  
  function bucket(g, x, y, rows, res, night, col) { sync(); const R = .16 * S * PXM, H = .34 * S * PXM * K, c = col || '#2f73b8';
    g.save(); g.fillStyle = 'rgba(10,14,20,.25)'; g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(x + 1, y + .6, R * 1.1, R * .55, 0, 0, TAU); g.fill();
    const gr = g.createLinearGradient(x - R, 0, x + R, 0); gr.addColorStop(0, shade(c, 1.15)); gr.addColorStop(1, shade(c, .7)); g.fillStyle = gr;
    g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(x - R, y - H); g.lineTo(x - R * .86, y); g.ellipse(x, y, R * .86, R * .43, 0, Math.PI, 0, true); g.lineTo(x + R, y - H); g.closePath(); g.fill();
    g.fillStyle = shade(c, .55); g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(x, y - H, R, R * .5, 0, 0, TAU); g.fill();
    g.fillStyle = night ? '#24445c' : '#7fb3c9'; g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(x, y - H + .25, R * .88, R * .42, 0, 0, TAU); g.fill();   
    g.save(); g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(x, y - H + .25, R * .88, R * .42, 0, 0, TAU); g.clip();
    (rows || []).forEach((q, i) => { const a = (i * 2.3) + .6, rr = R * (.12 + .08 * (i % 3)), ppc = S * PXM / 100; fish(g, q.id, q.cm, x + Math.cos(a) * rr, y - H + .25 + Math.sin(a) * rr * .5, a + Math.PI / 2, ppc, true, q.si, 1) });   
    g.restore();
    g.strokeStyle = '#c9d1d8'; g.lineWidth = Math.max(.15, .6 / res); g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(x, y - H, R, R * .5, 0, Math.PI * 1.05, Math.PI * 1.95, true); g.stroke();   
    g.restore() }
  function tackleBox(g, x, y, res) { sync(); const w = .42 * S * PXM, d = .24 * S * PXM, h = .2 * S * PXM * K; g.save();
    g.fillStyle = 'rgba(10,14,20,.25)'; g.fillRect(x - w / 2 + .6, y - d / 2 + .8, w, d);
    g.fillStyle = '#3c6b46'; g.fillRect(x - w / 2, y - d / 2 - h, w, h + d * .1); g.fillStyle = '#4f8a5c'; g.fillRect(x - w / 2, y - d / 2 - h - d * .5, w, d * .5);
    g.fillStyle = '#d8b13a'; g.fillRect(x - .5, y - d / 2 - h * .6, 1, h * .35); g.fillStyle = '#2a2d31'; g.fillRect(x - w * .2, y - d / 2 - h - d * .5 - .5, w * .4, .5); g.restore() }
  
  const ST = { wait: 0, bite: 1, fight: 2, lift: 3, keep: 4, release: 5, lost: 6 };
  function anglerNew(seed, rodLv, bait, hasBucket) { return { r: rng(seed), rodLv, bait, hasBucket, st: 'wait', t: 0, next: 0, fish: null, bucket: [], log: [] } }
  function anglerStep(A_, dt, pick, now) {   
    const R = A_.r; A_.t += dt; if (!A_.next) A_.next = 20 + R() * 60;
    if (A_.st === 'wait' && A_.t >= A_.next) { A_.st = 'bite'; A_.t = 0; A_.dur = .7 + R() * .9; A_.fish = pick(A_.rodLv, A_.bait, R) }
    else if (A_.st === 'bite' && A_.t >= A_.dur) { A_.st = 'fight'; A_.t = 0; A_.dur = 1.6 + (A_.fish.si + 1) * 1.1 + R() * 1.5; A_.escapes = R() < .18 }
    else if (A_.st === 'fight' && A_.t >= A_.dur) { A_.t = 0; if (A_.escapes) { A_.st = 'lost'; A_.dur = 2; A_.log.push([now, 'lost', A_.fish]) } else { A_.st = 'lift'; A_.dur = 1.3 } }
    else if (A_.st === 'lift' && A_.t >= A_.dur) { A_.t = 0; A_.dur = 1.6; const small = A_.fish.si === 0 && R() < .5, full = A_.bucket.length >= 6;
      if (A_.hasBucket && !small && !full) { A_.st = 'keep'; A_.bucket.push(A_.fish); A_.log.push([now, 'keep', A_.fish]) } else { A_.st = 'release'; A_.log.push([now, 'release', A_.fish]) } }
    else if ((A_.st === 'keep' || A_.st === 'release' || A_.st === 'lost') && A_.t >= A_.dur) { A_.st = 'wait'; A_.t = 0; A_.fish = null; A_.next = 30 + R() * 150 }
    return A_ }
  
  function anglerFrame(A_, rod, t) { const s = A_.st;
    if (s === 'wait') return { fr: rod.kind === 'spin' ? (Math.floor(t * 2) % 2 ? 5 : 4) : 0, bend: null, bite: false };
    if (s === 'bite') return { fr: 3, bend: .25 + Math.abs(Math.sin(t * 9)) * .25, bite: true, bell: true };
    if (s === 'fight') return { fr: Math.floor(t * 2.4) % 2 ? 5 : 4, bend: .4 + Math.sin(t * 5) * .1, bite: true };
    if (s === 'lift') return { fr: 6, bend: .5, fishUp: true };
    return { fr: 7, bend: 0, inHand: s !== 'lost' } }
  return { KINDS, A, F, fitsLv, rng, shade, P, rodSide, reelSide, rodWorld, float, fish, bucket, tackleBox, armsFor, kindOf, dirOf, anglerNew, anglerStep, anglerFrame, fishAt, rest, restGeo, S, K, PXM };
})();

function tcLiveAdd(id,o){o=o||{};const L=TC_LIVE_ADD,mode=o.mode||'zone';if(!L.on)return null;
 try{const had=L.zones.concat(L.walk).find(z=>z.id===id);if(had)return had;
  if(mode==='zone'){const q=MAP_CHUNKS.find(c=>c.id===id);if(!q){L.err.push(id+': אין תא כזה ב-MAP_CHUNKS');return null}
   if(MAP_ACTIVE_IDS.has(id)){L.err.push(id+': כבר חי');return null}if(q.cat==='sea'){L.err.push(id+': תא של ים — mode walk ליבשה שבו');return null}
   const r=o.rect||{x:q.x,y:q.y,w:q.w,h:q.h};if(r.x!==q.x||r.y!==q.y||r.w!==q.w||r.h!==q.h){L.err.push(id+': zone = תא שלם בלבד (לשטח חלקי — mode walk)');return null}
   ACTIVE_REGIONS.push(r);MAP_ACTIVE_IDS.add(id);const e={id,mode,r,note:o.note||'',by:o.by||''};L.zones.push(e);return e}
  if(mode==='walk'){const r=o.rect||null,fn=typeof o.fn==='function'?o.fn:null;if(!r&&!fn){L.err.push(id+': walk בלי rect / fn');return null}
   const e={id,mode,r,fn,note:o.note||'',by:o.by||''};L.walk.push(e);return e}
  L.err.push(id+': mode לא מוכר — '+mode);return null}catch(x){L.err.push(id+': '+String(x&&x.message||x).slice(0,120));return null}}
function tcLiveWalkAt(x,y){const W=TC_LIVE_ADD.walk;for(let i=0;i<W.length;i++){const e=W[i],r=e.r;if(r&&!(x>=r.x&&x<=r.x+r.w&&y>=r.y&&y<=r.y+r.h))continue;try{if(e.fn&&!e.fn(x,y))continue}catch(er){continue}return true}return false}

function tcLiveAddAudit(){const L=TC_LIVE_ADD,o={ok:true,issues:L.err.slice(0,8),zones:L.zones.map(z=>z.id),walk:L.walk.map(z=>z.id),pts:0,regions:ACTIVE_REGIONS.length,ids:MAP_ACTIVE_IDS.size};try{
 if(ACTIVE_REGIONS.length!==L.base.regions+L.zones.length)o.issues.push('ACTIVE_REGIONS '+ACTIVE_REGIONS.length+' ≠ '+L.base.regions+'+'+L.zones.length);
 if(MAP_ACTIVE_IDS.size!==L.base.ids+L.zones.length)o.issues.push('MAP_ACTIVE_IDS '+MAP_ACTIVE_IDS.size+' ≠ '+L.base.ids+'+'+L.zones.length);
 for(const z of L.zones){if(!ACTIVE_REGIONS.includes(z.r))o.issues.push(z.id+':regions');if(!MAP_ACTIVE_IDS.has(z.id))o.issues.push(z.id+':ids');
  for(let x=z.r.x+50;x<z.r.x+z.r.w;x+=100)for(let y=z.r.y+50;y<z.r.y+z.r.h;y+=100){o.pts++;if(!inActiveRegion(x,y)){o.issues.push(z.id+':region@'+x+','+y);break}}}
 for(const z of L.walk){if(MAP_ACTIVE_IDS.has(z.id))o.issues.push(z.id+':walk-in-ids');const r=z.r;if(!r)continue;
  for(let x=r.x+Math.min(50,r.w/2);x<r.x+r.w;x+=100)for(let y=r.y+Math.min(50,r.h/2);y<r.y+r.h;y+=100){if(z.fn&&!z.fn(x,y))continue;o.pts++;if(!inActiveRegion(x,y)){o.issues.push(z.id+':walk@'+x+','+y);break}}}
 const mapIds=[...MAP_ACTIVE_IDS].sort().join(),regIds=MAP_CHUNKS.filter(q=>ACTIVE_REGIONS.some(r=>q.x>=r.x&&q.x<r.x+r.w&&q.y>=r.y&&q.y<r.y+r.h)).map(q=>q.id).sort().join();
 if(mapIds!==regIds)o.issues.push('MAP_ACTIVE_IDS ≠ ACTIVE_REGIONS')}catch(e){o.issues.push('err: '+String(e&&e.message||e).slice(0,120))}
 o.issues=[...new Set(o.issues)].slice(0,16);o.ok=!o.issues.length;return o}

function plThumb(cv,g,c1,c2,rod,sub){const W=220,H=150,d=Math.min(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1);cv.width=W*d;cv.height=H*d;const c=cv.getContext('2d');c.scale(d,d);
 const bg=c.createRadialGradient(W/2,H*.42,8,W/2,H*.5,W*.66);bg.addColorStop(0,'#ffffff');bg.addColorStop(1,plMix(c2,'#efe9dc',.62));c.fillStyle=bg;c.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
 c.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.12)';c.beginPath();c.ellipse(W/2,H*.86,62,8,0,0,Math.PI*2);c.fill();
 let A=c1,B=c2;if(plLum(A)>.6){A=plLum(c2)<.6?c2:plMix(c1,'#000000',.45);B=c1}c.save();c.translate(W/2,H*.5);plGlyph(c,g,A,B,rod,sub);c.restore()}

function d2Glyph(c,g,A,B){const P=Math.PI,R=(x,y,w,h,r)=>{c.beginPath();if(c.roundRect)c.roundRect(x,y,w,h,r||0);else c.rect(x,y,w,h)},F=col=>{c.fillStyle=col;c.fill()},S=(col,w)=>{c.strokeStyle=col;c.lineWidth=w||2;c.stroke()},
 E=(x,y,rx,ry)=>{c.beginPath();c.ellipse(x,y,rx,ry,0,0,P*2)},L=(pts)=>{c.beginPath();pts.forEach((p,i)=>i?c.lineTo(p[0],p[1]):c.moveTo(p[0],p[1]))},ol='rgba(18,26,34,.55)',dk=plMix(A,'#000000',.35),lt=plMix(A,'#ffffff',.45);

  if(hair===0){c.beginPath();c.ellipse(0,-14,31,20,0,P,0);F('#2b1d12');R(-31,-16,62,8,3);F('#2b1d12')}else if(hair===1){c.beginPath();c.ellipse(0,-12,30,16,0,P,0);F('rgba(43,29,18,.55)')}else if(hair===3){E(-10,-18,9,4);F('rgba(255,255,255,.45)')}
  if(beard){c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-28,10);c.quadraticCurveTo(0,58,28,10);c.quadraticCurveTo(0,40,-28,10);F('#2b1d12')}};
 c.lineJoin='round';c.lineCap='round';
 switch(g){
 case'd2parcel':R(-46,-30,92,64,6);F('#c99b62');S(ol,2);R(-8,-30,16,64,0);F('#b8854d');R(-46,-6,92,10,0);F('rgba(255,255,255,.35)');R(16,8,24,16,3);F('#ffffff');S(ol,1.4);return;
 case'd2tape':E(0,0,38,38);F('#d9b77a');S(ol,2);E(0,0,16,16);F('#f4efe3');S(ol,2);R(30,-8,46,16,3);F('rgba(217,183,122,.8)');S(ol,1.4);return;
 case'd2label':for(let i=0;i<3;i++){R(-44+i*8,-34+i*10,72,40,5);F(i===2?'#ffffff':'#eef1f4');S(ol,1.6)}for(let i=0;i<3;i++){R(-20,-2+i*9,48-i*12,3,1);F('#7a8794')}return;

var TCSND=(function(){
 const st={ctx:null,master:null,comp:null,ana:null,rev:null,noise:null,lfo:null,vol:.8,mute:false,notes:0,sfx:0,ambOn:0,err:null,created:0,S:null,sessions:0};
 try{const q=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('tcShowAudio')||'{}');if(isFinite(q.v))st.vol=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,+q.v));st.mute=!!q.m}catch(e){}
 const keep=()=>{try{localStorage.setItem('tcShowAudio',JSON.stringify({v:st.vol,m:st.mute}))}catch(e){}};
 const mtof=m=>440*Math.pow(2,(m-69)/12),R=Math.random;
 function masterLevel(){return st.mute?0:Math.pow(st.vol,1.6)*.95}
  
 function makeIR(ctx,sec,decay){const n=Math.floor(ctx.sampleRate*sec),b=ctx.createBuffer(2,n,ctx.sampleRate);for(let ch=0;ch<2;ch++){const d=b.getChannelData(ch);for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const t=i/n;d[i]=(R()*2-1)*Math.pow(1-t,decay)*(t<.012?0:1)}for(const [ms,g] of [[11,.5],[19,.35],[27,.3],[41,.22]]){const i=Math.floor(ctx.sampleRate*ms/1000*(ch?1.07:1));if(i<n)d[i]+=g*(ch?-1:1)}}return b}
 function ensure(){if(st.ctx)return st.ctx;const AC=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;if(!AC){st.err='no-audio';return null}
  try{const ctx=new AC({latencyHint:'playback'});st.ctx=ctx;st.created=Date.now();
   st.master=ctx.createGain();st.master.gain.value=masterLevel();st.comp=ctx.createDynamicsCompressor();st.comp.threshold.value=-16;st.comp.knee.value=12;st.comp.ratio.value=3.2;st.comp.attack.value=.008;st.comp.release.value=.28;
   const tone=ctx.createBiquadFilter();tone.type='peaking';tone.frequency.value=3200;tone.Q.value=.8;tone.gain.value=-3.5;    
   st.comp.connect(tone);tone.connect(st.master);st.master.connect(ctx.destination);st.ana=ctx.createAnalyser();st.ana.fftSize=2048;st.master.connect(st.ana);
   st.rev=ctx.createConvolver();const rg=ctx.createGain();rg.gain.value=.55;st.rev.connect(rg);rg.connect(st.comp);    
   st.lfo=ctx.createOscillator();st.lfo.frequency.value=5.3;st.vib=ctx.createGain();st.vib.gain.value=7;st.lfo.connect(st.vib);st.lfo.start();
   return ctx}catch(e){st.err=String(e&&e.message||e);st.ctx=null;return null}}
  
 

 function fxBuild(){if(st.noise||!st.ctx)return;const ctx=st.ctx,t0=performance.now();try{st.rev.buffer=makeIR(ctx,2.8,3.2);
   const n=ctx.sampleRate*3,nb=ctx.createBuffer(1,n,ctx.sampleRate),d=nb.getChannelData(0);let b0=0,b1=0,b2=0;for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const w=R()*2-1;b0=.99765*b0+w*.099;b1=.963*b1+w*.2965;b2=.57*b2+w*1.0526;d[i]=(b0+b1+b2+w*.1848)*.16}st.noise=nb;    
   const wb=ctx.createBuffer(1,n,ctx.sampleRate),wd=wb.getChannelData(0);for(let i=0;i<n;i++)wd[i]=R()*2-1;st.white=wb}catch(e){st.err=st.err||'fx: '+String(e&&e.message||e)}st.fx=+(performance.now()-t0).toFixed(1)}
 function session(){const ctx=st.ctx;if(!ctx)return null;fxBuild();const g=ctx.createGain();g.gain.value=1;g.connect(st.comp);const S={g,mus:ctx.createGain(),amb:ctx.createGain(),sfx:ctx.createGain(),send:ctx.createGain(),ambs:{},alive:true};
  S.mus.gain.value=.62;S.amb.gain.value=.5;S.sfx.gain.value=.75;S.send.gain.value=1;S.mus.connect(g);S.amb.connect(g);S.sfx.connect(g);
  S.musRev=ctx.createGain();S.musRev.gain.value=.42;S.mus.connect(S.musRev);S.musRev.connect(S.send);S.sfxRev=ctx.createGain();S.sfxRev.gain.value=.22;S.sfx.connect(S.sfxRev);S.sfxRev.connect(S.send);S.send.connect(st.rev);
  st.sessions++;return S}
 function endSession(S){if(!S||!S.alive)return;S.alive=false;const ctx=st.ctx,t=ctx.currentTime;try{S.g.gain.cancelScheduledValues(t);S.g.gain.setValueAtTime(S.g.gain.value,t);S.g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0,t+.18)}catch(e){}
  setTimeout(()=>{try{S.g.disconnect();S.send.disconnect()}catch(e){}for(const k in S.ambs){try{S.ambs[k].stop()}catch(e){}}},420)}
  
 function osc(type,f,t,end,dest,det){const o=st.ctx.createOscillator();o.type=type;o.frequency.setValueAtTime(f,t);if(det)o.detune.setValueAtTime(det,t);o.connect(dest);o.start(t);o.stop(end);return o}
 function gainEnv(dest,t,a,peak,hold,rel,sus){const g=st.ctx.createGain();g.gain.setValueAtTime(0,t);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(peak,t+a);if(sus!=null)g.gain.setTargetAtTime(peak*sus,t+a,.25);g.gain.setTargetAtTime(0,t+Math.max(a,hold),rel/3.5);g.connect(dest);return g}
 function noiseSrc(t,end,dest,white,rate){if(!st.noise)fxBuild();const s=st.ctx.createBufferSource();s.buffer=white?st.white:st.noise;s.loop=true;if(rate)s.playbackRate.value=rate;s.connect(dest);s.start(t,R()*2);s.stop(end);return s}
 function filt(type,f,q,dest){const b=st.ctx.createBiquadFilter();b.type=type;b.frequency.value=f;if(q!=null)b.Q.value=q;b.connect(dest);return b}
 function pan(x,dest){if(!st.ctx.createStereoPanner)return dest;const p=st.ctx.createStereoPanner();p.pan.value=Math.max(-1,Math.min(1,x));p.connect(dest);return p}
 const INST={
  str(t,m,d,v,dest,o){const f=mtof(m),a=o.a!=null?o.a:.22,rel=o.r||.7,lp=filt('lowpass',Math.min(7000,f*(o.bright||4.2)+500),.6,pan(o.p||((m-62)/40),dest)),g=gainEnv(lp,t,a,v*.075,d,rel,.92);

  brass(t,m,d,v,dest,o){const f=mtof(m),rel=o.r||.28,lp=filt('lowpass',f*1.1,1.4,pan(o.p||.15,dest)),e=t+d+rel*1.6;lp.frequency.setValueAtTime(f*1.1,t);lp.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(Math.min(9000,f*6),t+.07);lp.frequency.setTargetAtTime(Math.min(7000,f*3.6),t+.08,.15);lp.frequency.setTargetAtTime(f*1.2,t+d,rel/3);
   const g=gainEnv(lp,t,.045,v*.11,d,rel,.82);for(const det of [-5,4])osc('sawtooth',f,t,e,g,det);osc('square',f/2,t,e,gainEnv(lp,t,.05,v*.02,d,rel,.8))},

  flute(t,m,d,v,dest,o){const f=mtof(m),rel=o.r||.18,P=pan(o.p!=null?o.p:.3,dest),g=gainEnv(P,t,.07,v*.16,d,rel,.9),e=t+d+rel*1.6;const a=osc('sine',f,t,e,g);const b=osc('triangle',f,t,e,gainEnv(P,t,.06,v*.035,d,rel,.9));
   const vg=st.ctx.createGain();vg.gain.setValueAtTime(0,t);vg.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(9,t+.35);st.lfo.connect(vg);vg.connect(a.detune);vg.connect(b.detune);
   noiseSrc(t,e,filt('bandpass',f*1.02,9,gainEnv(P,t,.03,v*.05,Math.min(d,.12),.15)),true)},
  clar(t,m,d,v,dest,o){const f=mtof(m),rel=o.r||.16,lp=filt('lowpass',f*3+400,.7,pan(-.3,dest)),g=gainEnv(lp,t,.05,v*.07,d,rel,.92);const q=osc('square',f,t,t+d+rel*1.6,g);const vg=st.ctx.createGain();vg.gain.setValueAtTime(0,t);vg.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(6,t+.4);st.lfo.connect(vg);vg.connect(q.detune)},
  oboe(t,m,d,v,dest,o){const f=mtof(m),rel=o.r||.14,bp=filt('bandpass',f*2.2,1.2,pan(.35,dest)),g=gainEnv(bp,t,.05,v*.2,d,rel,.9);const q=osc('sawtooth',f,t,t+d+rel*1.6,g);st.vib.connect(q.detune)},
  harp(t,m,d,v,dest,o){const f=mtof(m),P=pan(o.p!=null?o.p:(m-60)/30,dest);for(const [k,a,tau] of [[1,1,1.1],[2,.42,.55],[3,.16,.3],[4,.07,.18]]){const g=st.ctx.createGain();g.gain.setValueAtTime(0,t);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(v*.11*a,t+.004);g.gain.setTargetAtTime(0,t+.005,tau*(o.sus||1));g.connect(P);osc('sine',f*k,t,t+tau*6,g)}},
  piano(t,m,d,v,dest,o){const f=mtof(m),P=pan((m-60)/36,dest),dd=Math.min(3.2,Math.max(.6,d+.5));for(const [k,a,tau,ty] of [[1,1,dd*.7,'triangle'],[1.002,.6,dd*.6,'sine'],[2,.3,dd*.32,'sine'],[3.01,.1,dd*.18,'sine']]){const g=st.ctx.createGain();g.gain.setValueAtTime(0,t);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(v*.12*a,t+.006);g.gain.setTargetAtTime(v*.05*a,t+.01,.18);g.gain.setTargetAtTime(0,t+d,Math.min(tau,.35));g.connect(P);osc(ty,f*k,t,t+d+1.6,g)}

   const g2=st.ctx.createGain();g2.gain.setValueAtTime(v*.12,t);g2.gain.setTargetAtTime(0,t,.16);g2.connect(dest);osc('triangle',f*1.5,t,t+1,g2);noiseSrc(t,t+.12,filt('lowpass',380,.7,gainEnv(dest,t,.002,v*.2,.02,.06)))},

 const AMB={
  sea(S){const c=st.ctx,out=c.createGain();const lp=filt('lowpass',650,.5,out),lfo=c.createOscillator(),lg=c.createGain(),am=c.createGain();am.gain.value=.55;lfo.frequency.value=.11;lg.gain.value=.45;lfo.connect(lg);lg.connect(am.gain);am.connect(lp);
   const s1=noiseSrc(c.currentTime,c.currentTime+3600,am);const hp=filt('highpass',2600,.4,out),am2=c.createGain();am2.gain.value=.12;lg.connect(am2.gain);am2.connect(hp);const s2=noiseSrc(c.currentTime,c.currentTime+3600,am2,true,.5);lfo.start();return{out,stop(){for(const q of [s1,s2,lfo])try{q.stop()}catch(e){}}}},
  wind(S){const c=st.ctx,out=c.createGain(),bp=filt('bandpass',520,2.2,out),lfo=c.createOscillator(),lg=c.createGain();lfo.frequency.value=.07;lg.gain.value=320;lfo.connect(lg);lg.connect(bp.frequency);const am=c.createGain();am.gain.value=.9;const l2=c.createOscillator(),g2=c.createGain();l2.frequency.value=.19;g2.gain.value=.5;l2.connect(g2);g2.connect(am.gain);am.connect(bp);
   const s=noiseSrc(c.currentTime,c.currentTime+3600,am);const lo=filt('lowpass',180,.5,out);const s2=noiseSrc(c.currentTime,c.currentTime+3600,lo);lfo.start();l2.start();return{out,stop(){for(const q of [s,s2,lfo,l2])try{q.stop()}catch(e){}}}},
  rain(S){const c=st.ctx,out=c.createGain(),hp=filt('highpass',1300,.4,filt('lowpass',9000,.4,out)),g=c.createGain();g.gain.value=.55;g.connect(hp);const s=noiseSrc(c.currentTime,c.currentTime+3600,g,true);const body=filt('lowpass',420,.5,out),g2=c.createGain();g2.gain.value=.5;g2.connect(body);const s2=noiseSrc(c.currentTime,c.currentTime+3600,g2);return{out,stop(){for(const q of [s,s2])try{q.stop()}catch(e){}}}},
  train(S){const c=st.ctx,out=c.createGain(),lp=filt('lowpass',140,.7,out);const s=noiseSrc(c.currentTime,c.currentTime+3600,lp,false,.7);const hum=c.createGain();hum.gain.value=.25;hum.connect(filt('lowpass',300,.7,out));const o=osc('sawtooth',46,c.currentTime,c.currentTime+3600,hum);return{out,stop(){for(const q of [s,o])try{q.stop()}catch(e){}}}},
  city(S){const c=st.ctx,out=c.createGain(),lp=filt('lowpass',320,.5,out);const s=noiseSrc(c.currentTime,c.currentTime+3600,lp,false,.8);return{out,stop(){try{s.stop()}catch(e){}}}},
  room(S){const c=st.ctx,out=c.createGain(),lp=filt('lowpass',260,.5,out);const s=noiseSrc(c.currentTime,c.currentTime+3600,lp,false,.6);return{out,stop(){try{s.stop()}catch(e){}}}},
  engine(S){const c=st.ctx,out=c.createGain(),lp=filt('lowpass',220,.9,out),am=c.createGain();am.gain.value=.6;const l=c.createOscillator(),lg=c.createGain();l.frequency.value=7;lg.gain.value=.4;l.connect(lg);lg.connect(am.gain);am.connect(lp);const o=osc('sawtooth',54,c.currentTime,c.currentTime+3600,am);l.start();return{out,stop(){for(const q of [o,l])try{q.stop()}catch(e){}}}},
  fire(S){const c=st.ctx,out=c.createGain(),bp=filt('bandpass',900,.6,out);const s=noiseSrc(c.currentTime,c.currentTime+3600,bp);return{out,stop(){try{s.stop()}catch(e){}}}}
 };
 function amb(S,name,level,fade,t){if(!S||!S.alive||!AMB[name])return;let a=S.ambs[name];if(!a){if(level<=.001)return;a=AMB[name](S);a.g=st.ctx.createGain();a.g.gain.value=0;a.out.connect(a.g);a.g.connect(S.amb);S.ambs[name]=a;st.ambOn++}
  const at=t||st.ctx.currentTime;a.g.gain.cancelScheduledValues(at);a.g.gain.setTargetAtTime(Math.max(0,level),at,Math.max(.02,(fade||1)/3))}

  splash(S,t,v){const g=st.ctx.createGain();g.gain.setValueAtTime(0,t);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(v*.35,t+.03);g.gain.setTargetAtTime(0,t+.05,.25);const bp=filt('bandpass',1200,.6,S.sfx);bp.frequency.setValueAtTime(2500,t);bp.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(500,t+.6);g.connect(bp);noiseSrc(t,t+1.2,g,true)},
  wave(S,t,v){const g=st.ctx.createGain();g.gain.setValueAtTime(0,t);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(v*.5,t+.6);g.gain.setTargetAtTime(0,t+.8,.5);const lp=filt('lowpass',900,.5,S.sfx);g.connect(lp);noiseSrc(t,t+3,g)},
  gull(S,t,v){for(let k=0;k<2;k++){const t0=t+k*.28,g=gainEnv(pan(.5-R(),S.sfx),t0,.02,v*.035,.16,.06),o=osc('sine',1500,t0,t0+.35,g);o.frequency.setValueAtTime(1350,t0);o.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(1900,t0+.07);o.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(1200,t0+.2)}},
  applause(S,t,v,p){const d=p||5,n=Math.round(d*90);for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const u=i/n,tt=t+u*d+R()*.03,env=Math.min(1,u*5)*Math.min(1,(1-u)*2.4),f=900+R()*2200;noiseSrc(tt,tt+.05,filt('bandpass',f,1.4,gainEnv(pan(R()*1.6-.8,S.sfx),tt,.001,v*env*(.14+R()*.12),.008,.03)),true)}},

  clock(S,t,v,p){for(let k=0;k<(p||1);k++)INST.bell(t+k*1.1,52,1,v*1.2,S.sfx,{sus:1.4})},
  boing(S,t,v){const g=gainEnv(S.sfx,t,.005,v*.12,.35,.2),o=osc('triangle',190,t,t+.8,g);const l=st.ctx.createOscillator(),lg=st.ctx.createGain();l.frequency.value=14;lg.gain.setValueAtTime(90,t);lg.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0,t+.6);l.connect(lg);lg.connect(o.frequency);l.start(t);l.stop(t+.8);o.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(330,t+.5)},
  whoosh(S,t,v,p){const d=p||.8,g=st.ctx.createGain();g.gain.setValueAtTime(0,t);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(v*.3,t+d*.6);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0,t+d);const bp=filt('bandpass',500,1.2,S.sfx);bp.frequency.setValueAtTime(400,t);bp.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(3000,t+d);g.connect(bp);noiseSrc(t,t+d+.1,g,true)},
  click(S,t,v){noiseSrc(t,t+.03,filt('highpass',1800,.7,gainEnv(S.sfx,t,.001,v*.3,.004,.012)),true)},
  lamp(S,t,v){const g=gainEnv(S.sfx,t,.3,v*.03,1.2,.5,.8);osc('sawtooth',100,t,t+2.4,filt('lowpass',600,.5,g));SFX.click(S,t,v)},
  spark(S,t,v){for(let k=0;k<5;k++)noiseSrc(t+k*.04,t+k*.04+.05,filt('highpass',4000,.5,gainEnv(S.sfx,t+k*.04,.001,v*.2*R(),.01,.02)),true)},
  firework(S,t,v){INST.kick(t,0,0,v*.7,S.sfx);for(let k=0;k<26;k++){const tt=t+.25+R()*1.1;noiseSrc(tt,tt+.04,filt('highpass',3000+R()*3000,.5,gainEnv(pan(R()*2-1,S.sfx),tt,.001,v*.1*R(),.005,.02)),true)}},
  kite(S,t,v,p){const d=p||1.5,am=st.ctx.createGain();am.gain.value=0;const l=st.ctx.createOscillator(),lg=st.ctx.createGain();l.frequency.value=11;lg.gain.value=v*.08;l.connect(lg);lg.connect(am.gain);l.start(t);l.stop(t+d);am.connect(filt('bandpass',700,.8,S.sfx));noiseSrc(t,t+d,am,true)},
  creak(S,t,v){const g=gainEnv(filt('bandpass',420,6,S.sfx),t,.05,v*.25,.5,.1),o=osc('sawtooth',38,t,t+.8,g);o.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(52,t+.5)},
  steps(S,t,v,p){for(let k=0;k<(p||4);k++){const tt=t+k*.32;noiseSrc(tt,tt+.06,filt('lowpass',500,.7,gainEnv(S.sfx,tt,.002,v*.3,.01,.04)))}},
  ratchet(S,t,v,p){for(let k=0;k<(p||8);k++)SFX.tick(S,t+k*.11,v,k%2)},
  rope(S,t,v){const g=st.ctx.createGain();g.gain.setValueAtTime(0,t);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(v*.2,t+.15);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0,t+.5);g.connect(filt('bandpass',900,2,S.sfx));noiseSrc(t,t+.6,g)},
  bump(S,t,v){INST.kick(t,0,0,v*.6,S.sfx);noiseSrc(t,t+.2,filt('lowpass',700,.6,gainEnv(S.sfx,t,.002,v*.25,.02,.08)))},
  wipe(S,t,v){noiseSrc(t,t+.35,filt('bandpass',1400,2.5,gainEnv(S.sfx,t,.05,v*.07,.15,.08)))},
  flag(S,t,v,p){SFX.kite(S,t,v*.7,p||1.2)},
  pour(S,t,v){noiseSrc(t,t+1.1,filt('bandpass',2400,3,gainEnv(S.sfx,t,.08,v*.06,.8,.2)),true)}
 };
  
 const PC={C:0,D:2,E:4,F:5,G:7,A:9,B:11};
 function nm(s){const m=/^([A-G])([#b]?)(-?\d)$/.exec(s);if(!m)return 60;return 12*(+m[3]+1)+PC[m[1]]+(m[2]==='#'?1:m[2]==='b'?-1:0)}
 const QUAL={'':[0,4,7],m:[0,3,7],dim:[0,3,6],aug:[0,4,8],'7':[0,4,7,10],m7:[0,3,7,10],maj7:[0,4,7,11],sus4:[0,5,7],sus2:[0,2,7],add9:[0,4,7,14],m9:[0,3,7,14],'6':[0,4,7,9]};
 function chord(s){const m=/^([A-G])([#b]?)(m7|m9|maj7|m|dim|aug|7|sus4|sus2|add9|6)?(?:\/([A-G])([#b]?))?$/.exec(s);if(!m)return{r:0,iv:[0,4,7],b:0};const r=(PC[m[1]]+(m[2]==='#'?1:m[2]==='b'?-1:0)+12)%12;const b=m[4]?(PC[m[4]]+(m[5]==='#'?1:m[5]==='b'?-1:0)+12)%12:r;return{r,iv:QUAL[m[3]||''],b}}
 function prog(s,cb){return s.trim().split(/\s+/).map(x=>{const [n,len]=x.split(':');return{c:chord(n),beats:len?+len:cb}})}
 function melody(s){let b=0;const out=[];for(const x of s.trim().split(/\s+/)){const [n,len]=x.split(':');const d=+(len||1);if(n!=='r'&&n!=='-')out.push([b,d,nm(n)]);b+=d}return{notes:out,len:b}}
 const near=(pc,lo)=>{let m=lo-((lo%12)+12)%12+pc;if(m<lo)m+=12;return m};
  
 function compose(c,out){const beat=60/c.bpm,P=prog(c.ch||'C',c.cb||4),V=c.v==null?.8:c.v,E=(t,i,m,d,v,o)=>{if(t<c.t1-.02)out.push({t,k:'n',i,m,d:Math.max(.05,Math.min(d,c.t1+(c.tail||.6)-t)),v:v*V*(c.fadeIn&&t<c.t0+c.fadeIn?Math.max(.15,(t-c.t0)/c.fadeIn):1),o:o||{}})};
  let b=0,ci=0;const tb=b=>c.t0+b*beat,span=(c.t1-c.t0)/beat;
  while(b<span){const ch=P[ci%P.length],L=ch.beats,t=tb(b),dur=L*beat,tones=ch.c.iv.map(x=>(ch.c.r+x)%12),root=ch.c.b;
   if(c.pad){const lo=c.padLo||55;const vo=ch.c.iv.slice(0,4).map((x,k)=>near((ch.c.r+x)%12,lo+(k?3:0)));vo.sort((a,b)=>a-b);for(const m of vo)E(t,c.pad,m,dur*.98,c.padV||.55,{a:c.padA||.3,r:.8})}
   if(c.bass){const m=near(root,c.bassLo||36);if(c.bass==='timp')E(t,'timp',m,1,.7);else if(c.bass==='walk'){for(let k=0;k<L;k++)E(tb(b+k),'pizz',k%2?m+7:m,beat*.9,.8)}else E(t,c.bass,m,dur*.97,.7)}
   if(c.timp&&(ci%(c.timpEvery||1)===0))E(t,'timp',near(root,40),1,c.timp===2?.95:.65);
   if(c.arp){const r=c.arpR||.5,pat=c.arpPat||'up',lo=c.arpLo||60,ns=[...tones.map(p=>near(p,lo)),near(tones[0],lo)+12],seq=pat==='updown'?[...ns,...ns.slice(1,-1).reverse()]:pat==='broken'?[ns[0],ns[2],ns[1],ns[3]||ns[0]+12]:ns;for(let k=0;k*r<L-.001;k++)E(tb(b+k*r),c.arp,seq[k%seq.length],r*beat*(c.arp==='harp'||c.arp==='piano'?3:1),(c.arpV||.5)*(k%2?.85:1))}
   if(c.pulse){const r=c.pulseR||.5;for(let k=0;k*r<L-.001;k++){const m=near(root,c.pulseLo||43)+(c.pulseOct&&k%2?12:0);E(tb(b+k*r),c.pulse,m,r*beat*.7,(c.pulseV||.55)*(k%(1/r*2)===0?1.15:1),{a:.02,r:.12})}}
   if(c.drums){const D=c.drums;for(let k=0;k<L;k++){const tt=tb(b+k);if(D==='march'){E(tt,'snare',0,.1,k%2?.35:.55);if(k%2)E(tt+beat/2,'snare',0,.1,.3);if(k===0)E(tt,'kick',0,.2,.6)}
     else if(D==='train'){E(tt,'brush',0,.1,.55);E(tt+beat/2,'brush',0,.1,.35);if(k%2===0)E(tt,'kick',0,.2,.35)}
     else if(D==='soft'){if(k===0)E(tt,'kick',0,.2,.4);E(tt+beat/2,'hat',0,.1,.3)}
     else if(D==='build'){for(let q=0;q<4;q++)E(tt+q*beat/4,'snare',0,.06,.12+.5*((b+k+q/4)/span))}
     else if(D==='dance'){if(k%2===0)E(tt,'kick',0,.2,.5);else E(tt,'snare',0,.1,.4);E(tt+beat/2,'hat',0,.1,.3)}}}
   b+=L;ci++}
  for(const key of ['mel','mel2','mel3']){const M=c[key];if(!M)continue;const ml=melody(M.s),o=(M.o||0)*12,start=M.from||0;let base=start;while(base<span){for(const [nb,nd,m] of ml.notes){const bb=base+nb;if(bb>=span)break;E(tb(bb),M.i,m+o,nd*beat*(M.leg||.96),M.v||.7,{p:M.p});if(M.dbl)E(tb(bb),M.dbl,m+o+(M.dblO||0)*12,nd*beat*.96,M.dblV||.4)}if(!M.loop)break;base+=ml.len}}
  if(c.end==='swell')out.push({t:c.t1-1.6,k:'n',i:'swell',m:0,d:1.6,v:.8*V,o:{}});
  if(c.end==='hit'){out.push({t:c.t1-.05,k:'n',i:'cym',m:0,d:2.4,v:.7*V,o:{}});out.push({t:c.t1-.05,k:'n',i:'timp',m:near(P[0].c.r,40),d:1,v:.9*V,o:{}})}
  if(c.startCym)out.push({t:c.t0,k:'n',i:'cym',m:0,d:2.6,v:.6*V,o:{}});
  if(c.roll){for(let tt=c.t1-c.roll;tt<c.t1;tt+=.075)out.push({t:tt,k:'n',i:'timp',m:near(P[0].c.r,40),d:.3,v:.25+.6*((tt-(c.t1-c.roll))/c.roll),o:{}})}
  return out}
  
 function build(spec){const ev=[];for(const c of spec.cues||[])compose(c,ev);for(const s of spec.sfx||[])ev.push({t:s[0],k:'s',s:s[1],v:s[2]==null?.8:s[2],p:s[3]});for(const a of spec.amb||[])ev.push({t:a[0],k:'a',a:a[1],v:a[2],f:a[3]||1.5});for(const n of spec.notes||[])ev.push({t:n[0],k:'n',i:n[1],m:typeof n[2]==='string'?nm(n[2]):n[2],d:n[3]||1,v:n[4]||.7,o:n[5]||{}});ev.sort((a,b)=>a.t-b.t);return ev}
 function fire(S,e,at){try{if(e.k==='n'){const f=INST[e.i];if(f){f(at,e.m,e.d,e.v,S.mus,e.o||{});st.notes++}}else if(e.k==='s'){const f=SFX[e.s];if(f){f(S,at,e.v,e.p);st.sfx++}}else if(e.k==='a')amb(S,e.a,e.v,e.f,at)}catch(x){st.err=String(x&&x.message||x)}}
  
 function play(spec){const ctx=ensure();const P={ev:build(spec),i:0,S:null,synced:false,pump,pause,resume,stop,count:0};
  function start(showT){if(!st.ctx||P.S)return;P.S=session();st.S=P.S;const lv={};let i=0;while(i<P.ev.length&&P.ev[i].t<showT-.05){const e=P.ev[i];if(e.k==='a')lv[e.a]=e;i++}P.i=i;for(const k in lv){const e=lv[k];amb(P.S,e.a,e.v,.5)}}
  function pump(showT){if(P.done||!st.ctx)return;if(st.ctx.state==='suspended'&&!P.paused){try{st.ctx.resume()}catch(e){}}if(st.ctx.state!=='running')return;if(!P.S)start(showT);const S=P.S;if(!S||!S.alive)return;const now=st.ctx.currentTime;
   while(P.i<P.ev.length&&P.ev[P.i].t<showT+.32){const e=P.ev[P.i++];if(e.t<showT-.12&&e.k!=='a')continue;fire(S,e,now+Math.max(0,e.t-showT)+.02);P.count++}}
  function pause(){P.paused=true;try{st.ctx&&st.ctx.suspend()}catch(e){}}
  function resume(){P.paused=false;try{st.ctx&&st.ctx.resume()}catch(e){}}
  function stop(){P.done=true;const S=P.S;if(S)endSession(S);if(st.S===S)st.S=null;P.S=null;setTimeout(()=>{try{if(st.ctx&&!st.S&&st.ctx.state==='running')st.ctx.suspend()}catch(e){}},520)}
  return P}
 function setVol(v){st.vol=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,v));if(st.master)st.master.gain.setTargetAtTime(masterLevel(),st.ctx.currentTime,.05);keep()}
 function setMute(m){st.mute=!!m;if(st.master)st.master.gain.setTargetAtTime(masterLevel(),st.ctx.currentTime,.03);keep()}
  
 function duck(on){const S=st.S;if(!S||!S.alive||!st.ctx)return;const t=st.ctx.currentTime;S.mus.gain.setTargetAtTime(on?.24:.62,t,on?.08:.35);S.amb.gain.setTargetAtTime(on?.3:.5,t,on?.08:.35);st.ducked=!!on}
 function level(){if(!st.ana)return 0;const a=new Float32Array(st.ana.fftSize);st.ana.getFloatTimeDomainData(a);let s=0;for(const x of a)s+=x*x;return Math.sqrt(s/a.length)}
 return{st,ensure,play,setVol,setMute,level,duck,nm,melody,chord,build,INST,SFX,AMB,get ctx(){return st.ctx},get vol(){return st.vol},get mute(){return st.mute}}})();


var TCK=(function(){
 const TAU=Math.PI*2,cl=(v,a,b)=>v<a?a:v>b?b:v,lerp=(a,b,u)=>a+(b-a)*u,sm=u=>{u=cl(u,0,1);return u*u*(3-2*u)},seg=(t,a,b)=>cl((t-a)/(b-a),0,1),eio=u=>{u=cl(u,0,1);return u<.5?4*u*u*u:1-Math.pow(-2*u+2,3)/2};
 const HX={};function hx(h){if(HX[h])return HX[h];let s=String(h).replace('#','');if(s.length===3)s=s.split('').map(q=>q+q).join('');const n=parseInt(s.slice(0,6),16)||0;return HX[h]=[n>>16&255,n>>8&255,n&255]}
 function mix(a,b,u){const A=hx(a),B=hx(b);u=cl(u,0,1);return'#'+A.map((v,i)=>Math.round(v+(B[i]-v)*u).toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('')}
 function rgba(h,a){const A=hx(h);return'rgba('+A[0]+','+A[1]+','+A[2]+','+cl(a,0,1).toFixed(3)+')'}
 function rng(seed){let s=(seed>>>0)||1;return()=>{s=(Math.imul(s,1664525)+1013904223)>>>0;return s/4294967296}}
  
 function kf(keys,t,ease){ease=ease||sm;if(t<=keys[0][0])return keys[0].slice(1);for(let i=0;i<keys.length-1;i++){const a=keys[i],b=keys[i+1];if(t<b[0]){const u=ease((t-a[0])/(b[0]-a[0]));return a.slice(1).map((v,j)=>typeof v==='string'?mix(v,b[j+1],u):lerp(v,b[j+1],u))}}return keys[keys.length-1].slice(1)}
  
 function walker(keys,stride){stride=stride||46;const segs=[];let acc=0;for(let i=0;i<keys.length-1;i++){const a=keys[i],b=keys[i+1],d=Math.hypot(b[1]-a[1],(b[2]||0)-(a[2]||0));segs.push({a,b,d,acc});acc+=d}
  return t=>{if(t<=keys[0][0])return{x:keys[0][1],y:keys[0][2]||0,moving:0,dir:0,ph:0};for(const q of segs){if(t<q.b[0]){const u0=(t-q.a[0])/(q.b[0]-q.a[0]),u=lerp(u0,sm(u0),.55),x=lerp(q.a[1],q.b[1],u),y=lerp(q.a[2]||0,q.b[2]||0,u);return{x,y,moving:q.d>1?1:0,dir:Math.sign(q.b[1]-q.a[1]),ph:(q.acc+q.d*u)/stride}}}const L=keys[keys.length-1];return{x:L[1],y:L[2]||0,moving:0,dir:0,ph:acc/stride}}}
 const cache={};function cached(key,w,h,fn){let cv=cache[key];if(!cv){cv=document.createElement('canvas');cv.width=Math.max(1,Math.round(w));cv.height=Math.max(1,Math.round(h));fn(cv.getContext('2d'),cv.width,cv.height);cache[key]=cv}return cv}
  
 const SKY=[[0,'#03061a','#0a1436','#1a2652'],[4.6,'#070c2a','#1e2350','#3e3566'],[5.6,'#1d2a5e','#6a5a8c','#f0a07a'],[6.6,'#3d6fb0','#9ec1de','#ffd7a0'],[8.5,'#3a86d6','#86bfea','#d6ecf8'],[16,'#3a82d0','#8cc2ea','#e0eef6'],[17.6,'#3a64a8','#d79a72','#ffd08a'],[18.6,'#2a3c78','#c0607a','#ff9a5a'],[19.4,'#141c48','#55406e','#d0705c'],[20.4,'#070d2c','#18224a','#363a62'],[24,'#03061a','#0a1436','#1a2652']];
 const STORM=['#15191f','#252b35','#39414d'];
 function skyCols(h,storm){h=((h%24)+24)%24;let a=SKY[0],b=SKY[1];for(let i=0;i<SKY.length-1;i++)if(h>=SKY[i][0]&&h<=SKY[i+1][0]){a=SKY[i];b=SKY[i+1];break}const u=sm((h-a[0])/(b[0]-a[0]||1));let r=[1,2,3].map(j=>mix(a[j],b[j],u));if(storm)r=r.map((q,j)=>mix(q,STORM[j],storm));return r}
 function sky(c,x,y,w,h,hour,storm){const C=skyCols(hour,storm),g=c.createLinearGradient(0,y,0,y+h);g.addColorStop(0,C[0]);g.addColorStop(.55,C[1]);g.addColorStop(1,C[2]);c.fillStyle=g;c.fillRect(x,y,w,h);return C}
 function dark(hour){const h=((hour%24)+24)%24;return h<5?1:h<7?1-(h-5)/2:h<17.5?0:h<20.5?(h-17.5)/3:1}
 function glow(c,x,y,r,col,a){if(a<=0||r<=0)return;const g=c.createRadialGradient(x,y,0,x,y,r);g.addColorStop(0,rgba(col,a));g.addColorStop(.35,rgba(col,a*.45));g.addColorStop(1,rgba(col,0));c.fillStyle=g;c.fillRect(x-r,y-r,r*2,r*2)}
 function sun(c,x,y,r,hour){const low=cl(1-Math.abs(((hour||12)-12))/6.5,0,1),col=mix('#ff7a3a','#fff3c4',low);glow(c,x,y,r*7,mix('#ff9a4a','#fff0b0',low),.45);glow(c,x,y,r*2.4,col,.8);c.fillStyle=mix(col,'#ffffff',.35);c.beginPath();c.arc(x,y,r,0,TAU);c.fill()}
 function moon(c,x,y,r,a){a=a==null?1:a;glow(c,x,y,r*6,'#c8d8ff',.22*a);c.fillStyle=rgba('#f2efe0',a);c.beginPath();c.arc(x,y,r,0,TAU);c.fill();c.fillStyle=rgba('#c9c4b0',.5*a);for(const [dx,dy,rr] of [[-.3,-.2,.22],[.25,.15,.16],[.05,.42,.12],[.4,-.35,.1]]){c.beginPath();c.arc(x+dx*r,y+dy*r,rr*r,0,TAU);c.fill()}}
 function stars(c,x,y,w,h,t,a,seed){if(a<=.02)return;const r=rng(seed||7),n=Math.round(w*h/2600);for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const sx=x+r()*w,sy=y+r()*h*(r()<.7?.6:1),b=r(),tw=.6+.4*Math.sin(t*(1+b*3)+i);c.fillStyle=rgba('#ffffff',a*(.3+.7*b)*tw*(1-(sy-y)/h*.6));const z=b>.93?2.2:b>.7?1.5:1;c.fillRect(sx,sy,z,z)}}
  
 function cloudCanvas(seed,col,shade){return cached('cl|'+seed+'|'+col+'|'+shade,360,170,(g,w,h)=>{const r=rng(seed);const pts=[];for(let i=0;i<11;i++){const u=i/10;pts.push([40+u*280+(r()-.5)*30,110-Math.sin(u*Math.PI)*(30+r()*40)-r()*12,26+Math.sin(u*Math.PI)*34+r()*14])}

 function clouds(c,t,o){ const r=rng(o.seed||3);for(let i=0;i<o.n;i++){const sp=(o.sp||8)*(.6+r()*.8),s=(o.s||1)*(.6+r()*.7),span=o.w+500*s,x=o.x-250*s+(((r()*span+t*sp)%span)+span)%span,y=o.y+r()*(o.dy||60);cloud(c,x,y,s,(o.seed||3)*31+i%5,o.col||'#ffffff',o.shade||'#9aa7b8',o.a==null?.95:o.a)}}
  
 function sea(c,x,y,w,h,t,o){o=o||{};const g=c.createLinearGradient(0,y,0,y+h);g.addColorStop(0,o.top||'#2a6f97');g.addColorStop(1,o.bot||'#0b3d5c');c.fillStyle=g;c.fillRect(x,y,w,h);
  const rough=o.rough||1,n=o.lines||22;c.lineWidth=1.2;for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const u=i/n,yy=y+Math.pow(u,1.6)*h,amp=(1+u*6)*rough,len=40+u*160,sp=(.6+u)*(o.sp||1);c.strokeStyle=rgba(o.line||'#ffffff',(.08+u*.14)*(o.la||1));c.beginPath();for(let xx=x;xx<=x+w;xx+=12){const yv=yy+Math.sin(xx/len+t*sp+i*1.7)*amp*.5;xx===x?c.moveTo(xx,yv):c.lineTo(xx,yv)}c.stroke()}
  if(o.sunX!=null){const gx=o.sunX;for(let i=0;i<26;i++){const u=i/26,yy=y+Math.pow(u,1.4)*h,ww=(10+u*120)*(o.gw||1)*(.5+.5*Math.sin(t*2+i*2.3));c.fillStyle=rgba(o.glit||'#ffd27a',(.5-u*.35)*(o.ga==null?1:o.ga));c.fillRect(gx-ww/2+Math.sin(t+i)*6,yy,ww,1.6+u*3)}}}
 function waveBand(c,x0,x1,y,amp,len,ph,col,depth){c.fillStyle=col;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(x0,y+depth);for(let x=x0;x<=x1;x+=8)c.lineTo(x,y+Math.sin(x/len+ph)*amp+Math.sin(x/(len*.43)+ph*1.7)*amp*.3);c.lineTo(x1,y+depth);c.closePath();c.fill()}
  
 function skyline(c,x,y,w,h,seed,col,lit,winCol){const cv=cached('sk|'+seed+'|'+col+'|'+w+'|'+h+'|'+(lit>0?1:0)+'|'+winCol,w,h,(g,W,H)=>{const r=rng(seed);let px=0;while(px<W){const bw=26+r()*70,bh=H*(.25+r()*.7);g.fillStyle=col;g.fillRect(px,H-bh,bw,bh);if(r()<.25){g.fillRect(px+bw*.4,H-bh-12-r()*20,3,20)}if(r()<.2){g.beginPath();g.moveTo(px,H-bh);g.lineTo(px+bw/2,H-bh-10-r()*14);g.lineTo(px+bw,H-bh);g.fill()}
   if(lit>0){for(let yy=H-bh+8;yy<H-6;yy+=11)for(let xx=px+5;xx<px+bw-6;xx+=9)if(r()<.38){g.fillStyle=rgba(winCol||'#ffd98a',.55+r()*.45);g.fillRect(xx,yy,4,6)}}px+=bw+1+r()*6}});c.drawImage(cv,x,y-h,w,h)}
  
 function rain(c,t,x,y,w,h,n,ang,a){c.strokeStyle=rgba('#cfe0f0',a==null?.35:a);c.lineWidth=1.2;c.beginPath();const r=rng(99),len=16+h*.02,dx=Math.sin(ang||.2)*len,dy=Math.cos(ang||.2)*len;for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const sx=r()*w,sy=r()*h,sp=.8+r()*.6,yy=y+((sy+t*h*1.6*sp)%h),xx=x+((sx+t*w*.1*Math.sin(ang||.2)*sp)%w+w)%w;c.moveTo(xx,yy);c.lineTo(xx+dx,yy+dy)}c.stroke()}
 function bolt(c,x,y,len,seed,a){const r=rng(seed);c.strokeStyle=rgba('#eef4ff',a);c.lineWidth=2.4;c.shadowColor='#bcd0ff';c.shadowBlur=14;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(x,y);let px=x,py=y;while(py<y+len){px+=(r()-.5)*36;py+=12+r()*22;c.lineTo(px,py)}c.stroke();c.shadowBlur=0}
 function flash(t,times){let f=0;for(const q of times){const d=t-q;if(d>=0&&d<.9)f=Math.max(f,d<.08?1:d<.16?.3:d<.24?.85:Math.max(0,1-(d-.24)/.6)*.5)}return f}
 function beam(c,x,y,ang,len,spread,col,a){c.save();c.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';const ex=x+Math.cos(ang)*len,ey=y+Math.sin(ang)*len,nx=-Math.sin(ang)*len*spread,ny=Math.cos(ang)*len*spread,g=c.createLinearGradient(x,y,ex,ey);g.addColorStop(0,rgba(col,a));g.addColorStop(1,rgba(col,0));c.fillStyle=g;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(x,y);c.lineTo(ex+nx,ey+ny);c.lineTo(ex-nx,ey-ny);c.closePath();c.fill();c.restore()}

 function grade(c,w,h,col,a,mode){if(a<=0)return;if(mode==='soft-light'){c.fillStyle=rgba(col,a*.45);c.fillRect(0,0,w,h);return}c.save();c.globalCompositeOperation=mode||'multiply';c.fillStyle=rgba(col,a);c.fillRect(0,0,w,h);c.restore()}

 function text(c,s,x,y,size,col,o){o=o||{};c.save();c.font=(o.w||800)+' '+size+'px '+(o.f||'"Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif');c.textAlign=o.al||'center';c.textBaseline=o.bl||'middle';c.direction='rtl';if(o.glow){c.shadowColor=o.glow;c.shadowBlur=o.gb||18}if(o.stroke){c.lineJoin='round';c.lineWidth=o.sw||size*.16;c.strokeStyle=o.stroke;c.strokeText(s,x,y)}c.fillStyle=col;c.globalAlpha=o.a==null?1:o.a;c.fillText(s,x,y);c.restore()}

 const BOY={hr:[8.3,9.3],hy:-88.5,neck:-78.5,sy:-76.5,sw:10.4,wy:-50,ww:8,hip:-45.5,hw:8.6,th:23,sh:22.5,ua:15,fa:14.5,hand:2.5,limb:[6,5.1,7.4,6.4]};
 const EXPR={n:[.1,.05,'n',1],smile:[.35,.15,'smile',1],grin:[.55,.25,'grin',.92],laugh:[.75,.4,'laugh',.3],sur:[1.5,1.3,'o',1.38],worry:[1.2,-.5,'worry',1.06],sad:[1.1,-.7,'frown',.9],det:[-.9,.35,'det',.86],think:[.9,-.2,'side',.95],shout:[.3,.9,'shout',1.2],proud:[.2,.4,'smile',.8],calm:[0,0,'smile',.62]};
 function ik(ax,ay,bx,by,l1,l2,sg){let dx=bx-ax,dy=by-ay,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy);const mx=l1+l2-.02;if(d>mx){bx=ax+dx/d*mx;by=ay+dy/d*mx;dx=bx-ax;dy=by-ay;d=mx}if(d<.01)d=.01;const a=Math.atan2(dy,dx),A=Math.acos(cl((l1*l1+d*d-l2*l2)/(2*l1*d),-1,1)),q=a+sg*A;return[ax+Math.cos(q)*l1,ay+Math.sin(q)*l1,bx,by]}
 function limb(c,x0,y0,x1,y1,x2,y2,w1,w2,c1,c2){c.lineCap='round';c.lineJoin='round';c.strokeStyle=c1;c.lineWidth=w1;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(x0,y0);c.lineTo(x1,y1);c.stroke();c.strokeStyle=c2||c1;c.lineWidth=w2;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(x1,y1);c.lineTo(x2,y2);c.stroke()}
  
 function armTargets(P,B,T){const pr=P.arms||'down',d=P.turn>=0?1:-1,sy=B.sy,ph=P.walk!=null?P.walk*TAU:0,sw=P.walk!=null?Math.sin(ph)*(P.run?9:5):0,o={};
  const down=[[-B.sw-2.2-sw*.2,sy+30],[B.sw+2.2+sw*.2,sy+30]];
  const set=(a,b)=>{o.a=a;o.b=b};
  switch(typeof pr==='string'?pr:'custom'){
   case'down':set([down[0][0]+sw*(P.turn||0),down[0][1]],[down[1][0]-sw*(P.turn||0),down[1][1]]);break;
   case'hips':set([-B.sw-6,sy+24],[B.sw+6,sy+24]);o.bend=1;break;
   case'wave':{const w=Math.sin(T*9)*5;set(down[0],[B.sw+12+w,sy-26]);break}
   case'wave2':{const w=Math.sin(T*9)*5;set([-B.sw-12-w,sy-26],[B.sw+12+w,sy-26]);break}
   case'up':set([-B.sw-6,sy-34],[B.sw+6,sy-34]);break;
   case'cheer':{const w=Math.sin(T*7)*4;set([-B.sw-9+w,sy-30-Math.abs(w)],[B.sw+9-w,sy-30-Math.abs(w)]);break}
   case'point':set(d>0?down[0]:[-B.sw-28,sy+2],d>0?[B.sw+28,sy+2]:down[1]);break;
   case'pointUp':set(d>0?down[0]:[-B.sw-12,sy-30],d>0?[B.sw+12,sy-30]:down[1]);break;
   case'chin':set(d>0?down[0]:[-2,B.hy+B.hr[1]*.9],d>0?[2,B.hy+B.hr[1]*.9]:down[1]);break;
   case'head':set([-B.sw+1,B.hy-B.hr[1]*.7],[B.sw-1,B.hy-B.hr[1]*.7]);break;
   case'clap':{const op=Math.abs(Math.sin(T*11))*5;set([-1.5-op,sy+15],[1.5+op,sy+15]);break}
   case'front':set([-5,sy+19],[5,sy+19]);break;
   case'hold':set([d*6-5,sy+16],[d*6+5,sy+16]);break;
   case'lantern':set(d>0?down[0]:[-B.sw-10,sy+14],d>0?[B.sw+10,sy+14]:down[1]);break;
   case'pull':{const k=Math.sin(T*3)*3;set([d*(16+k)-3,sy+20],[d*(26+k)+3,sy+17]);break}
   case'shrug':set([-B.sw-9,sy+9],[B.sw+9,sy+9]);o.bend=1;break;
   case'think':set(down[0],[3,B.hy+B.hr[1]*.95]);break;
   case'shade':set(down[0],[d*3+2,B.hy-B.hr[1]*.35]);break;
   case'crank':{const a=T*4.2;set([d*14+Math.cos(a)*5-2,sy+20+Math.sin(a)*5],[d*14+Math.cos(a)*5+2,sy+20+Math.sin(a)*5]);break}
   case'wheel':{const a=Math.sin(T*1.6)*.5;set([d*16+Math.cos(Math.PI+a)*8,sy+16+Math.sin(Math.PI+a)*8],[d*16+Math.cos(a)*8,sy+16+Math.sin(a)*8]);break}
   case'radio':set(d>0?down[0]:[-4,B.hy+B.hr[1]*.8],d>0?[4,B.hy+B.hr[1]*.8]:down[1]);break;
   case'bow':set([-4,sy+34],[4,sy+34]);break;
   case'shake':set(d>0?down[0]:[-B.sw-16,sy+20],d>0?[B.sw+16,sy+20+Math.sin(T*10)*2]:down[1]);break;
   case'give':set(d>0?down[0]:[-B.sw-18,sy+10],d>0?[B.sw+18,sy+10]:down[1]);break;
   case'row':{const a=T*3;set([d*14+Math.cos(a)*6,sy+22+Math.sin(a)*3],[d*20+Math.cos(a)*6,sy+22+Math.sin(a)*3]);break}
   default:set(pr.a||down[0],pr.b||down[1]);o.bend=pr.bend}
  return o}
  
 function fig(c,x,y,s,L,P){P=P||{};const boy=!!L.boy,B=boy?BOY:MAN,T=P.t||0,turn=cl(P.turn||0,-1,1),at=Math.abs(turn),d=turn>=0?1:-1;

  const walking=P.walk!=null,ph=walking?P.walk*TAU:0,bob=walking?-Math.abs(Math.sin(ph))*(P.run?3.2:1.7):0,yb=(P.bob||0)+bob+(P.legs==='sit'?B.th*.92:P.legs==='kneel'?B.sh*.7:0);

   if(P.legs==='sit'){const kx=hx0+d*B.th*Math.max(.3,at)*.95;legs.push([hx0,hipY,kx,hipY+2,kx+d*1.5,0]);continue}
   if(P.legs==='kneel'){if(i===(d>0?0:1)){legs.push([hx0,hipY,hx0+d*2,hipY+B.th*.95,hx0-d*B.sh*.7,-1])}else{const kx=hx0+d*B.th*.75;legs.push([hx0,hipY,kx,hipY+B.th*.35,kx,0])}continue}

 function open(kind,idx,o){o=o||{};if(ST.on)return false;const prod=idx&&typeof idx==='object'?idx:(kind==='film'?FILMS:PLAYS)[idx];if(!prod)return false;css();const full=!!o.full&&kind==='film';

  const off=kind==='film'&&!full?PRE:0,cast=prod.cast||{};S.lines=(prod.subs||[]).map(q=>({t0:q[0]+off,t1:q[1]+off,text:q[2],who:q[4]||(q[3]==='b'?'boy':'man'),role:cast[q[4]]||(q[3]==='b'?'b':''),b:q[3]==='b'})).sort((a,b)=>a.t0-b.t0);
  S.warmQ=[];try{if(TCCITY.ok())for(const q of (prod.cams||[]))S.warmQ.push(q,q,q)}catch(e){}TCVOICE.stop();ST.voice={lines:S.lines.length,sent:0,spoken:0};

   if(a==='close')close(false);else if(a==='play')toggle();else if(a==='mute'){sndStart();TCSND.setMute(!TCSND.mute);if(TCSND.mute)hush(S);syncUi(S)}else if(a==='snd')sndStart()});

 function sndOk(){const c=TCSND.ctx;return !!c&&c.state==='running'}
 function sndStart(){const c=TCSND.ensure();if(c&&c.state!=='running'&&ST.on&&ST.on.playing){try{c.resume()}catch(e){}}}
 function wake(S){S.idleT=0;S.el.classList.remove('idle')}
 function toggle(){const S=ST.on;if(!S)return;S.playing=!S.playing;if(S.playing){S.last=performance.now();S.audio.resume();TCVOICE.resume()}else{S.audio.pause();TCVOICE.pause()}syncUi(S)}
 function syncUi(S){const el=S.el,pb=el.querySelector('[data-ts=play]'),mb=el.querySelector('[data-ts=mute]');pb.textContent=S.playing?'⏸ עצירה':'▶ המשך';pb.setAttribute('aria-label',S.playing?'עצירה':'המשך');mb.textContent=TCSND.mute?'🔇 מושתק':'🔊 צליל';mb.setAttribute('aria-label',TCSND.mute?'ביטול השתקה':'השתקה');const v=el.querySelector('[data-ts=vol]');if(+v.value!==Math.round(TCSND.vol*100))v.value=Math.round(TCSND.vol*100)}
 function close(completed){const S=ST.on;if(!S)return;ST.on=null;ST.closed++;cancelAnimationFrame(S.raf);clearInterval(S.iv);hush(S);try{S.audio.stop()}catch(e){}try{S.el.remove()}catch(e){}
  try{if(S.ph){G77_PHH.every=S.ph[0];if(S.ph[1]!=null)G77_PHS.every=S.ph[1]}}catch(e){}
  ST.last={kind:S.kind,idx:typeof S.idx==='object'?(S.prod.id||'obj'):S.idx,full:!!S.full,t:S.t,completed:!!completed,frames:ST.frames};
  try{S.o.onEnd&&S.o.onEnd(!!completed,S)}catch(e){ST.err=String(e&&e.message||e)}}
  
 function hush(S){TCVOICE.stop();if(S&&S.lines)for(const L of S.lines)if(L.on&&!L.done){L.done=1;L.on=0}try{TCSND.duck(false)}catch(e){}}
 function voice(S,T){for(const L of S.lines){if(L.sent)continue;if(T<L.t0)break;L.sent=1;if(T>L.t1||TCSND.mute)continue;const slot=Math.max(.8,L.t1-L.t0),est=L.text.length/13,rate=est>slot*1.1?Math.min(1.35,est/slot):1;
   L.spoken=TCVOICE.speak(L.text,L.who,L.role,TCSND.vol,{t:T,rate,onstart(){L.on=1;L.ts=S.t;try{TCSND.duck(true)}catch(e){}},onend(){L.done=1;L.on=0;L.te=S.t;if(!S.lines.some(q=>q.on&&!q.done))try{TCSND.duck(false)}catch(e){}}});ST.voice.sent++;if(L.spoken)ST.voice.spoken++}}
  
 function lineNow(S,T){let best=null;for(const L of S.lines){if(T<L.t0)break;let v;if(L.spoken){if(L.done)v=false;else if(L.on)v=true;else v=T<L.t0+1.2?false:T<L.t1}else v=T<L.t1;if(v)best=L}if(!best)return null;const a0=best.spoken&&best.ts!=null?best.ts:best.t0;return{text:best.text,b:best.b,a:Math.min(1,(T-a0)/.18,best.spoken?1:(best.t1-T)/.2)}}
 function chapter(S){const p=S.prod,ft=S.kind==='film'?S.t-(S.full?0:PRE):S.t;if(S.kind==='film'){if(ft<0)return'האורות יורדים';if(ft>p.len)return S.full?p.name:'מחיאות כפיים';let a=0;for(const q of p.shots){if(ft<a+q.d)return q.ch||p.name;a+=q.d}return p.name}const cs=p.chapters||[];let n='';for(const q of cs)if(S.t>=q[0])n=q[1];return n}
 function loop(now){const S=ST.on;if(!S)return;const rdt=(now-S.last)/1000;S.last=now;const dt=Math.min(.1,Math.max(0,rdt));
  if(S.playing&&!S.hold){S.t+=dt;ST.frames++;ST.dts.push(rdt*1000);if(ST.dts.length>1800)ST.dts.shift();S.idleT+=dt;if(S.idleT>3.2)S.el.classList.add('idle')}
  const d0=performance.now();try{draw(S)}catch(e){ST.err=String(e&&e.stack||e).slice(0,400)}if(S.playing&&!S.hold){ST.dms=ST.dms||[];ST.dms.push(performance.now()-d0);if(ST.dms.length>1800)ST.dms.shift()}
  if(S.playing){S.audio.pump(S.t);voice(S,S.t)}
  if(S.warmQ&&S.warmQ.length){try{TCCITY.grab(S.warmQ.shift())}catch(e){}}
  S.el.classList.toggle('nosnd',!sndOk()&&!TCSND.mute);
  if(S.frame++%6===0){S.el.querySelector('.tsProg i').style.width=(100*Math.min(1,S.t/S.total)).toFixed(1)+'%';S.el.querySelector('.tsTime').textContent=fmt(S.t)+' / '+fmt(S.total);S.el.querySelector('.tsCh').textContent=chapter(S)}
  if(S.t>=S.total){close(true);return}
  S.raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop)}
  
 function draw(S){const cv=S.cv,dpr=Math.min(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1),W=cv.clientWidth||innerWidth,H=cv.clientHeight||innerHeight;if(cv.width!==Math.round(W*dpr)||cv.height!==Math.round(H*dpr)){cv.width=Math.round(W*dpr);cv.height=Math.round(H*dpr)}
  const c=cv.getContext('2d');c.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);if(S.full)fullScreen(c,W,H,S);else if(S.kind==='film')cinema(c,W,H,S,dpr);else theatre(c,W,H,S,dpr);
  if(!S.playing){c.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.35)';c.fillRect(0,0,W,H);K.text(c,'❚❚  עצירה',W/2,H/2,Math.min(44,W/18),'#f2c45a',{stroke:'rgba(0,0,0,.7)',sw:6})}}
 function buf(S,key,w,h){let b=S[key];if(!b){b=document.createElement('canvas');S[key]=b}if(b.width!==w||b.height!==h){b.width=w;b.height=h}return b}
 const GRAIN=(()=>{let cv=null;return()=>{if(cv)return cv;cv=document.createElement('canvas');cv.width=cv.height=192;const g=cv.getContext('2d'),im=g.createImageData(192,192);for(let i=0;i<im.data.length;i+=4){const v=Math.random()*255;im.data[i]=im.data[i+1]=im.data[i+2]=v;im.data[i+3]=255}g.putImageData(im,0,0);return cv}})();
  
 function filmFrame(c,F,ft,S){c.fillStyle='#000';c.fillRect(0,0,FW,FH);if(ft<0||ft>F.len)return;let a=0,i=0;for(;i<F.shots.length;i++){if(ft<a+F.shots[i].d)break;a+=F.shots[i].d}if(i>=F.shots.length)return;const sh=F.shots[i],lt=ft-a;
  const shot=(cc,q,t)=>{cc.save();try{q.draw(cc,t,t/q.d)}catch(e){ST.err=String(e&&e.stack||e).slice(0,300)}cc.restore()};
  const tr=sh.tr||'cut',td=sh.td||.7;
  if(tr==='x'&&lt<td&&i>0){const prev=F.shots[i-1];shot(c,prev,prev.d+lt);const b=buf(S,'xb',c.canvas.width,c.canvas.height),bc=b.getContext('2d');bc.setTransform(c.getTransform());shot(bc,sh,lt);c.save();c.setTransform(1,0,0,1,0,0);c.globalAlpha=K.sm(lt/td);c.drawImage(b,0,0);c.restore()}
  else shot(c,sh,lt);
  if(tr==='dip'&&lt<td){c.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,'+(1-K.sm(lt/td))+')';c.fillRect(0,0,FW,FH)}
  const nx=F.shots[i+1];if(nx&&nx.tr==='dip'&&sh.d-lt<(nx.td||.7)){c.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,'+K.sm(1-(sh.d-lt)/(nx.td||.7))+')';c.fillRect(0,0,FW,FH)}
  if(ft<.8){c.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,'+(1-ft/.8)+')';c.fillRect(0,0,FW,FH)}if(F.len-ft<1.2){c.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,'+(1-(F.len-ft)/1.2)+')';c.fillRect(0,0,FW,FH)}
  const ln=S.lines?lineNow(S,S.t):null;if(ln)subtitle(c,ln.text,FW/2,FH-40,Math.max(0,ln.a),ln.b?'b':'')}
 function subtitle(c,txt,x,y,al,who){const Z=typeof TCSET!=='undefined'?TCSET.subsScale():1;if(!Z)return;    c.save();c.globalAlpha=al;if(Z!==1){c.translate(x,y);c.scale(Z,Z);x=0;y=0}c.font='700 29px "Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif';c.direction='rtl';c.textAlign='center';c.textBaseline='middle';
   
  const W0=c.measureText(txt).width,MW=FW*.84/(Z||1);let L=[txt];if(W0>MW){const n=Math.ceil(W0/MW),lim=Math.min(MW,W0/n*1.12);L=[];let cur='';for(const wd of String(txt).split(' ')){const t2=cur?cur+' '+wd:wd;if(cur&&c.measureText(t2).width>lim){L.push(cur);cur=wd}else cur=t2}if(cur)L.push(cur)}
  const y0=y-(L.length-1)*42;L.forEach((s,i)=>{const yy=y0+i*42,w=c.measureText(s).width;c.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.5)';const p=16;if(c.roundRect){c.beginPath();c.roundRect(x-w/2-p,yy-22,w+p*2,44,10);c.fill()}else c.fillRect(x-w/2-p,yy-22,w+p*2,44);c.lineJoin='round';c.lineWidth=5;c.strokeStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.85)';c.strokeText(s,x,yy);c.fillStyle=who==='b'?'#ffe9a8':'#ffffff';c.fillText(s,x,yy)});c.restore()}
  
 function env(list,t){let v=0;for(const [a,d] of list||[]){const u=(t-a)/d;if(u>=0&&u<=1)v=Math.max(v,Math.sin(Math.PI*Math.min(1,u*1.6))*(u<.85?1:(1-u)/.15))}return v}
  
 function fullScreen(c,W,H,S){c.fillStyle='#000';c.fillRect(0,0,W,H);const k=Math.min(W/FW,H/FH),sw=FW*k,sh=FH*k;c.save();c.translate((W-sw)/2,(H-sh)/2);c.scale(k,k);c.beginPath();c.rect(0,0,FW,FH);c.clip();filmFrame(c,S.prod,S.t,S);
  const g=c.createRadialGradient(FW/2,FH/2,FH*.5,FW/2,FH/2,FW*.68);g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,.32)');c.fillStyle=g;c.fillRect(0,0,FW,FH);c.restore()}
  
 function cinema(c,W,H,S,dpr){const F=S.prod,T=S.t,ft=T-PRE,E=PRE+F.len,house=T<PRE?1-K.sm(T/2.6)*.94:T>E?.06+K.sm((T-E-1)/2.5)*.9:.06,cur=T<PRE?K.sm((T-1.8)/2.6):T>E?1-K.sm((T-E-1.2)/2.8):1;
  const sw=Math.min(W*.92,H*.64*FW/FH),sh=sw*FH/FW,sx=(W-sw)/2,sy=Math.max(10,H*.06);
   
  const hq=Math.round(house*20)/20,bg=K.cached('hall|'+W+'x'+H+'|'+hq+'|'+dpr,W*dpr,H*dpr,(g)=>{g.scale(dpr,dpr);const wall=g.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);wall.addColorStop(0,K.mix('#0e0a14','#3a2430',hq));wall.addColorStop(1,K.mix('#040306','#24141c',hq));g.fillStyle=wall;g.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
   for(const s of [-1,1]){const x0=s<0?0:W,pw=Math.max(0,(W-sw)/2-14);if(pw<20)continue;for(let k=0;k<3;k++){const px=s<0?x0+pw*(k+.5)/3:x0-pw*(k+.5)/3,py=sy+sh*.35;g.strokeStyle=K.rgba('#c9a24a',.25+hq*.4);g.lineWidth=1.5;g.strokeRect(px-pw/7,sy+10,pw/3.5,H*.62);
    g.fillStyle=K.mix('#3a2a1a','#d9b45a',hq);g.beginPath();g.moveTo(px-9,py);g.lineTo(px+9,py);g.lineTo(px+5,py+16);g.lineTo(px-5,py+16);g.closePath();g.fill();K.glow(g,px,py+4,70*(.3+hq),'#ffcf8a',.15+hq*.55);K.glow(g,px,py-30,90,'#ffcf8a',hq*.18)}}
   for(const x of [W*.04,W*.96]){if(W<700)break;g.fillStyle='#0d3b1f';g.fillRect(x-30,H*.5,60,20);K.text(g,'יציאה',x,H*.5+10,13,'#6bff9a',{w:700,glow:'#2aff6a',gb:8})}
   g.fillStyle='#030204';g.fillRect(sx-14,sy-12,sw+28,sh+24)});
  c.drawImage(bg,0,0,W,H);const sc=S.scr,lum=S.lum*(ft>0&&ft<F.len?1:0);if(lum>.02){c.fillStyle=K.rgba(sc,.07*lum);c.fillRect(sx-40,sy-30,sw+80,sh+60)}
   
  c.save();c.translate(sx,sy);c.scale(sw/FW,sh/FH);c.beginPath();c.rect(0,0,FW,FH);c.clip();filmFrame(c,F,ft,S);
  if(ft>0&&ft<F.len){const g=c.createRadialGradient(FW/2,FH/2,FH*.42,FW/2,FH/2,FW*.62);g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,.42)');c.fillStyle=g;c.fillRect(0,0,FW,FH)}c.restore();
  if(T<PRE+.4){c.fillStyle=K.rgba('#d6cdbd',house*.65);c.fillRect(sx,sy,sw,sh)}
  if(S.frame%30===0&&ft>0&&ft<F.len){try{const sm=buf(S,'smp',6,2),g=sm.getContext('2d',{willReadFrequently:true});g.drawImage(c.canvas,sx*dpr,sy*dpr,sw*dpr,sh*dpr,0,0,6,2);const d=g.getImageData(0,0,6,2).data;let r=0,gg=0,b=0;for(let i=0;i<d.length;i+=4){r+=d[i];gg+=d[i+1];b+=d[i+2]}const n=d.length/4;r/=n;gg/=n;b/=n;S.lum=(r*.3+gg*.59+b*.11)/255;const m=Math.max(r,gg,b,1);S.scr='#'+[r,gg,b].map(v=>Math.round(Math.min(255,v/m*230)).toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('')}catch(e){}}
   
  if(ft>0&&ft<F.len){c.save();const g=c.createLinearGradient(0,H,0,sy+sh);g.addColorStop(0,K.rgba(sc,0));g.addColorStop(1,K.rgba(sc,.05+lum*.07));c.fillStyle=g;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(W/2-30,H+40);c.lineTo(W/2+30,H+40);c.lineTo(sx+sw,sy+sh);c.lineTo(sx,sy+sh);c.closePath();c.fill();const R=K.rng(4);for(let i=0;i<40;i++){const u=(R()+T*.01*(R()+.2))%1,px=K.lerp(W/2,sx+R()*sw,u),py=K.lerp(H,sy+sh,u)+Math.sin(T*.6+i)*6;c.fillStyle=K.rgba('#ffffff',.18*R()*(.3+lum));c.fillRect(px,py,1.5,1.5)}c.restore()}
   
  curtainPair(c,sx-14,sy-12,sw+28,sh+24,cur,house,T);
   
  const laugh=ft>0?env(F.react&&F.react.laugh,ft):0,lean=ft>0?env(F.react&&F.react.lean,ft):0,clap=T>E+.1&&T<E+4.6?1:0;
  c.save();c.translate(0,0);K.crowd(c,W,H+20,{rows:3,rowH:H*.085,n:Math.max(7,Math.round(W/120)),scale:Math.max(.7,Math.min(1.5,H/620)),t:T,lit:sc,la:.2+lum*.55,laugh,lean,clap,clapHigh:1,seat:'#2a0710',seed:9,dim:(1-house)*.72});c.restore();
  if(S.snack){c.save();c.translate(W-90,H-10);popcorn(c,1.1*Math.min(1.4,H/620),K.rgba(sc,.4))}

 function train(c,x,y,s,n,o){ for(let i=n;i>=1;i--)car(c,x-(130+122+(i-1)*246)*s,y,s,{...o,seed:(o.seed||1)*7+i});loco(c,x,y,s,o)}
 function track(c,x0,x1,y,s,col){s=s||1;c.fillStyle=col||'#3a342e';c.beginPath();c.moveTo(x0,y+2*s);c.lineTo(x1,y+2*s);c.lineTo(x1,y+12*s);c.lineTo(x0,y+12*s);c.closePath();c.fill();c.fillStyle='#2a221c';for(let x=x0-(x0%(16*s));x<x1;x+=16*s)c.fillRect(x,y+.5*s,9*s,4*s);c.fillStyle='#9aa0a8';c.fillRect(x0,y-1.5*s,x1-x0,2.6*s)}
 function lantern(c,x,y,s,on,t){c.save();c.translate(x,y);c.scale(s,s);if(on)K.glow(c,0,6,46,'#ffcf6a',.5*on*(.92+.08*Math.sin((t||0)*17)));c.strokeStyle='#2a2420';c.lineWidth=1.6;c.beginPath();c.arc(0,-6,5,Math.PI,0);c.stroke();c.fillStyle='#2a2420';c.fillRect(-6,-2,12,3);c.fillRect(-6,14,12,3);c.fillStyle=on?'#ffe08a':'#6a6a5a';c.fillRect(-5,1,10,13);c.restore()}
 function truss(c,x0,x1,yd,h,col,step){step=step||70;c.strokeStyle=col;c.lineWidth=5;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(x0,yd-h);c.lineTo(x1,yd-h);c.moveTo(x0,yd);c.lineTo(x1,yd);c.stroke();c.lineWidth=3.2;c.beginPath();for(let x=x0,k=0;x<x1;x+=step,k++){c.moveTo(x,yd);c.lineTo(x,yd-h);if(k%2){c.moveTo(x,yd);c.lineTo(x+step,yd-h)}else{c.moveTo(x,yd-h);c.lineTo(x+step,yd)}}c.stroke()}
 function rails3d(c,vx,vy,w,h,t,speed,o){ const by=h,gw=w*.42;c.fillStyle=o&&o.bal||'#2a241e';c.beginPath();c.moveTo(vx-6,vy);c.lineTo(vx+6,vy);c.lineTo(w/2+gw*1.3,by);c.lineTo(w/2-gw*1.3,by);c.closePath();c.fill();
  const off=(t*speed)%1;c.fillStyle=o&&o.sl||'#4a3a2a';for(let i=0;i<26;i++){const u=Math.pow((i+off)/26,2.2),y=vy+(by-vy)*u,hw=6+(gw*1.15-6)*u;c.fillRect(vx-hw+(w/2-vx)*u,y,hw*2,2+u*16)}
  c.strokeStyle=o&&o.rail||'#c8ccd2';c.lineWidth=2.4;for(const s of [-1,1]){c.beginPath();c.moveTo(vx+s*3,vy);c.lineTo(w/2+s*gw*.82,by);c.stroke()}}
 function credits(c,t,d,title,lines){c.fillStyle='#000';c.fillRect(0,0,FW,FH);const H0=FH+40,sp=46,y0=H0-t*((H0+lines.length*sp+160)/d);K.text(c,title,FW/2,y0,46,'#f6d27a',{glow:'#f2c45a',gb:16});lines.forEach((q,i)=>{const y=y0+90+i*sp;if(y<-30||y>FH+30)return;const [a,b]=q;if(b)K.text(c,a+'  ·  '+b,FW/2,y,24,i%2?'#e9e2d0':'#f4ecd8',{w:600});else K.text(c,a,FW/2,y,a.length<4?22:26,'#f2c45a',{w:800})})}
 function titleCard(c,t,main,sub,o){o=o||{};const a1=K.seg(t,o.a||.3,(o.a||.3)+.8)*(1-K.seg(t,o.b||2.1,(o.b||2.1)+.5));if(a1>0)K.text(c,o.studio||'אולפני טורבו סיטי מציגים',FW/2,FH*.46,26,'#f4ecd8',{w:600,a:a1,glow:'#ffffff',gb:8});
  const a2=K.seg(t,o.c||2.5,(o.c||2.5)+1.1);if(a2>0){const sc=1+.06*(1-K.eio(a2));c.save();c.translate(FW/2,FH*.44);c.scale(sc,sc);K.text(c,main,0,0,86,'#f6d27a',{a:a2,glow:'#f2a83a',gb:30,stroke:'rgba(40,20,0,.35)',sw:6});c.restore();if(sub)K.text(c,sub,FW/2,FH*.44+70,24,'#f4ecd8',{w:600,a:K.seg(t,(o.c||2.5)+.8,(o.c||2.5)+1.6)})}}
 return{lay,wheel,loco,car,train,track,lantern,truss,rails3d,credits,titleCard,FW,FH}})();
